        have h' : (n1.toNat : ℤ) < (m.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [e1, e3]; omega
        exact_mod_cast h'
      have hlt2 : n2.toNat < m.toNat := by
        have h' : (n2.toNat : ℤ) < (m.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [e2, e3]; omega
        exact_mod_cast h'
      have hn1n : n1.toNat < n := by omega
      have hn2n : n2.toNat < n := by omega
      exact MulanWins.cut hsplit
        (ih n1.toNat hn1n n1 (le_refl _) hn1_1 T₁ hn1_ang)
        (ih n2.toNat hn2n n2 (le_refl _) hn2_1 T₂ hn2_ang)

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `m·θ` for a positive integer `m`,
then Mulan can force a win.
-/
lemma mulanWins_of_hasMultiple (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (m : ℤ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (T : TriangleAngles)
    (h : T.a = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.b = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.c = (m:ℝ) * θ) :
    MulanWins θ T :=
  mulanWins_of_hasMultiple_aux θ hθ m.toNat m (le_refl _) hm T h

/--
If `π = n·θ` for an integer `n ≥ 2` (with `θ > 0`), then Mulan can guarantee
victory in finitely many steps starting from any triangle.
-/
lemma mulanWins_of_divides (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (n : ℤ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (hn : Real.pi = (n : ℝ) * θ) :
    MulanCanForceWin θ := by
  intro T

    have hk0 : k ≤ 0 := by omega
    have hkr : (k:ℝ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk0
    have hprod : (k:ℝ) * θ ≤ 0 * θ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkr hθ.le
    simp at hprod
    linarith [hk]
  rcases base_step θ hθ n hn2 hn T with hdirect | ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1, h2⟩
  · rcases hdirect with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
    · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T.a T.a_pos k hk) T (Or.inl hk)
    · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T.b T.b_pos k hk) T (Or.inr (Or.inl hk))
    · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T.c T.c_pos k hk) T (Or.inr (Or.inr hk))
  · apply MulanWins.cut hsplit
    · rcases h1 with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₁.a T₁.a_pos k hk) T₁ (Or.inl hk)
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₁.b T₁.b_pos k hk) T₁ (Or.inr (Or.inl hk))
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₁.c T₁.c_pos k hk) T₁ (Or.inr (Or.inr hk))
    · rcases h2 with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₂.a T₂.a_pos k hk) T₂ (Or.inl hk)
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₂.b T₂.b_pos k hk) T₂ (Or.inr (Or.inl hk))
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₂.c T₂.c_pos k hk) T₂ (Or.inr (Or.inr hk))

/--
Core algebraic fact underlying the one-move avoidance argument: if a single
cut splits an angle `γ` (with the other two angles `α`, `β` fixed) into `x`
and `γ - x`, producing triangles with angle sets `{x, α, β+(γ-x)}` and
`{γ-x, β, α+x}`, then it is impossible for both resulting triangles to
contain an angle equal to `θ`, provided `α ≠ θ`, `β ≠ θ`, `γ ≠ 2θ`, and
`θ ≠ π/2`.
-/
lemma no_double_target_of_split (θ : ℝ) (hθ90 : θ ≠ Real.pi / 2)
    (α β γ x : ℝ) (hsum : α + β + γ = Real.pi)
    (hαpos : 0 < α) (hβpos : 0 < β)
    (hαθ : α ≠ θ) (hβθ : β ≠ θ) (hγ2θ : γ ≠ 2 * θ) :
    ¬ ((x = θ ∨ α = θ ∨ β + (γ - x) = θ) ∧ (γ - x = θ ∨ β = θ ∨ α + x = θ)) := by
  rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1 | h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · exact hγ2θ (by linarith)
    · exact hβθ h2
    · linarith
  · exact hαθ h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · linarith
    · exact hβθ h2
    · exact hθ90 (by linarith)

/--
If `θ ≠ π/2` and none of the angles of `T` equal `θ` or `2θ`, then for any
legal cut of `T` into `T₁` and `T₂`, at least one of `T₁`, `T₂` has no angle
equal to `θ`. In other words, Shan-Yu can always avoid an immediate loss on
this move.
-/
lemma no_forcing_of_split (θ : ℝ) (hθ90 : θ ≠ Real.pi / 2)
    (T T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles) (hsplit : LegalSplit T T₁ T₂)
    (hTa : T.a ≠ θ) (hTb : T.b ≠ θ) (hTc : T.c ≠ θ)
    (hTa2 : T.a ≠ 2 * θ) (hTb2 : T.b ≠ 2 * θ) (hTc2 : T.c ≠ 2 * θ) :
    ¬ HasTargetAngle θ T₁ ∨ ¬ HasTargetAngle θ T₂ := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  rcases hsplit with
    ⟨x, hx0, hxa, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ |
    ⟨x, hx0, hxb, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ |
    ⟨x, hx0, hxc, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩
  · have key := no_double_target_of_split θ hθ90 T.b T.c T.a x (by linarith)
      T.b_pos T.c_pos hTb hTc hTa2
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key
  · have key := no_double_target_of_split θ hθ90 T.c T.a T.b x (by linarith)
      T.c_pos T.a_pos hTc hTa hTb2
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key
  · have key := no_double_target_of_split θ hθ90 T.a T.b T.c x hsum
      T.a_pos T.b_pos hTa hTb hTc2
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key

/--
Core algebraic fact underlying the two-move avoidance argument for the target
angle `2θ`: if a single cut splits an angle `γ` (with the other two angles
`α`, `β` fixed) into `x` and `γ - x`, producing triangles with angle sets
`{x, α, β+(γ-x)}` and `{γ-x, β, α+x}`, then it is impossible for both
resulting triangles to contain an angle equal to `2θ`, provided `α ≠ 2θ`,
`β ≠ 2θ`, `γ ≠ 4θ`, and `θ ≠ π/4`.
-/
lemma no_double_target_of_split_two_theta (θ : ℝ) (hθ45 : θ ≠ Real.pi / 4)
    (α β γ x : ℝ) (hsum : α + β + γ = Real.pi)
    (hαpos : 0 < α) (hβpos : 0 < β)
    (hα2θ : α ≠ 2 * θ) (hβ2θ : β ≠ 2 * θ) (hγ4θ : γ ≠ 4 * θ) :
    ¬ ((x = 2 * θ ∨ α = 2 * θ ∨ β + (γ - x) = 2 * θ) ∧
       (γ - x = 2 * θ ∨ β = 2 * θ ∨ α + x = 2 * θ)) := by
  rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1 | h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · exact hγ4θ (by linarith)
    · exact hβ2θ h2
    · linarith
  · exact hα2θ h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · linarith
    · exact hβ2θ h2
    · exact hθ45 (by linarith)

/--
Core algebraic fact underlying the general `m·θ`-avoidance argument: if a
single cut splits an angle `γ` (with the other two angles `α`, `β` fixed)
into `x` and `γ - x`, producing triangles with angle sets `{x, α, β+(γ-x)}`
and `{γ-x, β, α+x}`, then it is impossible for both resulting triangles to
contain an angle equal to `m·θ` for a fixed integer `m`, provided `α ≠ mθ`,
`β ≠ mθ`, `γ ≠ 2mθ`, and `mθ ≠ π/2`.
-/
lemma no_double_target_of_split_multiple (θ : ℝ) (m : ℤ)
    (hmθ90 : (m : ℝ) * θ ≠ Real.pi / 2)
    (α β γ x : ℝ) (hsum : α + β + γ = Real.pi)
    (hαpos : 0 < α) (hβpos : 0 < β)
    (hαmθ : α ≠ (m : ℝ) * θ) (hβmθ : β ≠ (m : ℝ) * θ)
    (hγ2mθ : γ ≠ 2 * ((m : ℝ) * θ)) :
    ¬ ((x = (m : ℝ) * θ ∨ α = (m : ℝ) * θ ∨ β + (γ - x) = (m : ℝ) * θ) ∧
       (γ - x = (m : ℝ) * θ ∨ β = (m : ℝ) * θ ∨ α + x = (m : ℝ) * θ)) := by
  rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1 | h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · exact hγ2mθ (by linarith)
    · exact hβmθ h2
    · linarith
  · exact hαmθ h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · linarith
    · exact hβmθ h2
    · exact hmθ90 (by linarith)

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `2mθ` for a positive integer `m`
(with `θ > 0`), then Mulan can make a single legal cut so that both
resulting triangles have an angle equal to `mθ`.
-/
lemma exists_split_even_multiple (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (m : ℤ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (T : TriangleAngles)
    (h : T.a = 2 * (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.b = 2 * (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.c = 2 * (m:ℝ) * θ) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      (T₁.a = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T₁.b = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T₁.c = (m:ℝ) * θ) ∧
      (T₂.a = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T₂.b = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T₂.c = (m:ℝ) * θ) := by
  have hm_real : (1:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hm_pos : 0 < (m:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hmθ_pos : 0 < (m:ℝ) * θ := mul_pos hm_pos hθ
  rcases h with ha | hb | hc
  · have hxa : (m:ℝ) * θ < T.a := by rw [ha]; nlinarith [hmθ_pos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_a T ((m:ℝ) * θ) hmθ_pos hxa
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inl h1a, Or.inl ?_⟩
    rw [h2a, ha]; ring
  · have hxb : (m:ℝ) * θ < T.b := by rw [hb]; nlinarith [hmθ_pos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_b T ((m:ℝ) * θ) hmθ_pos hxb
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inl h1a, Or.inl ?_⟩
    rw [h2a, hb]; ring
  · have hxc : (m:ℝ) * θ < T.c := by rw [hc]; nlinarith [hmθ_pos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_c T ((m:ℝ) * θ) hmθ_pos hxc
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inl h1a, Or.inl ?_⟩
    rw [h2a, hc]; ring

/--
If `θ` does not divide `π` (no integer multiple of `θ` equals `π`), and none of the
angles `α`, `β`, `γ` of a triangle (with `α + β + γ = π`) is an integer multiple of `θ`,
then for any cut splitting `γ` into `x` and `γ - x`, it is impossible for both resulting

import Mathlib
open Set

/--
A nondegenerate triangle, represented only by its three angles.

The physical game depends only on the angles of the current triangle,
so side lengths and coordinates are omitted.
-/
structure TriangleAngles where
  a : ℝ
  b : ℝ
  c : ℝ
  a_pos : 0 < a
  b_pos : 0 < b
  c_pos : 0 < c
  angle_sum : a + b + c = Real.pi

/--
`LegalSplit T T₁ T₂` means that Mulan can cut the triangle `T`
so that the two possible remaining triangles are `T₁` and `T₂`.

The three disjuncts correspond to cutting from the vertices whose
angles are `T.a`, `T.b`, and `T.c`, respectively.
-/
def LegalSplit
    (T T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles) : Prop :=
  (
    ∃ x : ℝ,
      0 < x ∧ x < T.a ∧
        T₁.a = x ∧
        T₁.b = T.b ∧
        T₁.c = T.c + (T.a - x) ∧
        T₂.a = T.a - x ∧
        T₂.b = T.c ∧
        T₂.c = T.b + x
  ) ∨
  (
    ∃ x : ℝ,
      0 < x ∧ x < T.b ∧
        T₁.a = x ∧
        T₁.b = T.c ∧
        T₁.c = T.a + (T.b - x) ∧
        T₂.a = T.b - x ∧
        T₂.b = T.a ∧
        T₂.c = T.c + x
  ) ∨
  (
    ∃ x : ℝ,
      0 < x ∧ x < T.c ∧
        T₁.a = x ∧
        T₁.b = T.a ∧
        T₁.c = T.b + (T.c - x) ∧
        T₂.a = T.c - x ∧
        T₂.b = T.b ∧
        T₂.c = T.a + x
  )

/-- The current triangle already contains an angle equal to `θ`. -/
def HasTargetAngle (θ : ℝ) (T : TriangleAngles) : Prop :=
  T.a = θ ∨ T.b = θ ∨ T.c = θ

/--
`MulanWins θ T` means that Mulan has a strategy which guarantees
reaching an angle equal to `θ` after finitely many cuts.

A proof of this predicate is a finite strategy tree:

* `terminal` represents a position in which Mulan has already won;
* `cut` represents one cut chosen by Mulan, together with winning
  strategies for both triangles that Shan-Yu might retain.
-/
inductive MulanWins (θ : ℝ) : TriangleAngles → Prop
  | terminal {T : TriangleAngles} :
      HasTargetAngle θ T →
      MulanWins θ T
  | cut {T T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles} :
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ →
      MulanWins θ T₁ →
      MulanWins θ T₂ →
      MulanWins θ T

/--
Mulan can guarantee victory for the angle `θ`, regardless of
Shan-Yu's initial triangle.
-/
def MulanCanForceWin (θ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ T : TriangleAngles, MulanWins θ T

/--
For a triangle `T` and any `x` with `0 < x < T.c`, cutting from the vertex
opposite the side subtending angle `T.c` produces two triangles with angle
triples `(x, T.a, T.b + (T.c - x))` and `(T.c - x, T.b, T.a + x)`, and this
cut is a legal split of `T`.
-/
lemma exists_split_of_lt_c (T : TriangleAngles) (x : ℝ)
    (hx0 : 0 < x) (hxc : x < T.c) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      T₁.a = x ∧ T₁.b = T.a ∧ T₁.c = T.b + (T.c - x) ∧
      T₂.a = T.c - x ∧ T₂.b = T.b ∧ T₂.c = T.a + x := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  refine ⟨⟨x, T.a, T.b + (T.c - x), hx0, T.a_pos, by linarith [T.b_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ⟨T.c - x, T.b, T.a + x, by linarith, T.b_pos, by linarith [T.a_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  right; right
  exact ⟨x, hx0, hxc, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/--
For a triangle `T` and any `x` with `0 < x < T.a`, cutting from the vertex
opposite the side subtending angle `T.a` produces two triangles with angle
triples `(x, T.b, T.c + (T.a - x))` and `(T.a - x, T.c, T.b + x)`, and this
cut is a legal split of `T`.
-/
lemma exists_split_of_lt_a (T : TriangleAngles) (x : ℝ)
    (hx0 : 0 < x) (hxa : x < T.a) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      T₁.a = x ∧ T₁.b = T.b ∧ T₁.c = T.c + (T.a - x) ∧
      T₂.a = T.a - x ∧ T₂.b = T.c ∧ T₂.c = T.b + x := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  refine ⟨⟨x, T.b, T.c + (T.a - x), hx0, T.b_pos, by linarith [T.c_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ⟨T.a - x, T.c, T.b + x, by linarith, T.c_pos, by linarith [T.b_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  left
  exact ⟨x, hx0, hxa, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/--
For a triangle `T` and any `x` with `0 < x < T.b`, cutting from the vertex
opposite the side subtending angle `T.b` produces two triangles with angle
triples `(x, T.c, T.a + (T.b - x))` and `(T.b - x, T.a, T.c + x)`, and this
cut is a legal split of `T`.
-/
lemma exists_split_of_lt_b (T : TriangleAngles) (x : ℝ)
    (hx0 : 0 < x) (hxb : x < T.b) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      T₁.a = x ∧ T₁.b = T.c ∧ T₁.c = T.a + (T.b - x) ∧
      T₂.a = T.b - x ∧ T₂.b = T.a ∧ T₂.c = T.c + x := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  refine ⟨⟨x, T.c, T.a + (T.b - x), hx0, T.c_pos, by linarith [T.a_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ⟨T.b - x, T.a, T.c + x, by linarith, T.a_pos, by linarith [T.c_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  right; left
  exact ⟨x, hx0, hxb, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `2θ` (for `θ > 0`), then Mulan can
force a win in a single move: cutting off an angle of size `θ` from the
`2θ`-angle produces two triangles, each of which has an angle exactly `θ`,
regardless of which one Shan-Yu keeps.
-/
lemma mulanWins_of_double_angle (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (T : TriangleAngles)
    (h : T.a = 2 * θ ∨ T.b = 2 * θ ∨ T.c = 2 * θ) :
    MulanWins θ T := by
  rcases h with ha | hb | hc
  · obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_a T θ hθ (by linarith)
    exact MulanWins.cut hsplit (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl h1a))
      (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl (by rw [h2a]; linarith)))
  · obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_b T θ hθ (by linarith)
    exact MulanWins.cut hsplit (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl h1a))
      (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl (by rw [h2a]; linarith)))
  · obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_c T θ hθ (by linarith)
    exact MulanWins.cut hsplit (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl h1a))
      (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl (by rw [h2a]; linarith)))

/--
`HasMultipleAngle θ T` means that `T` has an angle equal to an integer
multiple of `θ`.
-/
def HasMultipleAngle (θ : ℝ) (T : TriangleAngles) : Prop :=
  (∃ k : ℤ, T.a = (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨ (∃ k : ℤ, T.b = (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨ (∃ k : ℤ, T.c = (k : ℝ) * θ)

/--
Any open interval `(a, a + γ)` of length `γ > θ > 0` contains an integer
multiple of `θ`.
-/
lemma exists_int_mul_mem_Ioo (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (a γ : ℝ) (hγ : θ < γ) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, a < (k : ℝ) * θ ∧ (k : ℝ) * θ < a + γ := by
  have hθ' : θ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hθ
  have heq : a / θ * θ = a := by field_simp [hθ']
  refine ⟨⌊a / θ⌋ + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h2 : a / θ < (⌊a / θ⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hlt := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h2 hθ
    rw [heq] at hlt
    push_cast
    linarith
  · have h1 : (⌊a / θ⌋ : ℝ) ≤ a / θ := Int.floor_le _
    have hle := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hθ.le
    rw [heq] at hle
    push_cast
    linarith

/--
If `π` is an integer multiple of `θ` and a triangle `T` has an angle strictly
greater than `θ`, then Mulan can make a cut such that both resulting
triangles have an angle equal to an integer multiple of `θ`.
-/
lemma exists_multiple_split (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (n : ℤ) (hn : Real.pi = (n : ℝ) * θ)
    (T : TriangleAngles) (h : θ < T.a ∨ θ < T.b ∨ θ < T.c) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧ HasMultipleAngle θ T₁ ∧ HasMultipleAngle θ T₂ := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  rcases h with ha | hb | hc
  · obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := exists_int_mul_mem_Ioo θ hθ T.b T.a ha
    have hx0 : 0 < (k : ℝ) * θ - T.b := by linarith
    have hxa : (k : ℝ) * θ - T.b < T.a := by linarith
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_a T ((k : ℝ) * θ - T.b) hx0 hxa
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨n - k, ?_⟩), Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨k, ?_⟩)⟩
    · rw [h1c]; push_cast; linear_combination hsum + hn
    · rw [h2c]; ring
  · obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := exists_int_mul_mem_Ioo θ hθ T.c T.b hb
    have hx0 : 0 < (k : ℝ) * θ - T.c := by linarith
    have hxb : (k : ℝ) * θ - T.c < T.b := by linarith
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_b T ((k : ℝ) * θ - T.c) hx0 hxb
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨n - k, ?_⟩), Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨k, ?_⟩)⟩
    · rw [h1c]; push_cast; linear_combination hsum + hn
    · rw [h2c]; ring
  · obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := exists_int_mul_mem_Ioo θ hθ T.a T.c hc
    have hx0 : 0 < (k : ℝ) * θ - T.a := by linarith
    have hxc : (k : ℝ) * θ - T.a < T.c := by linarith
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_c T ((k : ℝ) * θ - T.a) hx0 hxc
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨n - k, ?_⟩), Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨k, ?_⟩)⟩
    · rw [h1c]; push_cast; linear_combination hsum + hn
    · rw [h2c]; ring

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `m·θ` for an integer `m ≥ 3` (with `θ > 0`),
then Mulan can make a legal cut so that both resulting triangles have an angle equal
to a positive integer multiple of `θ` that is strictly less than `m·θ`.
-/
lemma exists_multiple_split_lt (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (T : TriangleAngles) (m : ℤ) (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    (h : T.a = (m:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.b = (m:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.c = (m:ℝ)*θ) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, 1 ≤ k ∧ k < m ∧ (T₁.a = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₁.b = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₁.c = (k:ℝ)*θ)) ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, 1 ≤ k ∧ k < m ∧ (T₂.a = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₂.b = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₂.c = (k:ℝ)*θ)) := by
  have hm_real : (3:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hpos : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
  rcases h with ha | hb | hc
  · have hxa : θ < T.a := by rw [ha]; nlinarith [mul_pos hθ hpos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_a T θ hθ hxa
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨1, le_refl 1, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩,
      ⟨m - 1, by omega, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [h1a]; push_cast; ring
    · rw [h2a, ha]; push_cast; ring
  · have hxb : θ < T.b := by rw [hb]; nlinarith [mul_pos hθ hpos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_b T θ hθ hxb
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨1, le_refl 1, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩,
      ⟨m - 1, by omega, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [h1a]; push_cast; ring
    · rw [h2a, hb]; push_cast; ring
  · have hxc : θ < T.c := by rw [hc]; nlinarith [mul_pos hθ hpos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_c T θ hθ hxc
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨1, le_refl 1, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩,
      ⟨m - 1, by omega, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [h1a]; push_cast; ring
    · rw [h2a, hc]; push_cast; ring

/--
If `θ = π/n` for some integer `n ≥ 2`, then from any triangle `T`, Mulan can
ensure that after at most one legal cut, the resulting triangle has an angle
equal to a positive integer multiple of `θ` (in fact, `T` itself may already
have such an angle).
-/
lemma base_step (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (n : ℤ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Real.pi = (n : ℝ) * θ)
    (T : TriangleAngles) :
    HasMultipleAngle θ T ∨
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧ HasMultipleAngle θ T₁ ∧ HasMultipleAngle θ T₂ := by
  by_cases hcase : θ < T.a ∨ θ < T.b ∨ θ < T.c
  · right
    exact exists_multiple_split θ hθ n hn T hcase
  · push_neg at hcase
    obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ := hcase
    have hsum := T.angle_sum
    have heq : (n : ℝ) * θ = T.a + T.b + T.c := by rw [← hn]; exact hsum.symm
    have h1 : (n : ℝ) ≤ 3 := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have hlt : (3 : ℝ) * θ < (n : ℝ) * θ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h hθ
      linarith [heq]
    have hn_le3 : n ≤ 3 := by exact_mod_cast h1
    have hn23 : n = 2 ∨ n = 3 := by omega
    rcases hn23 with hn2' | hn3'
    · subst hn2'
      have hpi2 : Real.pi = 2 * θ := by push_cast at hn; linarith
      by_cases hTa : T.a = θ
      · left; exact Or.inl ⟨1, by rw [hTa]; push_cast; ring⟩
      by_cases hTb : T.b = θ
      · left; exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨1, by rw [hTb]; push_cast; ring⟩)
      by_cases hTc : T.c = θ
      · left; exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨1, by rw [hTc]; push_cast; ring⟩)
      · right
        have ha' : T.a < θ := lt_of_le_of_ne ha hTa
        have hb' : T.b < θ := lt_of_le_of_ne hb hTb
        have hc' : T.c < θ := lt_of_le_of_ne hc hTc
        have hx0 : 0 < θ - T.a := by linarith
        have hxc : θ - T.a < T.c := by linarith
        obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
          exists_split_of_lt_c T (θ - T.a) hx0 hxc
        refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨1, ?_⟩), Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨1, ?_⟩)⟩
        · rw [h1c]; push_cast; linarith
        · rw [h2c]; push_cast; ring
    · subst hn3'
      have hpi3 : Real.pi = 3 * θ := by push_cast at hn; linarith
      have hTa : T.a = θ := by linarith
      left
      exact Or.inl ⟨1, by rw [hTa]; push_cast; ring⟩

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `m·θ` for an integer `m ≥ 3` (with `θ > 0`),
and no angle of `T` equals `k·θ` for any integer `k` with `1 ≤ k < m`, then Mulan can
make one legal cut so that, no matter which resulting triangle Shan-Yu keeps, the new
triangle has an angle equal to `n·θ` for some integer `n` with `1 ≤ n ≤ m - 1`.
-/
lemma reduction_step (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (T : TriangleAngles) (m : ℤ) (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    (hT : T.a = (m:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.b = (m:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.c = (m:ℝ)*θ)
    (hmin : ∀ k : ℤ, 1 ≤ k → k < m →
      ¬(T.a = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.b = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.c = (k:ℝ)*θ)) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      (∃ n : ℤ, 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ m - 1 ∧
        (T₁.a = (n:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₁.b = (n:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₁.c = (n:ℝ)*θ)) ∧
      (∃ n : ℤ, 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ m - 1 ∧
        (T₂.a = (n:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₂.b = (n:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₂.c = (n:ℝ)*θ)) := by
  obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨k1, hk1a, hk1b, hk1c⟩, ⟨k2, hk2a, hk2b, hk2c⟩⟩ :=
    exists_multiple_split_lt θ hθ T m hm hT
  exact ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨k1, hk1a, by omega, hk1c⟩, ⟨k2, hk2a, by omega, hk2c⟩⟩

/--
Auxiliary strong-induction lemma: if a triangle `T` has an angle equal to
`m·θ` for a positive integer `m`, Mulan can force a win. The extra natural
number `n` (with `m.toNat ≤ n`) serves as the strong-induction measure.
-/
lemma mulanWins_of_hasMultiple_aux (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ m : ℤ, m.toNat ≤ n → 1 ≤ m → ∀ T : TriangleAngles,
      (T.a = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.b = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.c = (m:ℝ) * θ) → MulanWins θ T := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro m hmn hm1 T h
    by_cases hm_eq1 : m = 1
    · subst hm_eq1
      apply MulanWins.terminal
      rcases h with ha | hb | hc
      · left; rw [ha]; push_cast; ring
      · right; left; rw [hb]; push_cast; ring
      · right; right; rw [hc]; push_cast; ring
    by_cases hm_eq2 : m = 2
    · subst hm_eq2
      exact mulanWins_of_double_angle θ hθ T (by
        rcases h with ha | hb | hc
        · left; rw [ha]; push_cast; ring
        · right; left; rw [hb]; push_cast; ring
        · right; right; rw [hc]; push_cast; ring)
    · have hm3 : 3 ≤ m := by omega
      obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨n1, hn1_1, hn1_lt, hn1_ang⟩, ⟨n2, hn2_1, hn2_lt, hn2_ang⟩⟩ :=
        exists_multiple_split_lt θ hθ T m hm3 h
      have e1 : (n1.toNat : ℤ) = n1 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
      have e2 : (n2.toNat : ℤ) = n2 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
      have e3 : (m.toNat : ℤ) = m := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
      have hlt1 : n1.toNat < m.toNat := by
        have h' : (n1.toNat : ℤ) < (m.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [e1, e3]; omega
        exact_mod_cast h'
      have hlt2 : n2.toNat < m.toNat := by
        have h' : (n2.toNat : ℤ) < (m.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [e2, e3]; omega
        exact_mod_cast h'
      have hn1n : n1.toNat < n := by omega
      have hn2n : n2.toNat < n := by omega
      exact MulanWins.cut hsplit
        (ih n1.toNat hn1n n1 (le_refl _) hn1_1 T₁ hn1_ang)
        (ih n2.toNat hn2n n2 (le_refl _) hn2_1 T₂ hn2_ang)

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `m·θ` for a positive integer `m`,
then Mulan can force a win.
-/
lemma mulanWins_of_hasMultiple (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (m : ℤ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (T : TriangleAngles)
    (h : T.a = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.b = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.c = (m:ℝ) * θ) :
    MulanWins θ T :=
  mulanWins_of_hasMultiple_aux θ hθ m.toNat m (le_refl _) hm T h

/--
If `π = n·θ` for an integer `n ≥ 2` (with `θ > 0`), then Mulan can guarantee
victory in finitely many steps starting from any triangle.
-/
lemma mulanWins_of_divides (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (n : ℤ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (hn : Real.pi = (n : ℝ) * θ) :
    MulanCanForceWin θ := by
  intro T
  have hkpos : ∀ (angle : ℝ), 0 < angle → ∀ k : ℤ, angle = (k:ℝ) * θ → 1 ≤ k := by
    intro angle hangle k hk
    by_contra hle
    push_neg at hle
    have hk0 : k ≤ 0 := by omega
    have hkr : (k:ℝ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk0

    · exact hβθ h2

  · exact hαθ h1

import Mathlib
open Set

/--
A nondegenerate triangle, represented only by its three angles.

The physical game depends only on the angles of the current triangle,
so side lengths and coordinates are omitted.
-/
structure TriangleAngles where
  a : ℝ
  b : ℝ
  c : ℝ
  a_pos : 0 < a
  b_pos : 0 < b
  c_pos : 0 < c
  angle_sum : a + b + c = Real.pi

/--
`LegalSplit T T₁ T₂` means that Mulan can cut the triangle `T`
so that the two possible remaining triangles are `T₁` and `T₂`.

The three disjuncts correspond to cutting from the vertices whose
angles are `T.a`, `T.b`, and `T.c`, respectively.
-/
def LegalSplit
    (T T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles) : Prop :=
  (
    ∃ x : ℝ,
      0 < x ∧ x < T.a ∧
        T₁.a = x ∧
        T₁.b = T.b ∧
        T₁.c = T.c + (T.a - x) ∧
        T₂.a = T.a - x ∧
        T₂.b = T.c ∧
        T₂.c = T.b + x
  ) ∨
  (
    ∃ x : ℝ,
      0 < x ∧ x < T.b ∧
        T₁.a = x ∧
        T₁.b = T.c ∧
        T₁.c = T.a + (T.b - x) ∧
        T₂.a = T.b - x ∧
        T₂.b = T.a ∧
        T₂.c = T.c + x
  ) ∨
  (
    ∃ x : ℝ,
      0 < x ∧ x < T.c ∧
        T₁.a = x ∧
        T₁.b = T.a ∧
        T₁.c = T.b + (T.c - x) ∧
        T₂.a = T.c - x ∧
        T₂.b = T.b ∧
        T₂.c = T.a + x
  )

/-- The current triangle already contains an angle equal to `θ`. -/
def HasTargetAngle (θ : ℝ) (T : TriangleAngles) : Prop :=
  T.a = θ ∨ T.b = θ ∨ T.c = θ

/--
`MulanWins θ T` means that Mulan has a strategy which guarantees
reaching an angle equal to `θ` after finitely many cuts.

A proof of this predicate is a finite strategy tree:

* `terminal` represents a position in which Mulan has already won;
* `cut` represents one cut chosen by Mulan, together with winning
  strategies for both triangles that Shan-Yu might retain.
-/
inductive MulanWins (θ : ℝ) : TriangleAngles → Prop
  | terminal {T : TriangleAngles} :
      HasTargetAngle θ T →
      MulanWins θ T
  | cut {T T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles} :
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ →
      MulanWins θ T₁ →
      MulanWins θ T₂ →
      MulanWins θ T

/--
Mulan can guarantee victory for the angle `θ`, regardless of
Shan-Yu's initial triangle.
-/
def MulanCanForceWin (θ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ T : TriangleAngles, MulanWins θ T

/--
For a triangle `T` and any `x` with `0 < x < T.c`, cutting from the vertex
opposite the side subtending angle `T.c` produces two triangles with angle
triples `(x, T.a, T.b + (T.c - x))` and `(T.c - x, T.b, T.a + x)`, and this
cut is a legal split of `T`.
-/
lemma exists_split_of_lt_c (T : TriangleAngles) (x : ℝ)
    (hx0 : 0 < x) (hxc : x < T.c) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      T₁.a = x ∧ T₁.b = T.a ∧ T₁.c = T.b + (T.c - x) ∧
      T₂.a = T.c - x ∧ T₂.b = T.b ∧ T₂.c = T.a + x := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  refine ⟨⟨x, T.a, T.b + (T.c - x), hx0, T.a_pos, by linarith [T.b_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ⟨T.c - x, T.b, T.a + x, by linarith, T.b_pos, by linarith [T.a_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  right; right
  exact ⟨x, hx0, hxc, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/--
For a triangle `T` and any `x` with `0 < x < T.a`, cutting from the vertex
opposite the side subtending angle `T.a` produces two triangles with angle
triples `(x, T.b, T.c + (T.a - x))` and `(T.a - x, T.c, T.b + x)`, and this
cut is a legal split of `T`.

lemma exists_split_of_lt_a (T : TriangleAngles) (x : ℝ)

    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,

  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  refine ⟨⟨x, T.b, T.c + (T.a - x), hx0, T.b_pos, by linarith [T.c_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ⟨T.a - x, T.c, T.b + x, by linarith, T.c_pos, by linarith [T.b_pos], by linarith⟩,

For a triangle `T` and any `x` with `0 < x < T.b`, cutting from the vertex
opposite the side subtending angle `T.b` produces two triangles with angle
triples `(x, T.c, T.a + (T.b - x))` and `(T.b - x, T.a, T.c + x)`, and this
cut is a legal split of `T`.

lemma exists_split_of_lt_b (T : TriangleAngles) (x : ℝ)
    (hx0 : 0 < x) (hxb : x < T.b) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,

      T₁.a = x ∧ T₁.b = T.c ∧ T₁.c = T.a + (T.b - x) ∧
      T₂.a = T.b - x ∧ T₂.b = T.a ∧ T₂.c = T.c + x := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  refine ⟨⟨x, T.c, T.a + (T.b - x), hx0, T.c_pos, by linarith [T.a_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ⟨T.b - x, T.a, T.c + x, by linarith, T.a_pos, by linarith [T.c_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  right; left
  exact ⟨x, hx0, hxb, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `2θ` (for `θ > 0`), then Mulan can
force a win in a single move: cutting off an angle of size `θ` from the

regardless of which one Shan-Yu keeps.
-/
lemma mulanWins_of_double_angle (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (T : TriangleAngles)
    (h : T.a = 2 * θ ∨ T.b = 2 * θ ∨ T.c = 2 * θ) :
    MulanWins θ T := by
  rcases h with ha | hb | hc
  · obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_a T θ hθ (by linarith)
    exact MulanWins.cut hsplit (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl h1a))
      (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl (by rw [h2a]; linarith)))
  · obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_b T θ hθ (by linarith)
    exact MulanWins.cut hsplit (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl h1a))
      (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl (by rw [h2a]; linarith)))
  · obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_c T θ hθ (by linarith)
    exact MulanWins.cut hsplit (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl h1a))
      (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl (by rw [h2a]; linarith)))

/--
`HasMultipleAngle θ T` means that `T` has an angle equal to an integer
multiple of `θ`.
-/
def HasMultipleAngle (θ : ℝ) (T : TriangleAngles) : Prop :=
  (∃ k : ℤ, T.a = (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨ (∃ k : ℤ, T.b = (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨ (∃ k : ℤ, T.c = (k : ℝ) * θ)

/--
Any open interval `(a, a + γ)` of length `γ > θ > 0` contains an integer
multiple of `θ`.
-/
lemma exists_int_mul_mem_Ioo (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (a γ : ℝ) (hγ : θ < γ) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, a < (k : ℝ) * θ ∧ (k : ℝ) * θ < a + γ := by
  have hθ' : θ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hθ
  have heq : a / θ * θ = a := by field_simp [hθ']
  refine ⟨⌊a / θ⌋ + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h2 : a / θ < (⌊a / θ⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hlt := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h2 hθ
    rw [heq] at hlt
    push_cast
    linarith
  · have h1 : (⌊a / θ⌋ : ℝ) ≤ a / θ := Int.floor_le _
    have hle := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hθ.le
    rw [heq] at hle
    push_cast
    linarith

/--
If `π` is an integer multiple of `θ` and a triangle `T` has an angle strictly
greater than `θ`, then Mulan can make a cut such that both resulting
triangles have an angle equal to an integer multiple of `θ`.
-/
lemma exists_multiple_split (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (n : ℤ) (hn : Real.pi = (n : ℝ) * θ)
    (T : TriangleAngles) (h : θ < T.a ∨ θ < T.b ∨ θ < T.c) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧ HasMultipleAngle θ T₁ ∧ HasMultipleAngle θ T₂ := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  rcases h with ha | hb | hc
  · obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := exists_int_mul_mem_Ioo θ hθ T.b T.a ha
    have hx0 : 0 < (k : ℝ) * θ - T.b := by linarith
    have hxa : (k : ℝ) * θ - T.b < T.a := by linarith
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_a T ((k : ℝ) * θ - T.b) hx0 hxa
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨n - k, ?_⟩), Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨k, ?_⟩)⟩
    · rw [h1c]; push_cast; linear_combination hsum + hn
    · rw [h2c]; ring
  · obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := exists_int_mul_mem_Ioo θ hθ T.c T.b hb
    have hx0 : 0 < (k : ℝ) * θ - T.c := by linarith
    have hxb : (k : ℝ) * θ - T.c < T.b := by linarith
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_b T ((k : ℝ) * θ - T.c) hx0 hxb
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨n - k, ?_⟩), Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨k, ?_⟩)⟩
    · rw [h1c]; push_cast; linear_combination hsum + hn
    · rw [h2c]; ring
  · obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := exists_int_mul_mem_Ioo θ hθ T.a T.c hc
    have hx0 : 0 < (k : ℝ) * θ - T.a := by linarith
    have hxc : (k : ℝ) * θ - T.a < T.c := by linarith
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_c T ((k : ℝ) * θ - T.a) hx0 hxc
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨n - k, ?_⟩), Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨k, ?_⟩)⟩
    · rw [h1c]; push_cast; linear_combination hsum + hn
    · rw [h2c]; ring

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `m·θ` for an integer `m ≥ 3` (with `θ > 0`),
then Mulan can make a legal cut so that both resulting triangles have an angle equal
to a positive integer multiple of `θ` that is strictly less than `m·θ`.
-/
lemma exists_multiple_split_lt (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (T : TriangleAngles) (m : ℤ) (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    (h : T.a = (m:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.b = (m:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.c = (m:ℝ)*θ) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, 1 ≤ k ∧ k < m ∧ (T₁.a = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₁.b = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₁.c = (k:ℝ)*θ)) ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, 1 ≤ k ∧ k < m ∧ (T₂.a = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₂.b = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₂.c = (k:ℝ)*θ)) := by
  have hm_real : (3:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hpos : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
  rcases h with ha | hb | hc
  · have hxa : θ < T.a := by rw [ha]; nlinarith [mul_pos hθ hpos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_a T θ hθ hxa
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨1, le_refl 1, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩,
      ⟨m - 1, by omega, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [h1a]; push_cast; ring
    · rw [h2a, ha]; push_cast; ring
  · have hxb : θ < T.b := by rw [hb]; nlinarith [mul_pos hθ hpos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_b T θ hθ hxb
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨1, le_refl 1, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩,
      ⟨m - 1, by omega, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [h1a]; push_cast; ring
    · rw [h2a, hb]; push_cast; ring
  · have hxc : θ < T.c := by rw [hc]; nlinarith [mul_pos hθ hpos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_c T θ hθ hxc
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨1, le_refl 1, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩,
      ⟨m - 1, by omega, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [h1a]; push_cast; ring
    · rw [h2a, hc]; push_cast; ring

/--
If `θ = π/n` for some integer `n ≥ 2`, then from any triangle `T`, Mulan can
ensure that after at most one legal cut, the resulting triangle has an angle
equal to a positive integer multiple of `θ` (in fact, `T` itself may already
have such an angle).
-/
lemma base_step (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (n : ℤ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Real.pi = (n : ℝ) * θ)
    (T : TriangleAngles) :
    HasMultipleAngle θ T ∨
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧ HasMultipleAngle θ T₁ ∧ HasMultipleAngle θ T₂ := by
  by_cases hcase : θ < T.a ∨ θ < T.b ∨ θ < T.c
  · right
    exact exists_multiple_split θ hθ n hn T hcase
  · push_neg at hcase
    obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ := hcase
    have hsum := T.angle_sum
    have heq : (n : ℝ) * θ = T.a + T.b + T.c := by rw [← hn]; exact hsum.symm
    have h1 : (n : ℝ) ≤ 3 := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have hlt : (3 : ℝ) * θ < (n : ℝ) * θ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h hθ
      linarith [heq]
    have hn_le3 : n ≤ 3 := by exact_mod_cast h1
    have hn23 : n = 2 ∨ n = 3 := by omega
    rcases hn23 with hn2' | hn3'
    · subst hn2'
      have hpi2 : Real.pi = 2 * θ := by push_cast at hn; linarith
      by_cases hTa : T.a = θ
      · left; exact Or.inl ⟨1, by rw [hTa]; push_cast; ring⟩
      by_cases hTb : T.b = θ
      · left; exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨1, by rw [hTb]; push_cast; ring⟩)
      by_cases hTc : T.c = θ
      · left; exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨1, by rw [hTc]; push_cast; ring⟩)
      · right
        have ha' : T.a < θ := lt_of_le_of_ne ha hTa
        have hb' : T.b < θ := lt_of_le_of_ne hb hTb
        have hc' : T.c < θ := lt_of_le_of_ne hc hTc
        have hx0 : 0 < θ - T.a := by linarith
        have hxc : θ - T.a < T.c := by linarith
        obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
          exists_split_of_lt_c T (θ - T.a) hx0 hxc
        refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨1, ?_⟩), Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨1, ?_⟩)⟩
        · rw [h1c]; push_cast; linarith
        · rw [h2c]; push_cast; ring
    · subst hn3'
      have hpi3 : Real.pi = 3 * θ := by push_cast at hn; linarith
      have hTa : T.a = θ := by linarith
      left
      exact Or.inl ⟨1, by rw [hTa]; push_cast; ring⟩

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `m·θ` for an integer `m ≥ 3` (with `θ > 0`),
and no angle of `T` equals `k·θ` for any integer `k` with `1 ≤ k < m`, then Mulan can
make one legal cut so that, no matter which resulting triangle Shan-Yu keeps, the new
triangle has an angle equal to `n·θ` for some integer `n` with `1 ≤ n ≤ m - 1`.
-/
lemma reduction_step (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (T : TriangleAngles) (m : ℤ) (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    (hT : T.a = (m:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.b = (m:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.c = (m:ℝ)*θ)
    (hmin : ∀ k : ℤ, 1 ≤ k → k < m →
      ¬(T.a = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.b = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.c = (k:ℝ)*θ)) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      (∃ n : ℤ, 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ m - 1 ∧
        (T₁.a = (n:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₁.b = (n:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₁.c = (n:ℝ)*θ)) ∧
      (∃ n : ℤ, 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ m - 1 ∧
        (T₂.a = (n:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₂.b = (n:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₂.c = (n:ℝ)*θ)) := by
  obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨k1, hk1a, hk1b, hk1c⟩, ⟨k2, hk2a, hk2b, hk2c⟩⟩ :=
    exists_multiple_split_lt θ hθ T m hm hT
  exact ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨k1, hk1a, by omega, hk1c⟩, ⟨k2, hk2a, by omega, hk2c⟩⟩

/--
Auxiliary strong-induction lemma: if a triangle `T` has an angle equal to
`m·θ` for a positive integer `m`, Mulan can force a win. The extra natural
number `n` (with `m.toNat ≤ n`) serves as the strong-induction measure.
-/
lemma mulanWins_of_hasMultiple_aux (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ m : ℤ, m.toNat ≤ n → 1 ≤ m → ∀ T : TriangleAngles,
      (T.a = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.b = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.c = (m:ℝ) * θ) → MulanWins θ T := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro m hmn hm1 T h
    by_cases hm_eq1 : m = 1
    · subst hm_eq1
      apply MulanWins.terminal
      rcases h with ha | hb | hc
      · left; rw [ha]; push_cast; ring
      · right; left; rw [hb]; push_cast; ring
      · right; right; rw [hc]; push_cast; ring
    by_cases hm_eq2 : m = 2
    · subst hm_eq2
      exact mulanWins_of_double_angle θ hθ T (by
        rcases h with ha | hb | hc
        · left; rw [ha]; push_cast; ring
        · right; left; rw [hb]; push_cast; ring
        · right; right; rw [hc]; push_cast; ring)
    · have hm3 : 3 ≤ m := by omega
      obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨n1, hn1_1, hn1_lt, hn1_ang⟩, ⟨n2, hn2_1, hn2_lt, hn2_ang⟩⟩ :=
        exists_multiple_split_lt θ hθ T m hm3 h
      have e1 : (n1.toNat : ℤ) = n1 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
      have e2 : (n2.toNat : ℤ) = n2 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
      have e3 : (m.toNat : ℤ) = m := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
      have hlt1 : n1.toNat < m.toNat := by
        have h' : (n1.toNat : ℤ) < (m.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [e1, e3]; omega
        exact_mod_cast h'
      have hlt2 : n2.toNat < m.toNat := by
        have h' : (n2.toNat : ℤ) < (m.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [e2, e3]; omega
        exact_mod_cast h'
      have hn1n : n1.toNat < n := by omega
      have hn2n : n2.toNat < n := by omega
      exact MulanWins.cut hsplit
        (ih n1.toNat hn1n n1 (le_refl _) hn1_1 T₁ hn1_ang)
        (ih n2.toNat hn2n n2 (le_refl _) hn2_1 T₂ hn2_ang)

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `m·θ` for a positive integer `m`,
then Mulan can force a win.
-/
lemma mulanWins_of_hasMultiple (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (m : ℤ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (T : TriangleAngles)
    (h : T.a = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.b = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.c = (m:ℝ) * θ) :
    MulanWins θ T :=
  mulanWins_of_hasMultiple_aux θ hθ m.toNat m (le_refl _) hm T h

/--
If `π = n·θ` for an integer `n ≥ 2` (with `θ > 0`), then Mulan can guarantee
victory in finitely many steps starting from any triangle.
-/
lemma mulanWins_of_divides (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (n : ℤ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (hn : Real.pi = (n : ℝ) * θ) :
    MulanCanForceWin θ := by
  intro T
  have hkpos : ∀ (angle : ℝ), 0 < angle → ∀ k : ℤ, angle = (k:ℝ) * θ → 1 ≤ k := by
    intro angle hangle k hk
    by_contra hle
    push_neg at hle
    have hk0 : k ≤ 0 := by omega
    have hkr : (k:ℝ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk0
    have hprod : (k:ℝ) * θ ≤ 0 * θ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkr hθ.le
    simp at hprod
    linarith [hk]
  rcases base_step θ hθ n hn2 hn T with hdirect | ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1, h2⟩
  · rcases hdirect with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
    · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T.a T.a_pos k hk) T (Or.inl hk)
    · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T.b T.b_pos k hk) T (Or.inr (Or.inl hk))
    · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T.c T.c_pos k hk) T (Or.inr (Or.inr hk))
  · apply MulanWins.cut hsplit
    · rcases h1 with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₁.a T₁.a_pos k hk) T₁ (Or.inl hk)
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₁.b T₁.b_pos k hk) T₁ (Or.inr (Or.inl hk))
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₁.c T₁.c_pos k hk) T₁ (Or.inr (Or.inr hk))
    · rcases h2 with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₂.a T₂.a_pos k hk) T₂ (Or.inl hk)
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₂.b T₂.b_pos k hk) T₂ (Or.inr (Or.inl hk))
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₂.c T₂.c_pos k hk) T₂ (Or.inr (Or.inr hk))

/--
Core algebraic fact underlying the one-move avoidance argument: if a single
cut splits an angle `γ` (with the other two angles `α`, `β` fixed) into `x`
and `γ - x`, producing triangles with angle sets `{x, α, β+(γ-x)}` and
`{γ-x, β, α+x}`, then it is impossible for both resulting triangles to
contain an angle equal to `θ`, provided `α ≠ θ`, `β ≠ θ`, `γ ≠ 2θ`, and
`θ ≠ π/2`.
-/
lemma no_double_target_of_split (θ : ℝ) (hθ90 : θ ≠ Real.pi / 2)
    (α β γ x : ℝ) (hsum : α + β + γ = Real.pi)
    (hαpos : 0 < α) (hβpos : 0 < β)
    (hαθ : α ≠ θ) (hβθ : β ≠ θ) (hγ2θ : γ ≠ 2 * θ) :
    ¬ ((x = θ ∨ α = θ ∨ β + (γ - x) = θ) ∧ (γ - x = θ ∨ β = θ ∨ α + x = θ)) := by
  rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1 | h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · exact hγ2θ (by linarith)
    · exact hβθ h2
    · linarith
  · exact hαθ h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · linarith
    · exact hβθ h2
    · exact hθ90 (by linarith)

/--
If `θ ≠ π/2` and none of the angles of `T` equal `θ` or `2θ`, then for any
legal cut of `T` into `T₁` and `T₂`, at least one of `T₁`, `T₂` has no angle
equal to `θ`. In other words, Shan-Yu can always avoid an immediate loss on
this move.
-/
lemma no_forcing_of_split (θ : ℝ) (hθ90 : θ ≠ Real.pi / 2)
    (T T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles) (hsplit : LegalSplit T T₁ T₂)
    (hTa : T.a ≠ θ) (hTb : T.b ≠ θ) (hTc : T.c ≠ θ)
    (hTa2 : T.a ≠ 2 * θ) (hTb2 : T.b ≠ 2 * θ) (hTc2 : T.c ≠ 2 * θ) :
    ¬ HasTargetAngle θ T₁ ∨ ¬ HasTargetAngle θ T₂ := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  rcases hsplit with
    ⟨x, hx0, hxa, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ |
    ⟨x, hx0, hxb, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ |
    ⟨x, hx0, hxc, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩
  · have key := no_double_target_of_split θ hθ90 T.b T.c T.a x (by linarith)
      T.b_pos T.c_pos hTb hTc hTa2
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key
  · have key := no_double_target_of_split θ hθ90 T.c T.a T.b x (by linarith)
      T.c_pos T.a_pos hTc hTa hTb2
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key
  · have key := no_double_target_of_split θ hθ90 T.a T.b T.c x hsum
      T.a_pos T.b_pos hTa hTb hTc2
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key

/--
Core algebraic fact underlying the two-move avoidance argument for the target
angle `2θ`: if a single cut splits an angle `γ` (with the other two angles
`α`, `β` fixed) into `x` and `γ - x`, producing triangles with angle sets
`{x, α, β+(γ-x)}` and `{γ-x, β, α+x}`, then it is impossible for both
resulting triangles to contain an angle equal to `2θ`, provided `α ≠ 2θ`,
`β ≠ 2θ`, `γ ≠ 4θ`, and `θ ≠ π/4`.
-/
lemma no_double_target_of_split_two_theta (θ : ℝ) (hθ45 : θ ≠ Real.pi / 4)
    (α β γ x : ℝ) (hsum : α + β + γ = Real.pi)
    (hαpos : 0 < α) (hβpos : 0 < β)
    (hα2θ : α ≠ 2 * θ) (hβ2θ : β ≠ 2 * θ) (hγ4θ : γ ≠ 4 * θ) :
    ¬ ((x = 2 * θ ∨ α = 2 * θ ∨ β + (γ - x) = 2 * θ) ∧
       (γ - x = 2 * θ ∨ β = 2 * θ ∨ α + x = 2 * θ)) := by
  rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1 | h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · exact hγ4θ (by linarith)
    · exact hβ2θ h2
    · linarith
  · exact hα2θ h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · linarith
    · exact hβ2θ h2
    · exact hθ45 (by linarith)

/--
Core algebraic fact underlying the general `m·θ`-avoidance argument: if a
single cut splits an angle `γ` (with the other two angles `α`, `β` fixed)
into `x` and `γ - x`, producing triangles with angle sets `{x, α, β+(γ-x)}`
and `{γ-x, β, α+x}`, then it is impossible for both resulting triangles to
contain an angle equal to `m·θ` for a fixed integer `m`, provided `α ≠ mθ`,
`β ≠ mθ`, `γ ≠ 2mθ`, and `mθ ≠ π/2`.
-/
lemma no_double_target_of_split_multiple (θ : ℝ) (m : ℤ)
    (hmθ90 : (m : ℝ) * θ ≠ Real.pi / 2)
    (α β γ x : ℝ) (hsum : α + β + γ = Real.pi)
    (hαpos : 0 < α) (hβpos : 0 < β)
    (hαmθ : α ≠ (m : ℝ) * θ) (hβmθ : β ≠ (m : ℝ) * θ)
    (hγ2mθ : γ ≠ 2 * ((m : ℝ) * θ)) :
    ¬ ((x = (m : ℝ) * θ ∨ α = (m : ℝ) * θ ∨ β + (γ - x) = (m : ℝ) * θ) ∧
       (γ - x = (m : ℝ) * θ ∨ β = (m : ℝ) * θ ∨ α + x = (m : ℝ) * θ)) := by
  rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1 | h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · exact hγ2mθ (by linarith)
    · exact hβmθ h2
    · linarith
  · exact hαmθ h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · linarith
    · exact hβmθ h2
    · exact hmθ90 (by linarith)

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `2mθ` for a positive integer `m`
(with `θ > 0`), then Mulan can make a single legal cut so that both
resulting triangles have an angle equal to `mθ`.
-/
lemma exists_split_even_multiple (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (m : ℤ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (T : TriangleAngles)
    (h : T.a = 2 * (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.b = 2 * (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.c = 2 * (m:ℝ) * θ) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      (T₁.a = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T₁.b = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T₁.c = (m:ℝ) * θ) ∧
      (T₂.a = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T₂.b = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T₂.c = (m:ℝ) * θ) := by
  have hm_real : (1:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hm_pos : 0 < (m:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hmθ_pos : 0 < (m:ℝ) * θ := mul_pos hm_pos hθ
  rcases h with ha | hb | hc
  · have hxa : (m:ℝ) * θ < T.a := by rw [ha]; nlinarith [hmθ_pos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_a T ((m:ℝ) * θ) hmθ_pos hxa
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inl h1a, Or.inl ?_⟩
    rw [h2a, ha]; ring
  · have hxb : (m:ℝ) * θ < T.b := by rw [hb]; nlinarith [hmθ_pos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_b T ((m:ℝ) * θ) hmθ_pos hxb
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inl h1a, Or.inl ?_⟩
    rw [h2a, hb]; ring
  · have hxc : (m:ℝ) * θ < T.c := by rw [hc]; nlinarith [hmθ_pos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_c T ((m:ℝ) * θ) hmθ_pos hxc
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inl h1a, Or.inl ?_⟩
    rw [h2a, hc]; ring

/--
If `θ` does not divide `π` (no integer multiple of `θ` equals `π`), and none of the
angles `α`, `β`, `γ` of a triangle (with `α + β + γ = π`) is an integer multiple of `θ`,
then for any cut splitting `γ` into `x` and `γ - x`, it is impossible for both resulting
triangles `{x, α, β+(γ-x)}` and `{γ-x, β, α+x}` to each contain an angle equal to some
(possibly different) integer multiple of `θ`.
-/
lemma no_double_multiple_of_split (θ : ℝ)
    (hθnd : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, Real.pi = (k : ℝ) * θ)
    (α β γ x : ℝ) (hsum : α + β + γ = Real.pi)
    (hα : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, α = (k : ℝ) * θ)
    (hβ : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, β = (k : ℝ) * θ)
    (hγ : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, γ = (k : ℝ) * θ) :
    ¬ (((∃ k : ℤ, x = (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨ (∃ k : ℤ, α = (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨
          (∃ k : ℤ, β + (γ - x) = (k : ℝ) * θ)) ∧
       ((∃ k : ℤ, γ - x = (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨ (∃ k : ℤ, β = (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨
          (∃ k : ℤ, α + x = (k : ℝ) * θ))) := by
  rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rcases h1 with ⟨k1, hk1⟩ | hα' | ⟨k1, hk1⟩
  · rcases h2 with ⟨k2, hk2⟩ | hβ' | ⟨k2, hk2⟩
    · exact hγ ⟨k1 + k2, by push_cast; linear_combination hk1 + hk2⟩
    · exact hβ hβ'
    · exact hα ⟨k2 - k1, by push_cast; linear_combination hk2 - hk1⟩
  · exact hα hα'
  · rcases h2 with ⟨k2, hk2⟩ | hβ' | ⟨k2, hk2⟩
    · exact hβ ⟨k1 - k2, by push_cast; linear_combination hk1 - hk2⟩
    · exact hβ hβ'
    · exact hθnd ⟨k1 + k2, by push_cast; linear_combination hk1 + hk2 - hsum⟩

/--
Invariant preserved under Shan-Yu's choice: if `θ` does not divide `π` (no integer
multiple of `θ` equals `π`), and a triangle `T` has no angle equal to an integer
multiple of `θ`, then for any legal cut of `T` into `T₁` and `T₂`, at least one of
`T₁`, `T₂` also has no angle equal to an integer multiple of `θ`. Thus Shan-Yu can
always keep the invariant "no angle is an integer multiple of `θ`" alive.
-/
lemma no_forcing_of_split_multiple (θ : ℝ)
    (hθnd : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, Real.pi = (k : ℝ) * θ)
    (T T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles) (hsplit : LegalSplit T T₁ T₂)
    (hTa : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, T.a = (k : ℝ) * θ)
    (hTb : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, T.b = (k : ℝ) * θ)
    (hTc : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, T.c = (k : ℝ) * θ) :
    ¬ HasMultipleAngle θ T₁ ∨ ¬ HasMultipleAngle θ T₂ := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  rcases hsplit with
    ⟨x, hx0, hxa, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ |
    ⟨x, hx0, hxb, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ |
    ⟨x, hx0, hxc, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩
  · have key := no_double_multiple_of_split θ hθnd T.b T.c T.a x (by linarith)
      hTb hTc hTa
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasMultipleAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasMultipleAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key
  · have key := no_double_multiple_of_split θ hθnd T.c T.a T.b x (by linarith)
      hTc hTa hTb
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasMultipleAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasMultipleAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key
  · have key := no_double_multiple_of_split θ hθnd T.a T.b T.c x hsum
      hTa hTb hTc
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasMultipleAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasMultipleAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key

import Mathlib
open Set

/--
A nondegenerate triangle, represented only by its three angles.

The physical game depends only on the angles of the current triangle,
so side lengths and coordinates are omitted.
-/
structure TriangleAngles where
  a : ℝ
  b : ℝ
  c : ℝ
  a_pos : 0 < a
  b_pos : 0 < b
  c_pos : 0 < c
  angle_sum : a + b + c = Real.pi

/--
`LegalSplit T T₁ T₂` means that Mulan can cut the triangle `T`
so that the two possible remaining triangles are `T₁` and `T₂`.

The three disjuncts correspond to cutting from the vertices whose
angles are `T.a`, `T.b`, and `T.c`, respectively.
-/
def LegalSplit
    (T T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles) : Prop :=
  (
    ∃ x : ℝ,
      0 < x ∧ x < T.a ∧
        T₁.a = x ∧
        T₁.b = T.b ∧
        T₁.c = T.c + (T.a - x) ∧
        T₂.a = T.a - x ∧
        T₂.b = T.c ∧
        T₂.c = T.b + x
  ) ∨
  (
    ∃ x : ℝ,
      0 < x ∧ x < T.b ∧
        T₁.a = x ∧
        T₁.b = T.c ∧
        T₁.c = T.a + (T.b - x) ∧
        T₂.a = T.b - x ∧
        T₂.b = T.a ∧
        T₂.c = T.c + x
  ) ∨
  (
    ∃ x : ℝ,
      0 < x ∧ x < T.c ∧
        T₁.a = x ∧
        T₁.b = T.a ∧
        T₁.c = T.b + (T.c - x) ∧
        T₂.a = T.c - x ∧
        T₂.b = T.b ∧
        T₂.c = T.a + x
  )

/-- The current triangle already contains an angle equal to `θ`. -/
def HasTargetAngle (θ : ℝ) (T : TriangleAngles) : Prop :=
  T.a = θ ∨ T.b = θ ∨ T.c = θ

/--
`MulanWins θ T` means that Mulan has a strategy which guarantees
reaching an angle equal to `θ` after finitely many cuts.

A proof of this predicate is a finite strategy tree:

* `terminal` represents a position in which Mulan has already won;
* `cut` represents one cut chosen by Mulan, together with winning
  strategies for both triangles that Shan-Yu might retain.
-/
inductive MulanWins (θ : ℝ) : TriangleAngles → Prop
  | terminal {T : TriangleAngles} :
      HasTargetAngle θ T →
      MulanWins θ T
  | cut {T T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles} :
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ →
      MulanWins θ T₁ →
      MulanWins θ T₂ →
      MulanWins θ T

/--
Mulan can guarantee victory for the angle `θ`, regardless of
Shan-Yu's initial triangle.
-/
def MulanCanForceWin (θ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ T : TriangleAngles, MulanWins θ T

/--
For a triangle `T` and any `x` with `0 < x < T.c`, cutting from the vertex
opposite the side subtending angle `T.c` produces two triangles with angle
triples `(x, T.a, T.b + (T.c - x))` and `(T.c - x, T.b, T.a + x)`, and this
cut is a legal split of `T`.
-/
lemma exists_split_of_lt_c (T : TriangleAngles) (x : ℝ)
    (hx0 : 0 < x) (hxc : x < T.c) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      T₁.a = x ∧ T₁.b = T.a ∧ T₁.c = T.b + (T.c - x) ∧
      T₂.a = T.c - x ∧ T₂.b = T.b ∧ T₂.c = T.a + x := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  refine ⟨⟨x, T.a, T.b + (T.c - x), hx0, T.a_pos, by linarith [T.b_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ⟨T.c - x, T.b, T.a + x, by linarith, T.b_pos, by linarith [T.a_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  right; right
  exact ⟨x, hx0, hxc, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/--
For a triangle `T` and any `x` with `0 < x < T.a`, cutting from the vertex
opposite the side subtending angle `T.a` produces two triangles with angle
triples `(x, T.b, T.c + (T.a - x))` and `(T.a - x, T.c, T.b + x)`, and this
cut is a legal split of `T`.
-/
lemma exists_split_of_lt_a (T : TriangleAngles) (x : ℝ)
    (hx0 : 0 < x) (hxa : x < T.a) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      T₁.a = x ∧ T₁.b = T.b ∧ T₁.c = T.c + (T.a - x) ∧
      T₂.a = T.a - x ∧ T₂.b = T.c ∧ T₂.c = T.b + x := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  refine ⟨⟨x, T.b, T.c + (T.a - x), hx0, T.b_pos, by linarith [T.c_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ⟨T.a - x, T.c, T.b + x, by linarith, T.c_pos, by linarith [T.b_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  left
  exact ⟨x, hx0, hxa, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/--
For a triangle `T` and any `x` with `0 < x < T.b`, cutting from the vertex
opposite the side subtending angle `T.b` produces two triangles with angle
triples `(x, T.c, T.a + (T.b - x))` and `(T.b - x, T.a, T.c + x)`, and this
cut is a legal split of `T`.
-/
lemma exists_split_of_lt_b (T : TriangleAngles) (x : ℝ)
    (hx0 : 0 < x) (hxb : x < T.b) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      T₁.a = x ∧ T₁.b = T.c ∧ T₁.c = T.a + (T.b - x) ∧
      T₂.a = T.b - x ∧ T₂.b = T.a ∧ T₂.c = T.c + x := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  refine ⟨⟨x, T.c, T.a + (T.b - x), hx0, T.c_pos, by linarith [T.a_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ⟨T.b - x, T.a, T.c + x, by linarith, T.a_pos, by linarith [T.c_pos], by linarith⟩,
          ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  right; left
  exact ⟨x, hx0, hxb, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `2θ` (for `θ > 0`), then Mulan can
force a win in a single move: cutting off an angle of size `θ` from the
`2θ`-angle produces two triangles, each of which has an angle exactly `θ`,
regardless of which one Shan-Yu keeps.
-/
lemma mulanWins_of_double_angle (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (T : TriangleAngles)
    (h : T.a = 2 * θ ∨ T.b = 2 * θ ∨ T.c = 2 * θ) :
    MulanWins θ T := by
  rcases h with ha | hb | hc
  · obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_a T θ hθ (by linarith)
    exact MulanWins.cut hsplit (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl h1a))
      (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl (by rw [h2a]; linarith)))
  · obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_b T θ hθ (by linarith)
    exact MulanWins.cut hsplit (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl h1a))
      (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl (by rw [h2a]; linarith)))
  · obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_c T θ hθ (by linarith)
    exact MulanWins.cut hsplit (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl h1a))
      (MulanWins.terminal (Or.inl (by rw [h2a]; linarith)))

/--
`HasMultipleAngle θ T` means that `T` has an angle equal to an integer
multiple of `θ`.
-/
def HasMultipleAngle (θ : ℝ) (T : TriangleAngles) : Prop :=
  (∃ k : ℤ, T.a = (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨ (∃ k : ℤ, T.b = (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨ (∃ k : ℤ, T.c = (k : ℝ) * θ)

/--
Any open interval `(a, a + γ)` of length `γ > θ > 0` contains an integer
multiple of `θ`.
-/
lemma exists_int_mul_mem_Ioo (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (a γ : ℝ) (hγ : θ < γ) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, a < (k : ℝ) * θ ∧ (k : ℝ) * θ < a + γ := by
  have hθ' : θ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hθ
  have heq : a / θ * θ = a := by field_simp [hθ']
  refine ⟨⌊a / θ⌋ + 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h2 : a / θ < (⌊a / θ⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hlt := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h2 hθ
    rw [heq] at hlt
    push_cast
    linarith
  · have h1 : (⌊a / θ⌋ : ℝ) ≤ a / θ := Int.floor_le _
    have hle := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hθ.le
    rw [heq] at hle
    push_cast
    linarith

/--
If `π` is an integer multiple of `θ` and a triangle `T` has an angle strictly
greater than `θ`, then Mulan can make a cut such that both resulting
triangles have an angle equal to an integer multiple of `θ`.
-/
lemma exists_multiple_split (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (n : ℤ) (hn : Real.pi = (n : ℝ) * θ)
    (T : TriangleAngles) (h : θ < T.a ∨ θ < T.b ∨ θ < T.c) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧ HasMultipleAngle θ T₁ ∧ HasMultipleAngle θ T₂ := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  rcases h with ha | hb | hc
  · obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := exists_int_mul_mem_Ioo θ hθ T.b T.a ha
    have hx0 : 0 < (k : ℝ) * θ - T.b := by linarith
    have hxa : (k : ℝ) * θ - T.b < T.a := by linarith
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_a T ((k : ℝ) * θ - T.b) hx0 hxa
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨n - k, ?_⟩), Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨k, ?_⟩)⟩
    · rw [h1c]; push_cast; linear_combination hsum + hn
    · rw [h2c]; ring
  · obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := exists_int_mul_mem_Ioo θ hθ T.c T.b hb
    have hx0 : 0 < (k : ℝ) * θ - T.c := by linarith
    have hxb : (k : ℝ) * θ - T.c < T.b := by linarith
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_b T ((k : ℝ) * θ - T.c) hx0 hxb
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨n - k, ?_⟩), Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨k, ?_⟩)⟩
    · rw [h1c]; push_cast; linear_combination hsum + hn
    · rw [h2c]; ring
  · obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := exists_int_mul_mem_Ioo θ hθ T.a T.c hc
    have hx0 : 0 < (k : ℝ) * θ - T.a := by linarith
    have hxc : (k : ℝ) * θ - T.a < T.c := by linarith
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_c T ((k : ℝ) * θ - T.a) hx0 hxc
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨n - k, ?_⟩), Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨k, ?_⟩)⟩
    · rw [h1c]; push_cast; linear_combination hsum + hn
    · rw [h2c]; ring

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `m·θ` for an integer `m ≥ 3` (with `θ > 0`),
then Mulan can make a legal cut so that both resulting triangles have an angle equal
to a positive integer multiple of `θ` that is strictly less than `m·θ`.
-/
lemma exists_multiple_split_lt (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (T : TriangleAngles) (m : ℤ) (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    (h : T.a = (m:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.b = (m:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.c = (m:ℝ)*θ) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, 1 ≤ k ∧ k < m ∧ (T₁.a = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₁.b = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₁.c = (k:ℝ)*θ)) ∧
      (∃ k : ℤ, 1 ≤ k ∧ k < m ∧ (T₂.a = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₂.b = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₂.c = (k:ℝ)*θ)) := by
  have hm_real : (3:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hpos : (0:ℝ) < (m:ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
  rcases h with ha | hb | hc
  · have hxa : θ < T.a := by rw [ha]; nlinarith [mul_pos hθ hpos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_a T θ hθ hxa
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨1, le_refl 1, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩,
      ⟨m - 1, by omega, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [h1a]; push_cast; ring
    · rw [h2a, ha]; push_cast; ring
  · have hxb : θ < T.b := by rw [hb]; nlinarith [mul_pos hθ hpos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_b T θ hθ hxb
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨1, le_refl 1, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩,
      ⟨m - 1, by omega, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [h1a]; push_cast; ring
    · rw [h2a, hb]; push_cast; ring
  · have hxc : θ < T.c := by rw [hc]; nlinarith [mul_pos hθ hpos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_c T θ hθ hxc
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨1, le_refl 1, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩,
      ⟨m - 1, by omega, by omega, Or.inl ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [h1a]; push_cast; ring
    · rw [h2a, hc]; push_cast; ring

/--
If `θ = π/n` for some integer `n ≥ 2`, then from any triangle `T`, Mulan can
ensure that after at most one legal cut, the resulting triangle has an angle
equal to a positive integer multiple of `θ` (in fact, `T` itself may already
have such an angle).
-/
lemma base_step (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (n : ℤ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n) (hn : Real.pi = (n : ℝ) * θ)
    (T : TriangleAngles) :
    HasMultipleAngle θ T ∨
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧ HasMultipleAngle θ T₁ ∧ HasMultipleAngle θ T₂ := by
  by_cases hcase : θ < T.a ∨ θ < T.b ∨ θ < T.c
  · right
    exact exists_multiple_split θ hθ n hn T hcase
  · push_neg at hcase
    obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ := hcase
    have hsum := T.angle_sum
    have heq : (n : ℝ) * θ = T.a + T.b + T.c := by rw [← hn]; exact hsum.symm
    have h1 : (n : ℝ) ≤ 3 := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have hlt : (3 : ℝ) * θ < (n : ℝ) * θ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h hθ
      linarith [heq]
    have hn_le3 : n ≤ 3 := by exact_mod_cast h1
    have hn23 : n = 2 ∨ n = 3 := by omega
    rcases hn23 with hn2' | hn3'
    · subst hn2'
      have hpi2 : Real.pi = 2 * θ := by push_cast at hn; linarith
      by_cases hTa : T.a = θ
      · left; exact Or.inl ⟨1, by rw [hTa]; push_cast; ring⟩
      by_cases hTb : T.b = θ
      · left; exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨1, by rw [hTb]; push_cast; ring⟩)
      by_cases hTc : T.c = θ
      · left; exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨1, by rw [hTc]; push_cast; ring⟩)
      · right
        have ha' : T.a < θ := lt_of_le_of_ne ha hTa
        have hb' : T.b < θ := lt_of_le_of_ne hb hTb
        have hc' : T.c < θ := lt_of_le_of_ne hc hTc
        have hx0 : 0 < θ - T.a := by linarith
        have hxc : θ - T.a < T.c := by linarith
        obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
          exists_split_of_lt_c T (θ - T.a) hx0 hxc
        refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨1, ?_⟩), Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨1, ?_⟩)⟩
        · rw [h1c]; push_cast; linarith
        · rw [h2c]; push_cast; ring
    · subst hn3'
      have hpi3 : Real.pi = 3 * θ := by push_cast at hn; linarith
      have hTa : T.a = θ := by linarith
      left
      exact Or.inl ⟨1, by rw [hTa]; push_cast; ring⟩

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `m·θ` for an integer `m ≥ 3` (with `θ > 0`),
and no angle of `T` equals `k·θ` for any integer `k` with `1 ≤ k < m`, then Mulan can
make one legal cut so that, no matter which resulting triangle Shan-Yu keeps, the new
triangle has an angle equal to `n·θ` for some integer `n` with `1 ≤ n ≤ m - 1`.
-/
lemma reduction_step (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (T : TriangleAngles) (m : ℤ) (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    (hT : T.a = (m:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.b = (m:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.c = (m:ℝ)*θ)
    (hmin : ∀ k : ℤ, 1 ≤ k → k < m →
      ¬(T.a = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.b = (k:ℝ)*θ ∨ T.c = (k:ℝ)*θ)) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      (∃ n : ℤ, 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ m - 1 ∧
        (T₁.a = (n:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₁.b = (n:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₁.c = (n:ℝ)*θ)) ∧
      (∃ n : ℤ, 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ m - 1 ∧
        (T₂.a = (n:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₂.b = (n:ℝ)*θ ∨ T₂.c = (n:ℝ)*θ)) := by
  obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨k1, hk1a, hk1b, hk1c⟩, ⟨k2, hk2a, hk2b, hk2c⟩⟩ :=
    exists_multiple_split_lt θ hθ T m hm hT
  exact ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨k1, hk1a, by omega, hk1c⟩, ⟨k2, hk2a, by omega, hk2c⟩⟩

/--
Auxiliary strong-induction lemma: if a triangle `T` has an angle equal to
`m·θ` for a positive integer `m`, Mulan can force a win. The extra natural
number `n` (with `m.toNat ≤ n`) serves as the strong-induction measure.
-/
lemma mulanWins_of_hasMultiple_aux (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ m : ℤ, m.toNat ≤ n → 1 ≤ m → ∀ T : TriangleAngles,
      (T.a = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.b = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.c = (m:ℝ) * θ) → MulanWins θ T := by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro m hmn hm1 T h
    by_cases hm_eq1 : m = 1
    · subst hm_eq1
      apply MulanWins.terminal
      rcases h with ha | hb | hc
      · left; rw [ha]; push_cast; ring
      · right; left; rw [hb]; push_cast; ring
      · right; right; rw [hc]; push_cast; ring
    by_cases hm_eq2 : m = 2
    · subst hm_eq2
      exact mulanWins_of_double_angle θ hθ T (by
        rcases h with ha | hb | hc
        · left; rw [ha]; push_cast; ring
        · right; left; rw [hb]; push_cast; ring
        · right; right; rw [hc]; push_cast; ring)
    · have hm3 : 3 ≤ m := by omega
      obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, ⟨n1, hn1_1, hn1_lt, hn1_ang⟩, ⟨n2, hn2_1, hn2_lt, hn2_ang⟩⟩ :=
        exists_multiple_split_lt θ hθ T m hm3 h
      have e1 : (n1.toNat : ℤ) = n1 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
      have e2 : (n2.toNat : ℤ) = n2 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
      have e3 : (m.toNat : ℤ) = m := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)
      have hlt1 : n1.toNat < m.toNat := by
        have h' : (n1.toNat : ℤ) < (m.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [e1, e3]; omega
        exact_mod_cast h'
      have hlt2 : n2.toNat < m.toNat := by
        have h' : (n2.toNat : ℤ) < (m.toNat : ℤ) := by rw [e2, e3]; omega
        exact_mod_cast h'
      have hn1n : n1.toNat < n := by omega
      have hn2n : n2.toNat < n := by omega
      exact MulanWins.cut hsplit
        (ih n1.toNat hn1n n1 (le_refl _) hn1_1 T₁ hn1_ang)
        (ih n2.toNat hn2n n2 (le_refl _) hn2_1 T₂ hn2_ang)

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `m·θ` for a positive integer `m`,
then Mulan can force a win.
-/
lemma mulanWins_of_hasMultiple (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (m : ℤ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (T : TriangleAngles)
    (h : T.a = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.b = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.c = (m:ℝ) * θ) :
    MulanWins θ T :=
  mulanWins_of_hasMultiple_aux θ hθ m.toNat m (le_refl _) hm T h

/--
If `π = n·θ` for an integer `n ≥ 2` (with `θ > 0`), then Mulan can guarantee
victory in finitely many steps starting from any triangle.
-/
lemma mulanWins_of_divides (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (n : ℤ) (hn2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (hn : Real.pi = (n : ℝ) * θ) :
    MulanCanForceWin θ := by
  intro T
  have hkpos : ∀ (angle : ℝ), 0 < angle → ∀ k : ℤ, angle = (k:ℝ) * θ → 1 ≤ k := by
    intro angle hangle k hk
    by_contra hle
    push_neg at hle
    have hk0 : k ≤ 0 := by omega
    have hkr : (k:ℝ) ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk0
    have hprod : (k:ℝ) * θ ≤ 0 * θ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkr hθ.le
    simp at hprod
    linarith [hk]
  rcases base_step θ hθ n hn2 hn T with hdirect | ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1, h2⟩
  · rcases hdirect with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
    · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T.a T.a_pos k hk) T (Or.inl hk)
    · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T.b T.b_pos k hk) T (Or.inr (Or.inl hk))
    · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T.c T.c_pos k hk) T (Or.inr (Or.inr hk))
  · apply MulanWins.cut hsplit
    · rcases h1 with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₁.a T₁.a_pos k hk) T₁ (Or.inl hk)
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₁.b T₁.b_pos k hk) T₁ (Or.inr (Or.inl hk))
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₁.c T₁.c_pos k hk) T₁ (Or.inr (Or.inr hk))
    · rcases h2 with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₂.a T₂.a_pos k hk) T₂ (Or.inl hk)
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₂.b T₂.b_pos k hk) T₂ (Or.inr (Or.inl hk))
      · exact mulanWins_of_hasMultiple θ hθ k (hkpos T₂.c T₂.c_pos k hk) T₂ (Or.inr (Or.inr hk))

/--
Core algebraic fact underlying the one-move avoidance argument: if a single
cut splits an angle `γ` (with the other two angles `α`, `β` fixed) into `x`
and `γ - x`, producing triangles with angle sets `{x, α, β+(γ-x)}` and
`{γ-x, β, α+x}`, then it is impossible for both resulting triangles to
contain an angle equal to `θ`, provided `α ≠ θ`, `β ≠ θ`, `γ ≠ 2θ`, and
`θ ≠ π/2`.
-/
lemma no_double_target_of_split (θ : ℝ) (hθ90 : θ ≠ Real.pi / 2)
    (α β γ x : ℝ) (hsum : α + β + γ = Real.pi)
    (hαpos : 0 < α) (hβpos : 0 < β)
    (hαθ : α ≠ θ) (hβθ : β ≠ θ) (hγ2θ : γ ≠ 2 * θ) :
    ¬ ((x = θ ∨ α = θ ∨ β + (γ - x) = θ) ∧ (γ - x = θ ∨ β = θ ∨ α + x = θ)) := by
  rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1 | h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · exact hγ2θ (by linarith)
    · exact hβθ h2
    · linarith
  · exact hαθ h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · linarith
    · exact hβθ h2
    · exact hθ90 (by linarith)

/--
If `θ ≠ π/2` and none of the angles of `T` equal `θ` or `2θ`, then for any
legal cut of `T` into `T₁` and `T₂`, at least one of `T₁`, `T₂` has no angle
equal to `θ`. In other words, Shan-Yu can always avoid an immediate loss on
this move.
-/
lemma no_forcing_of_split (θ : ℝ) (hθ90 : θ ≠ Real.pi / 2)
    (T T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles) (hsplit : LegalSplit T T₁ T₂)
    (hTa : T.a ≠ θ) (hTb : T.b ≠ θ) (hTc : T.c ≠ θ)
    (hTa2 : T.a ≠ 2 * θ) (hTb2 : T.b ≠ 2 * θ) (hTc2 : T.c ≠ 2 * θ) :
    ¬ HasTargetAngle θ T₁ ∨ ¬ HasTargetAngle θ T₂ := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  rcases hsplit with
    ⟨x, hx0, hxa, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ |
    ⟨x, hx0, hxb, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ |
    ⟨x, hx0, hxc, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩
  · have key := no_double_target_of_split θ hθ90 T.b T.c T.a x (by linarith)
      T.b_pos T.c_pos hTb hTc hTa2
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key
  · have key := no_double_target_of_split θ hθ90 T.c T.a T.b x (by linarith)
      T.c_pos T.a_pos hTc hTa hTb2
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key
  · have key := no_double_target_of_split θ hθ90 T.a T.b T.c x hsum
      T.a_pos T.b_pos hTa hTb hTc2
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasTargetAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key

/--
Core algebraic fact underlying the two-move avoidance argument for the target
angle `2θ`: if a single cut splits an angle `γ` (with the other two angles
`α`, `β` fixed) into `x` and `γ - x`, producing triangles with angle sets
`{x, α, β+(γ-x)}` and `{γ-x, β, α+x}`, then it is impossible for both
resulting triangles to contain an angle equal to `2θ`, provided `α ≠ 2θ`,
`β ≠ 2θ`, `γ ≠ 4θ`, and `θ ≠ π/4`.
-/
lemma no_double_target_of_split_two_theta (θ : ℝ) (hθ45 : θ ≠ Real.pi / 4)
    (α β γ x : ℝ) (hsum : α + β + γ = Real.pi)
    (hαpos : 0 < α) (hβpos : 0 < β)
    (hα2θ : α ≠ 2 * θ) (hβ2θ : β ≠ 2 * θ) (hγ4θ : γ ≠ 4 * θ) :
    ¬ ((x = 2 * θ ∨ α = 2 * θ ∨ β + (γ - x) = 2 * θ) ∧
       (γ - x = 2 * θ ∨ β = 2 * θ ∨ α + x = 2 * θ)) := by
  rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1 | h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · exact hγ4θ (by linarith)
    · exact hβ2θ h2
    · linarith
  · exact hα2θ h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · linarith
    · exact hβ2θ h2
    · exact hθ45 (by linarith)

/--
Core algebraic fact underlying the general `m·θ`-avoidance argument: if a
single cut splits an angle `γ` (with the other two angles `α`, `β` fixed)
into `x` and `γ - x`, producing triangles with angle sets `{x, α, β+(γ-x)}`
and `{γ-x, β, α+x}`, then it is impossible for both resulting triangles to
contain an angle equal to `m·θ` for a fixed integer `m`, provided `α ≠ mθ`,
`β ≠ mθ`, `γ ≠ 2mθ`, and `mθ ≠ π/2`.
-/
lemma no_double_target_of_split_multiple (θ : ℝ) (m : ℤ)
    (hmθ90 : (m : ℝ) * θ ≠ Real.pi / 2)
    (α β γ x : ℝ) (hsum : α + β + γ = Real.pi)
    (hαpos : 0 < α) (hβpos : 0 < β)
    (hαmθ : α ≠ (m : ℝ) * θ) (hβmθ : β ≠ (m : ℝ) * θ)
    (hγ2mθ : γ ≠ 2 * ((m : ℝ) * θ)) :
    ¬ ((x = (m : ℝ) * θ ∨ α = (m : ℝ) * θ ∨ β + (γ - x) = (m : ℝ) * θ) ∧
       (γ - x = (m : ℝ) * θ ∨ β = (m : ℝ) * θ ∨ α + x = (m : ℝ) * θ)) := by
  rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1 | h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · exact hγ2mθ (by linarith)
    · exact hβmθ h2
    · linarith
  · exact hαmθ h1
  · rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2
    · linarith
    · exact hβmθ h2
    · exact hmθ90 (by linarith)

/--
If a triangle `T` has an angle equal to `2mθ` for a positive integer `m`
(with `θ > 0`), then Mulan can make a single legal cut so that both
resulting triangles have an angle equal to `mθ`.
-/
lemma exists_split_even_multiple (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (m : ℤ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (T : TriangleAngles)
    (h : T.a = 2 * (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.b = 2 * (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T.c = 2 * (m:ℝ) * θ) :
    ∃ T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles,
      LegalSplit T T₁ T₂ ∧
      (T₁.a = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T₁.b = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T₁.c = (m:ℝ) * θ) ∧
      (T₂.a = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T₂.b = (m:ℝ) * θ ∨ T₂.c = (m:ℝ) * θ) := by
  have hm_real : (1:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hm_pos : 0 < (m:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hmθ_pos : 0 < (m:ℝ) * θ := mul_pos hm_pos hθ
  rcases h with ha | hb | hc
  · have hxa : (m:ℝ) * θ < T.a := by rw [ha]; nlinarith [hmθ_pos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=
      exists_split_of_lt_a T ((m:ℝ) * θ) hmθ_pos hxa
    refine ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, Or.inl h1a, Or.inl ?_⟩
    rw [h2a, ha]; ring
  · have hxb : (m:ℝ) * θ < T.b := by rw [hb]; nlinarith [hmθ_pos]
    obtain ⟨T₁, T₂, hsplit, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ :=

angles `α`, `β`, `γ` of a triangle (with `α + β + γ = π`) is an integer multiple of `θ`,
then for any cut splitting `γ` into `x` and `γ - x`, it is impossible for both resulting
triangles `{x, α, β+(γ-x)}` and `{γ-x, β, α+x}` to each contain an angle equal to some
(possibly different) integer multiple of `θ`.
-/
lemma no_double_multiple_of_split (θ : ℝ)
    (hθnd : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, Real.pi = (k : ℝ) * θ)
    (α β γ x : ℝ) (hsum : α + β + γ = Real.pi)
    (hα : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, α = (k : ℝ) * θ)
    (hβ : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, β = (k : ℝ) * θ)
    (hγ : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, γ = (k : ℝ) * θ) :
    ¬ (((∃ k : ℤ, x = (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨ (∃ k : ℤ, α = (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨
          (∃ k : ℤ, β + (γ - x) = (k : ℝ) * θ)) ∧
       ((∃ k : ℤ, γ - x = (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨ (∃ k : ℤ, β = (k : ℝ) * θ) ∨
          (∃ k : ℤ, α + x = (k : ℝ) * θ))) := by
  rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rcases h1 with ⟨k1, hk1⟩ | hα' | ⟨k1, hk1⟩
  · rcases h2 with ⟨k2, hk2⟩ | hβ' | ⟨k2, hk2⟩
    · exact hγ ⟨k1 + k2, by push_cast; linear_combination hk1 + hk2⟩
    · exact hβ hβ'
    · exact hα ⟨k2 - k1, by push_cast; linear_combination hk2 - hk1⟩
  · exact hα hα'
  · rcases h2 with ⟨k2, hk2⟩ | hβ' | ⟨k2, hk2⟩
    · exact hβ ⟨k1 - k2, by push_cast; linear_combination hk1 - hk2⟩
    · exact hβ hβ'
    · exact hθnd ⟨k1 + k2, by push_cast; linear_combination hk1 + hk2 - hsum⟩

/--
Invariant preserved under Shan-Yu's choice: if `θ` does not divide `π` (no integer
multiple of `θ` equals `π`), and a triangle `T` has no angle equal to an integer
multiple of `θ`, then for any legal cut of `T` into `T₁` and `T₂`, at least one of
`T₁`, `T₂` also has no angle equal to an integer multiple of `θ`. Thus Shan-Yu can
always keep the invariant "no angle is an integer multiple of `θ`" alive.
-/
lemma no_forcing_of_split_multiple (θ : ℝ)
    (hθnd : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, Real.pi = (k : ℝ) * θ)
    (T T₁ T₂ : TriangleAngles) (hsplit : LegalSplit T T₁ T₂)
    (hTa : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, T.a = (k : ℝ) * θ)
    (hTb : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, T.b = (k : ℝ) * θ)
    (hTc : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, T.c = (k : ℝ) * θ) :
    ¬ HasMultipleAngle θ T₁ ∨ ¬ HasMultipleAngle θ T₂ := by
  have hsum := T.angle_sum
  rcases hsplit with
    ⟨x, hx0, hxa, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ |
    ⟨x, hx0, hxb, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩ |
    ⟨x, hx0, hxc, h1a, h1b, h1c, h2a, h2b, h2c⟩
  · have key := no_double_multiple_of_split θ hθnd T.b T.c T.a x (by linarith)
      hTb hTc hTa
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasMultipleAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasMultipleAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key
  · have key := no_double_multiple_of_split θ hθnd T.c T.a T.b x (by linarith)
      hTc hTa hTb
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasMultipleAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasMultipleAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key
  · have key := no_double_multiple_of_split θ hθnd T.a T.b T.c x hsum
      hTa hTb hTc
    rw [not_and_or] at key
    rcases key with key | key
    · left; unfold HasMultipleAngle; rw [h1a, h1b, h1c]; exact key
    · right; unfold HasMultipleAngle; rw [h2a, h2b, h2c]; exact key

/--

integer multiple of `θ`. This is proved by induction on the `MulanWins`
derivation, using the invariant that Shan-Yu can always preserve "no angle is
an integer multiple of `θ`" across any legal split.

lemma hasMultiple_of_mulanWins (θ : ℝ) (hθnd : ¬ ∃ k : ℤ, Real.pi = (k : ℝ) * θ) :
    ∀ T : TriangleAngles, MulanWins θ T → HasMultipleAngle θ T := by
  intro T h
  induction h with
  | terminal hT =>
      rcases hT with ha | hb | hc
      · exact Or.inl ⟨1, by rw [ha]; push_cast; ring⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨1, by rw [hb]; push_cast; ring⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨1, by rw [hc]; push_cast; ring⟩)
  | cut hsplit h1 h2 ih1 ih2 =>
      by_contra hTno
      unfold HasMultipleAngle at hTno
      rw [not_or, not_or] at hTno
      obtain ⟨hTa, hTb, hTc⟩ := hTno
      rcases no_forcing_of_split_multiple θ hθnd _ _ _ hsplit hTa hTb hTc with hc1 | hc2
      · exact hc1 ih1
      · exact hc2 ih2

  have hb1' := prefixSum_bounds a C h (i+1) j1 hi1 hj1lt
  have hsucc : PrefixSum100 a (i+1) = PrefixSum100 a i + a (i+1) := by
    simp [PrefixSum100, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  have h1 : a (i+1) ≤ (minA a + (C:ℤ)) - (maxA a - (C:ℤ)) := by
    rw [hmaxeq, hmineq]
    linarith [hsucc, hb1'.2, hb0.1]
  have h2 : -(a (i+1)) ≤ (minA a + (C:ℤ)) - (maxA a - (C:ℤ)) := by
    rw [hmaxeq, hmineq]
    linarith [hsucc, hb0'.2, hb1.1]

    _ ≤ (minA a + (C:ℤ)) - (maxA a - (C:ℤ)) := habs
