      refine ⟨n + 1, le_refl _, ?_⟩
      intro k hk
      rcases hk.eq_or_lt with hk' | hk'
      · subst hk'
        exact le_refl _
      · exact le_trans (hr_max k (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hk')) (le_of_lt h)

lemma exists_prefix_max_ge (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, r ≤ n ∧ IsPrefixMaximum f r ∧ f n ≤ f r := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr_le, hr_max⟩ := exists_argmax_le f n
  refine ⟨r, hr_le, ?_, hr_max n (le_refl n)⟩
  intro k hk
  exact hr_max k (hk.trans hr_le)

lemma prefix_max_eq_f_zero_of_f_one_eq_zero (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (h1 : f 1 = 0) :
    ∀ r : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f r → f r = f 0 := by
  have key : ∀ r : ℕ, ∀ r' : ℕ, r' ≤ r → IsPrefixMaximum f r' → f r' = f 0 := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero =>
      intro r' hr' _
      have hz : r' = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hr'
      subst hz
      rfl
    | succ r ih =>
      intro r' hr' hpm
      rcases hr'.eq_or_lt with heq | hlt
      · subst heq
        have heq2 : f (r + 1) = f r + f 1 := hadd r 1 hpm
        rw [h1, add_zero] at heq2
        have hpm_r : IsPrefixMaximum f r := by
          intro k hk
          have hk' : k ≤ r + 1 := hk.trans (Nat.le_succ r)
          have hle := hpm k hk'
          rw [heq2] at hle
          exact hle
        have hindr := ih r (le_refl r) hpm_r
        rw [heq2]
        exact hindr
      · have hle : r' ≤ r := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hlt
        exact ih r' hle hpm
  intro r hr
  exact key r r (le_refl r) hr

lemma f_one_pos (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) :
    0 < f 1 := by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have h1 : f 1 = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp h
  have hpm_eq := prefix_max_eq_f_zero_of_f_one_eq_zero f hadd h1
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hunbounded 1
  obtain ⟨r, hr_le, hr_max, hr_ge⟩ := exists_prefix_max_ge f n
  have hr0 : f r = f 0 := hpm_eq r hr_max
  rw [hr0, hf0] at hr_ge
  omega

lemma record_step (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : IsPrefixMaximum f s) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < s) :
    f k + f (s - k) = f (k + 1) + f (s - k - 1) := by
  have heq1 : k + (s - k) = s := by omega
  have heq2 : (k + 1) + (s - k - 1) = s := by omega
  have h1 := hadd k (s - k) (by rw [heq1]; exact hs)
  have h2 := hadd (k + 1) (s - k - 1) (by rw [heq2]; exact hs)
  rw [heq1] at h1
  rw [heq2] at h2
  exact h1.symm.trans h2

lemma prefix_max_split (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : IsPrefixMaximum f s) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ s → f k + f (s - k) = f s := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    simp [hf0]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hk
    have hk' : k ≤ s := by omega
    have hklt : k < s := by omega
    have step := record_step f hadd s hs k hklt
    have ihk := ih hk'
    have heq : s - (k + 1) = s - k - 1 := by omega
    rw [heq]
    omega

lemma shift_identity (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hs : IsPrefixMaximum f s) (ht : IsPrefixMaximum f t) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ s → f (t - s + k) + f s = f t + f k := by
  intro k hk
  have h1 : f k + f (s - k) = f s := prefix_max_split f hadd hf0 s hs k hk
  have hsk_le_s : s - k ≤ s := Nat.sub_le s k
  have hsk_le_t : s - k ≤ t := hsk_le_s.trans hst
  have h2 : f (s - k) + f (t - (s - k)) = f t :=
    prefix_max_split f hadd hf0 t ht (s - k) hsk_le_t
  have heq : t - (s - k) = t - s + k := by omega
  rw [heq] at h2
  omega

lemma exists_next_record (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (r : ℕ) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, r < t ∧ f r < f t := by
  obtain ⟨r0, hr0_le, hr0_max⟩ := exists_argmax_le f r
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hunbounded (f r0 + 1)
  have hn_gt : r < n := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hle := hr0_max n h
    omega
  refine ⟨n, hn_gt, ?_⟩
  have hfr_le : f r ≤ f r0 := hr0_max r (le_refl r)
  omega

def recordTime (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 0
  | (i + 1) => Nat.find (exists_next_record f hunbounded (recordTime f hunbounded i))

lemma recordTime_zero (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) :
    recordTime f hunbounded 0 = 0 := rfl

lemma recordTime_succ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) :
    recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) =
      Nat.find (exists_next_record f hunbounded (recordTime f hunbounded i)) := rfl

lemma recordTime_succ_spec (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) :
    recordTime f hunbounded i < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) ∧
      f (recordTime f hunbounded i) < f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) := by
  rw [recordTime_succ]
  exact Nat.find_spec (exists_next_record f hunbounded (recordTime f hunbounded i))

lemma recordTime_min (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ)
    (hj_lt : j < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) (hj_gt : recordTime f hunbounded i < j) :
    f j ≤ f (recordTime f hunbounded i) := by
  rw [recordTime_succ] at hj_lt
  have hnotP := Nat.find_min (exists_next_record f hunbounded (recordTime f hunbounded i)) hj_lt
  push_neg at hnotP
  exact hnotP hj_gt

lemma recordTime_isPrefixMaximum (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) :
    ∀ i : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (recordTime f hunbounded i) := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
      rw [recordTime_zero]
      intro k hk
      have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hk
      subst hk0
      exact le_refl _
  | succ i ih =>
      intro k hk
      rcases hk.eq_or_lt with hkeq | hklt
      · subst hkeq
        exact le_refl _
      · by_cases hkr : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i
        · have hfk := ih k hkr
          have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
          omega
        · push_neg at hkr
          have hle := recordTime_min f hunbounded i k hklt hkr
          have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
          omega

lemma recordTime_lt_of_lt (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) :
    f k < f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) := by
  by_cases hkr : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i
  · have hfk := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i k hkr
    have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
    omega
  · push_neg at hkr
    have hle := recordTime_min f hunbounded i k hk hkr
    have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
    omega

lemma recordTime_strict (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) :
    ∀ i k : ℕ, k < recordTime f hunbounded i → f k < f (recordTime f hunbounded i) := by
  intro i
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      intro k hk
      rw [recordTime_zero] at hk
      exact absurd hk (Nat.not_lt_zero k)
  | succ j =>
      intro k hk
      exact recordTime_lt_of_lt f hunbounded j k hk

lemma recordTime_shift_eq (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i + k) =
      f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) - f (recordTime f hunbounded i) + f k := by
  have hst : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) :=
    le_of_lt (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).1
  have hs := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i
  have ht := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded (i + 1)
  have heq := shift_identity f hadd hf0 (recordTime f hunbounded i)
    (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) hst hs ht k hk
  have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
  omega

lemma recordTime_shift_lt (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i k : ℕ) (hk : k < recordTime f hunbounded i) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i + k) <
      f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) := by
  have heq := recordTime_shift_eq f hunbounded hadd hf0 i k (le_of_lt hk)
  have hklt := recordTime_strict f hunbounded i k hk
  have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
  omega

lemma recordTime_mono (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, i ≤ j → recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j := by
  intro j hij
  induction j, hij using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact le_refl _
  | succ n hn ih =>
    have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded n).1
    omega

lemma recordTime_diff_add (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (h i j : ℕ) (hhi : h ≤ i) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded h) =
      f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i) +
      f (recordTime f hunbounded i - recordTime f hunbounded h) := by
  set rh := recordTime f hunbounded h with hrh_def
  set ri := recordTime f hunbounded i with hri_def
  set rj := recordTime f hunbounded j with hrj_def
  have hri_rj : ri ≤ rj := recordTime_mono f hunbounded i j hij
  have hrh_ri : rh ≤ ri := recordTime_mono f hunbounded h i hhi
  have hs_i : IsPrefixMaximum f ri := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i
  have ht_j : IsPrefixMaximum f rj := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded j
  have hk_le : ri - rh ≤ ri := Nat.sub_le ri rh
  have heq1 := shift_identity f hadd hf0 ri rj hri_rj hs_i ht_j (ri - rh) hk_le
  have heq2 := shift_identity f hadd hf0 ri rj hri_rj hs_i ht_j 0 (Nat.zero_le ri)
  simp [hf0] at heq2
  have hsum : rj - ri + (ri - rh) = rj - rh := by omega
  rw [hsum] at heq1
  omega

lemma recordTime_shift_lt_general (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < recordTime f hunbounded i) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + k) < f (recordTime f hunbounded j) := by
  have hst : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j :=
    recordTime_mono f hunbounded i j hij
  have hs := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i
  have ht := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded j
  have hk_le : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i := le_of_lt hk
  have heq := shift_identity f hadd hf0 (recordTime f hunbounded i) (recordTime f hunbounded j)
    hst hs ht k hk_le
  have hfk_lt := recordTime_strict f hunbounded i k hk
  omega

lemma recordTime_shift_eq_general (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + k) =
      f (recordTime f hunbounded j) - f (recordTime f hunbounded i) + f k := by
  have hst : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j :=
    recordTime_mono f hunbounded i j hij
  have hs := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i
  have ht := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded j
  have heq := shift_identity f hadd hf0 (recordTime f hunbounded i) (recordTime f hunbounded j)
    hst hs ht k hk
  have hle : f (recordTime f hunbounded i) ≤ f (recordTime f hunbounded j) :=
    ht (recordTime f hunbounded i) hst
  omega

lemma recordTime_diff_shift_step (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < recordTime f hunbounded i) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + k + 1) -
        f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + k) =
      f (k + 1) - f k := by
  have hk1 : k + 1 ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i := by omega
  have hk0 : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i := le_of_lt hk
  have heq1 := recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 i j hij k hk0
  have heq2 := recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 i j hij (k + 1) hk1
  have hshift : recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + (k + 1) =
      recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + k + 1 := by omega
  rw [hshift] at heq2
  omega

lemma recordTime_diff_periodic (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (p : ℕ) (hp_def : p = recordTime f hunbounded (j + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded j)
    (hp_le : p ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k < recordTime f hunbounded i - p) :
    f (k + p + 1) - f (k + p) = f (k + 1) - f k := by
  have hri_rj : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j :=
    recordTime_mono f hunbounded i j hij
  have hrj_lt : recordTime f hunbounded j < recordTime f hunbounded (j + 1) :=
    (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded j).1
  have hkp_lt : k + p < recordTime f hunbounded i := by omega
  have hk_lt : k < recordTime f hunbounded i := by omega
  have h1 := recordTime_diff_shift_step f hunbounded hadd hf0 i j hij (k + p) hkp_lt
  have h2 := recordTime_diff_shift_step f hunbounded hadd hf0 i (j + 1)
    (hij.trans (Nat.le_succ j)) k hk_lt
  have hshift : recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + (k + p) =
      recordTime f hunbounded (j + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i + k := by omega
  rw [hshift] at h1
  omega

lemma recordTime_diff_nonincreasing (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i : ℕ) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1 + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) ≤
      f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) := by
  set rI := recordTime f hunbounded i with hrI_def
  set rJ := recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) with hrJ_def
  set rK := recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1 + 1) with hrK_def
  have hij1 : i ≤ i + 1 := Nat.le_succ i
  have hij2 : i + 1 ≤ i + 1 + 1 := Nat.le_succ (i + 1)
  have hrI_lt_rJ : rI < rJ := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).1
  have hrJ_lt_rK : rJ < rK := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded (i + 1)).1
  have hstep_p : f (rK - rJ + 0) = f rK - f rJ + f 0 :=
    recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 (i + 1) (i + 1 + 1) hij2 0 (Nat.zero_le rJ)
  simp only [add_zero, hf0] at hstep_p
  have hstep2 : f (rK - rJ + rI) = f rK - f rJ + f rI :=
    recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 (i + 1) (i + 1 + 1) hij2 rI (le_of_lt hrI_lt_rJ)
  have hstep3 : f (rJ - rI + 0) = f rJ - f rI + f 0 :=
    recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 i (i + 1) hij1 0 (Nat.zero_le rI)
  simp only [add_zero, hf0] at hstep3
  have ht_lt_rK : rK - rJ + rI < rK := by omega
  have hle : f (rK - rJ + rI) ≤ f rJ := by
    by_cases hcase : rK - rJ + rI ≤ rJ
    · exact recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded (i + 1) (rK - rJ + rI) hcase
    · push_neg at hcase
      exact recordTime_min f hunbounded (i + 1) (rK - rJ + rI) ht_lt_rK hcase
  have hfI_le_fJ : f rI ≤ f rJ := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded (i + 1) rI (le_of_lt hrI_lt_rJ)
  omega

def recordDiff (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) - f (recordTime f hunbounded i)

lemma recordDiff_eq_f_sub (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i : ℕ) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) = recordDiff f hunbounded i := by
  have h := recordTime_shift_eq f hunbounded hadd hf0 i 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
  simp only [add_zero, hf0] at h
  exact h

lemma recordDiff_pos (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) :
    0 < recordDiff f hunbounded i := by
  unfold recordDiff
  have h := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
  omega

lemma recordDiff_antitone (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i : ℕ) :
    recordDiff f hunbounded (i + 1) ≤ recordDiff f hunbounded i := by
  have hmono := recordTime_diff_nonincreasing f hunbounded hadd hf0 i
  rw [recordDiff_eq_f_sub f hunbounded hadd hf0 (i + 1),
      recordDiff_eq_f_sub f hunbounded hadd hf0 i] at hmono
  exact hmono

lemma exists_stable_recordDiff (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) :
    ∃ c J : ℕ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < J ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c := by
  have hantitone : ∀ i : ℕ, recordDiff f hunbounded (i + 1) ≤ recordDiff f hunbounded i :=
    recordDiff_antitone f hunbounded hadd hf0
  have hmono : Antitone (recordDiff f hunbounded) := antitone_nat_of_succ_le hantitone
  have hne : (Set.range (recordDiff f hunbounded)).Nonempty := ⟨recordDiff f hunbounded 0, ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨j0, hj0⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hne
  refine ⟨sInf (Set.range (recordDiff f hunbounded)), j0 + 1, ?_, Nat.succ_pos _, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hj0]; exact recordDiff_pos f hunbounded j0
  · intro j hj
    have hj0j : j0 ≤ j := by omega
    have hle1 : recordDiff f hunbounded j ≤ recordDiff f hunbounded j0 := hmono hj0j
    rw [hj0] at hle1
    have hle2 : sInf (Set.range (recordDiff f hunbounded)) ≤ recordDiff f hunbounded j :=
      Nat.sInf_le ⟨j, rfl⟩
    omega

lemma recordDiff_add_eq (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) = f (recordTime f hunbounded i) + recordDiff f hunbounded i := by
  unfold recordDiff
  have h := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
  omega

lemma recordTime_stable_sum (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (c J : ℕ) (hstable : ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : J ≤ j) (l : ℕ) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (j + l)) = f (recordTime f hunbounded j) + l * c := by
  induction l with
  | zero => simp
  | succ l ih =>
    have hjl : J ≤ j + l := by omega
    have hstep := hstable (j + l) hjl
    have hadd_eq := recordDiff_add_eq f hunbounded (j + l)
    rw [hstep] at hadd_eq
    have hshift : j + (l + 1) = (j + l) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hshift, hadd_eq, ih]
    ring

lemma record_diff_shift_stable_eq (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (c J : ℕ) (hstable : ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : J ≤ j) (l : ℕ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) - recordTime f hunbounded j + k) = l * c + f k := by
  have hij : j ≤ j + l := Nat.le_add_right j l
  have heq := recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 j (j + l) hij k hk
  have hsum := recordTime_stable_sum f hunbounded c J hstable j hj l
  omega

lemma record_diff_shift_stable_zero (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (c J : ℕ) (hstable : ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : J ≤ j) (l : ℕ) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) - recordTime f hunbounded j) = l * c := by
  have h := record_diff_shift_stable_eq f hunbounded hadd hf0 c J hstable j hj l 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
  simpa [hf0] using h

lemma recordTime_ge_index (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) :
    ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => exact Nat.zero_le _
  | succ n ih =>
    have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded n).1
    omega

lemma f_pos_on_pos (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 0 < f n := by
  have hs_ge : n ≤ recordTime f hunbounded n := recordTime_ge_index f hunbounded n
  have hs_pm : IsPrefixMaximum f (recordTime f hunbounded n) :=
    recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded n
  have hsplit : f n + f (recordTime f hunbounded n - n) = f (recordTime f hunbounded n) :=
    prefix_max_split f hadd hf0 (recordTime f hunbounded n) hs_pm n hs_ge
  have hlt : recordTime f hunbounded n - n < recordTime f hunbounded n := by omega
  have hstrict : f (recordTime f hunbounded n - n) < f (recordTime f hunbounded n) :=
    recordTime_strict f hunbounded n (recordTime f hunbounded n - n) hlt
  omega

lemma exists_min_a (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (c J : ℕ) (hstable_prop : ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c) :
    ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ f a = c ∧ ∀ b : ℕ, 0 < b → f b = c → a ≤ b := by
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ f n = c := by
    refine ⟨recordTime f hunbounded (J + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded J, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded J).1
      omega
    · have heq := recordDiff_eq_f_sub f hunbounded hadd hf0 J
      rw [heq]
      exact hstable_prop J (le_refl J)
  classical
  refine ⟨Nat.find hex, (Nat.find_spec hex).1, (Nat.find_spec hex).2, ?_⟩
  intro b hb hfb
  exact Nat.find_min' hex ⟨hb, hfb⟩

lemma prefix_max_of_gap_eq (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (i t : ℕ) (ht_ge : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ t)
    (ht_lt : t < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1))
    (heq : f t = f (recordTime f hunbounded i)) :
    IsPrefixMaximum f t := by
  intro k hk
  by_cases hcase : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i
  · have hle := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i k hcase
    omega
  · have hcase' : recordTime f hunbounded i < k := Nat.not_le.mp hcase
    have hklt : k < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) := lt_of_le_of_lt hk ht_lt
    have hle := recordTime_min f hunbounded i k hklt hcase'
    omega

lemma record_gap_stabilizes (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (c J : ℕ) (_hc_pos : 0 < c) (_hJ_pos : 0 < J)
    (hstable_prop : ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c)
    (a : ℕ) (ha_pos : 0 < a) (ha_eq : f a = c)
    (ha_min : ∀ b : ℕ, 0 < b → f b = c → a ≤ b) :
    ∃ J1 : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, J1 ≤ i → recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i = a := by
  refine ⟨max J a, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have hiJ : J ≤ i := le_trans (le_max_left J a) hi
  have hrs : recordTime f hunbounded i < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) :=
    (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).1
  have hL_pos : 0 < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i := by omega
  have hL_eq : f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) = c := by
    have h := recordDiff_eq_f_sub f hunbounded hadd hf0 i
    rw [hstable_prop i hiJ] at h
    exact h
  have ha_le_L : a ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i :=
    ha_min _ hL_pos hL_eq
  have hrle : recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i ≤
      recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) := Nat.sub_le _ _
  have ha_le_s : a ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) := by omega
  have hsplit := prefix_max_split f hadd hf0 (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1))
    (recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded (i + 1)) a ha_le_s
  have hsum : f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) =
      f (recordTime f hunbounded i) + recordDiff f hunbounded i :=
    recordDiff_add_eq f hunbounded i
  rw [hstable_prop i hiJ] at hsum
  have hfsa : f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a) = f (recordTime f hunbounded i) := by
    rw [ha_eq] at hsplit
    omega
  have ht_eq : recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a =
      recordTime f hunbounded i +
        ((recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) - a) := by omega
  have ht_ge : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a := by omega
  have ht_lt : recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) := by omega
  have hpm_t : IsPrefixMaximum f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a) :=
    prefix_max_of_gap_eq f hunbounded i (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a) ht_ge ht_lt hfsa
  rw [ht_eq] at hpm_t
  have hadd_eq := hadd (recordTime f hunbounded i)
    ((recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) - a) hpm_t
  rw [← ht_eq] at hadd_eq
  rw [hfsa] at hadd_eq
  have hfzero : f ((recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) - a) = 0 := by
    omega
  by_contra hne
  have hLa_pos : 0 < (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) - a := by
    omega
  have hpos := f_pos_on_pos f hunbounded hadd hf0 _ hLa_pos
  omega

theorem main
    (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd :
      ∀ m n : ℕ,
        IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) →
        f (m + n) = f m + f n) :
    ∃ A B C D : ℕ,
      0 < A ∧
      0 < B ∧
      0 < C ∧
      0 < D ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, f (A * n + B) = C * n + D := by
  have hf0 := f_zero_eq_zero f hadd
  have hf1 := f_one_pos f hunbounded hadd hf0
  have hrecord_pm := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded
  have hrecord_spec := recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded
  have hrecord_strict := recordTime_strict f hunbounded
  have hrecord_shift := recordTime_shift_eq f hunbounded hadd hf0
  have hrecord_shift_lt := recordTime_shift_lt f hunbounded hadd hf0
  have hrecord_mono := recordTime_mono f hunbounded
  have hrecord_diff_add := recordTime_diff_add f hunbounded hadd hf0
  have hrecord_shift_lt_general := recordTime_shift_lt_general f hunbounded hadd hf0
  have hrecord_shift_general := recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0
  have hrecord_diff_shift_step := recordTime_diff_shift_step f hunbounded hadd hf0
  have hrecord_periodic := recordTime_diff_periodic f hunbounded hadd hf0
  have hrecord_diff_nonincreasing := recordTime_diff_nonincreasing f hunbounded hadd hf0
  have hstable := exists_stable_recordDiff f hunbounded hadd hf0
  obtain ⟨c, J, hc_pos, hJ_pos, hstable_prop⟩ := hstable
  have hrecordDiff_add_eq := recordDiff_add_eq f hunbounded
  have hrecordTime_stable_sum := recordTime_stable_sum f hunbounded c J hstable_prop
  have hrecord_diff_shift_stable_eq :=
    record_diff_shift_stable_eq f hunbounded hadd hf0 c J hstable_prop
  have hrecord_diff_shift_stable_zero :=
    record_diff_shift_stable_zero f hunbounded hadd hf0 c J hstable_prop
  have hrecordTime_ge_index := recordTime_ge_index f hunbounded
  have hf_pos_on_pos := f_pos_on_pos f hunbounded hadd hf0
  obtain ⟨a, ha_pos, ha_eq, ha_min⟩ := exists_min_a f hunbounded hadd hf0 c J hstable_prop
  obtain ⟨J1, hJ1⟩ :=
    record_gap_stabilizes f hunbounded hadd hf0 c J hc_pos hJ_pos hstable_prop a ha_pos ha_eq ha_min
  sorry

NEXT STEP:
Prove the global additivity on the stabilized period: For all nonnegative integers k and l, we have f(k + l·a) = f(k) + l·c.

PROOF:
Fix nonnegative integers k and l.

- If l = 0, then f(k + 0·a) = f(k) is immediate, so the claim holds.

- Assume l ≥ 1. By the established stabilization of record gaps, there exists J1 such that for all j ≥ J1 we have r_{j+1} − r_j = a. Hence, for any j ≥ J1 and any l ≥ 1,
  r_{j+l} − r_j = ∑_{t=j}^{j+l-1} (r_{t+1} − r_t) = ∑_{t=j}^{j+l-1} a = l·a.

  The sequence (r_j) is strictly increasing and unbounded (since f is unbounded, there are infinitely many strict records), so we can choose j ≥ J1 with r_j ≥ k.

  From the previously proved identity valid for all j ≥ J and l ≥ 1 and all k' with 0 ≤ k' ≤ r_j,
  f(r_{j+l} − r_j + k') = (f(r_{j+l}) − f(r_j)) + f(k') = l·c + f(k'),
  we apply it with k' = k (which is allowed since k ≤ r_j), and with our j satisfying j ≥ J1 ≥ J. Using r_{j+l} − r_j = l·a gives
  f(k + l·a) = f(r_{j+l} − r_j + k) = l·c + f(k).

Thus, for all k, l ≥ 0 we have f(k + l·a) = f(k) + l·c, as required.

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

/--
`IsPrefixMaximum f r` means that `f r` is at least every value
`f k` with `k ≤ r`.
-/
def IsPrefixMaximum (f : ℕ → ℕ) (r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ r → f k ≤ f r

/--
A function from the nonnegative integers to themselves is unbounded when it
attains values at least as large as every prescribed natural number.
-/
def IsUnboundedNatFunction (f : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, N ≤ f n

lemma f_zero_eq_zero (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n) :
    f 0 = 0 := by
  have hpm : IsPrefixMaximum f (0 + 0) := by
    intro k hk
    have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp (by simpa using hk)
    subst hk0
    simp
  have h := hadd 0 0 hpm
  simp at h
  omega

lemma exists_argmax_le (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ r : ℕ, r ≤ n ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ n → f k ≤ f r := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨0, le_refl 0, ?_⟩
    intro k hk
    have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hk
    subst hk0
    exact le_refl _
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨r, hr_le, hr_max⟩ := ih
    by_cases h : f (n + 1) ≤ f r
    · refine ⟨r, hr_le.trans (Nat.le_succ n), ?_⟩
      intro k hk
      rcases hk.eq_or_lt with hk' | hk'
      · subst hk'
        exact h
      · exact hr_max k (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hk')
    · push_neg at h
      refine ⟨n + 1, le_refl _, ?_⟩
      intro k hk
      rcases hk.eq_or_lt with hk' | hk'
      · subst hk'
        exact le_refl _
      · exact le_trans (hr_max k (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hk')) (le_of_lt h)

lemma exists_prefix_max_ge (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, r ≤ n ∧ IsPrefixMaximum f r ∧ f n ≤ f r := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr_le, hr_max⟩ := exists_argmax_le f n
  refine ⟨r, hr_le, ?_, hr_max n (le_refl n)⟩
  intro k hk
  exact hr_max k (hk.trans hr_le)

lemma prefix_max_eq_f_zero_of_f_one_eq_zero (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (h1 : f 1 = 0) :
    ∀ r : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f r → f r = f 0 := by
  have key : ∀ r : ℕ, ∀ r' : ℕ, r' ≤ r → IsPrefixMaximum f r' → f r' = f 0 := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero =>
      intro r' hr' _
      have hz : r' = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hr'
      subst hz
      rfl
    | succ r ih =>
      intro r' hr' hpm
      rcases hr'.eq_or_lt with heq | hlt
      · subst heq
        have heq2 : f (r + 1) = f r + f 1 := hadd r 1 hpm
        rw [h1, add_zero] at heq2
        have hpm_r : IsPrefixMaximum f r := by
          intro k hk
          have hk' : k ≤ r + 1 := hk.trans (Nat.le_succ r)
          have hle := hpm k hk'
          rw [heq2] at hle
          exact hle
        have hindr := ih r (le_refl r) hpm_r
        rw [heq2]
        exact hindr
      · have hle : r' ≤ r := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hlt
        exact ih r' hle hpm
  intro r hr
  exact key r r (le_refl r) hr

lemma f_one_pos (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) :
    0 < f 1 := by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have h1 : f 1 = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp h
  have hpm_eq := prefix_max_eq_f_zero_of_f_one_eq_zero f hadd h1
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hunbounded 1
  obtain ⟨r, hr_le, hr_max, hr_ge⟩ := exists_prefix_max_ge f n
  have hr0 : f r = f 0 := hpm_eq r hr_max
  rw [hr0, hf0] at hr_ge
  omega

lemma record_step (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : IsPrefixMaximum f s) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < s) :
    f k + f (s - k) = f (k + 1) + f (s - k - 1) := by
  have heq1 : k + (s - k) = s := by omega
  have heq2 : (k + 1) + (s - k - 1) = s := by omega
  have h1 := hadd k (s - k) (by rw [heq1]; exact hs)
  have h2 := hadd (k + 1) (s - k - 1) (by rw [heq2]; exact hs)
  rw [heq1] at h1
  rw [heq2] at h2
  exact h1.symm.trans h2

lemma prefix_max_split (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : IsPrefixMaximum f s) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ s → f k + f (s - k) = f s := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    simp [hf0]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hk
    have hk' : k ≤ s := by omega
    have hklt : k < s := by omega
    have step := record_step f hadd s hs k hklt
    have ihk := ih hk'
    have heq : s - (k + 1) = s - k - 1 := by omega
    rw [heq]
    omega

lemma shift_identity (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hs : IsPrefixMaximum f s) (ht : IsPrefixMaximum f t) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ s → f (t - s + k) + f s = f t + f k := by
  intro k hk
  have h1 : f k + f (s - k) = f s := prefix_max_split f hadd hf0 s hs k hk
  have hsk_le_s : s - k ≤ s := Nat.sub_le s k
  have hsk_le_t : s - k ≤ t := hsk_le_s.trans hst
  have h2 : f (s - k) + f (t - (s - k)) = f t :=
    prefix_max_split f hadd hf0 t ht (s - k) hsk_le_t
  have heq : t - (s - k) = t - s + k := by omega
  rw [heq] at h2
  omega

lemma exists_next_record (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (r : ℕ) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, r < t ∧ f r < f t := by
  obtain ⟨r0, hr0_le, hr0_max⟩ := exists_argmax_le f r
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hunbounded (f r0 + 1)
  have hn_gt : r < n := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hle := hr0_max n h
    omega
  refine ⟨n, hn_gt, ?_⟩
  have hfr_le : f r ≤ f r0 := hr0_max r (le_refl r)
  omega

def recordTime (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 0
  | (i + 1) => Nat.find (exists_next_record f hunbounded (recordTime f hunbounded i))

lemma recordTime_zero (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) :
    recordTime f hunbounded 0 = 0 := rfl

lemma recordTime_succ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) :
    recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) =
      Nat.find (exists_next_record f hunbounded (recordTime f hunbounded i)) := rfl

lemma recordTime_succ_spec (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) :
    recordTime f hunbounded i < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) ∧
      f (recordTime f hunbounded i) < f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) := by
  rw [recordTime_succ]
  exact Nat.find_spec (exists_next_record f hunbounded (recordTime f hunbounded i))

lemma recordTime_min (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ)
    (hj_lt : j < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) (hj_gt : recordTime f hunbounded i < j) :
    f j ≤ f (recordTime f hunbounded i) := by
  rw [recordTime_succ] at hj_lt
  have hnotP := Nat.find_min (exists_next_record f hunbounded (recordTime f hunbounded i)) hj_lt
  push_neg at hnotP
  exact hnotP hj_gt

lemma recordTime_isPrefixMaximum (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) :
    ∀ i : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (recordTime f hunbounded i) := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
      rw [recordTime_zero]
      intro k hk
      have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hk
      subst hk0
      exact le_refl _
  | succ i ih =>
      intro k hk
      rcases hk.eq_or_lt with hkeq | hklt
      · subst hkeq
        exact le_refl _
      · by_cases hkr : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i
        · have hfk := ih k hkr
          have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
          omega
        · push_neg at hkr
          have hle := recordTime_min f hunbounded i k hklt hkr
          have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
          omega

lemma recordTime_lt_of_lt (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) :
    f k < f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) := by
  by_cases hkr : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i
  · have hfk := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i k hkr
    have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
    omega
  · push_neg at hkr
    have hle := recordTime_min f hunbounded i k hk hkr
    have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
    omega

lemma recordTime_strict (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) :
    ∀ i k : ℕ, k < recordTime f hunbounded i → f k < f (recordTime f hunbounded i) := by
  intro i
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      intro k hk
      rw [recordTime_zero] at hk
      exact absurd hk (Nat.not_lt_zero k)
  | succ j =>
      intro k hk
      exact recordTime_lt_of_lt f hunbounded j k hk

lemma recordTime_shift_eq (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i + k) =
      f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) - f (recordTime f hunbounded i) + f k := by
  have hst : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) :=
    le_of_lt (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).1
  have hs := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i
  have ht := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded (i + 1)
  have heq := shift_identity f hadd hf0 (recordTime f hunbounded i)
    (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) hst hs ht k hk
  have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
  omega

lemma recordTime_shift_lt (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i k : ℕ) (hk : k < recordTime f hunbounded i) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i + k) <
      f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) := by
  have heq := recordTime_shift_eq f hunbounded hadd hf0 i k (le_of_lt hk)
  have hklt := recordTime_strict f hunbounded i k hk
  have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
  omega

lemma recordTime_mono (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, i ≤ j → recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j := by
  intro j hij
  induction j, hij using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact le_refl _
  | succ n hn ih =>
    have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded n).1
    omega

lemma recordTime_diff_add (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (h i j : ℕ) (hhi : h ≤ i) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded h) =
      f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i) +
      f (recordTime f hunbounded i - recordTime f hunbounded h) := by
  set rh := recordTime f hunbounded h with hrh_def
  set ri := recordTime f hunbounded i with hri_def
  set rj := recordTime f hunbounded j with hrj_def
  have hri_rj : ri ≤ rj := recordTime_mono f hunbounded i j hij
  have hrh_ri : rh ≤ ri := recordTime_mono f hunbounded h i hhi
  have hs_i : IsPrefixMaximum f ri := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i
  have ht_j : IsPrefixMaximum f rj := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded j
  have hk_le : ri - rh ≤ ri := Nat.sub_le ri rh
  have heq1 := shift_identity f hadd hf0 ri rj hri_rj hs_i ht_j (ri - rh) hk_le
  have heq2 := shift_identity f hadd hf0 ri rj hri_rj hs_i ht_j 0 (Nat.zero_le ri)
  simp [hf0] at heq2
  have hsum : rj - ri + (ri - rh) = rj - rh := by omega
  rw [hsum] at heq1
  omega

lemma recordTime_shift_lt_general (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < recordTime f hunbounded i) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + k) < f (recordTime f hunbounded j) := by
  have hst : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j :=
    recordTime_mono f hunbounded i j hij
  have hs := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i
  have ht := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded j
  have hk_le : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i := le_of_lt hk
  have heq := shift_identity f hadd hf0 (recordTime f hunbounded i) (recordTime f hunbounded j)
    hst hs ht k hk_le
  have hfk_lt := recordTime_strict f hunbounded i k hk
  omega

lemma recordTime_shift_eq_general (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + k) =
      f (recordTime f hunbounded j) - f (recordTime f hunbounded i) + f k := by
  have hst : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j :=
    recordTime_mono f hunbounded i j hij
  have hs := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i
  have ht := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded j
  have heq := shift_identity f hadd hf0 (recordTime f hunbounded i) (recordTime f hunbounded j)
    hst hs ht k hk
  have hle : f (recordTime f hunbounded i) ≤ f (recordTime f hunbounded j) :=
    ht (recordTime f hunbounded i) hst
  omega

lemma recordTime_diff_shift_step (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < recordTime f hunbounded i) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + k + 1) -
        f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + k) =
      f (k + 1) - f k := by
  have hk1 : k + 1 ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i := by omega
  have hk0 : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i := le_of_lt hk
  have heq1 := recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 i j hij k hk0
  have heq2 := recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 i j hij (k + 1) hk1
  have hshift : recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + (k + 1) =
      recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + k + 1 := by omega
  rw [hshift] at heq2
  omega

lemma recordTime_diff_periodic (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (p : ℕ) (hp_def : p = recordTime f hunbounded (j + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded j)
    (hp_le : p ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k < recordTime f hunbounded i - p) :
    f (k + p + 1) - f (k + p) = f (k + 1) - f k := by
  have hri_rj : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j :=
    recordTime_mono f hunbounded i j hij
  have hrj_lt : recordTime f hunbounded j < recordTime f hunbounded (j + 1) :=
    (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded j).1
  have hkp_lt : k + p < recordTime f hunbounded i := by omega
  have hk_lt : k < recordTime f hunbounded i := by omega
  have h1 := recordTime_diff_shift_step f hunbounded hadd hf0 i j hij (k + p) hkp_lt
  have h2 := recordTime_diff_shift_step f hunbounded hadd hf0 i (j + 1)
    (hij.trans (Nat.le_succ j)) k hk_lt
  have hshift : recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + (k + p) =
      recordTime f hunbounded (j + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i + k := by omega
  rw [hshift] at h1
  omega

lemma recordTime_diff_nonincreasing (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i : ℕ) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1 + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) ≤
      f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) := by
  set rI := recordTime f hunbounded i with hrI_def
  set rJ := recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) with hrJ_def
  set rK := recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1 + 1) with hrK_def
  have hij1 : i ≤ i + 1 := Nat.le_succ i
  have hij2 : i + 1 ≤ i + 1 + 1 := Nat.le_succ (i + 1)
  have hrI_lt_rJ : rI < rJ := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).1
  have hrJ_lt_rK : rJ < rK := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded (i + 1)).1
  have hstep_p : f (rK - rJ + 0) = f rK - f rJ + f 0 :=
    recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 (i + 1) (i + 1 + 1) hij2 0 (Nat.zero_le rJ)
  simp only [add_zero, hf0] at hstep_p
  have hstep2 : f (rK - rJ + rI) = f rK - f rJ + f rI :=
    recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 (i + 1) (i + 1 + 1) hij2 rI (le_of_lt hrI_lt_rJ)
  have hstep3 : f (rJ - rI + 0) = f rJ - f rI + f 0 :=
    recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 i (i + 1) hij1 0 (Nat.zero_le rI)
  simp only [add_zero, hf0] at hstep3
  have ht_lt_rK : rK - rJ + rI < rK := by omega
  have hle : f (rK - rJ + rI) ≤ f rJ := by
    by_cases hcase : rK - rJ + rI ≤ rJ
    · exact recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded (i + 1) (rK - rJ + rI) hcase
    · push_neg at hcase
      exact recordTime_min f hunbounded (i + 1) (rK - rJ + rI) ht_lt_rK hcase
  have hfI_le_fJ : f rI ≤ f rJ := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded (i + 1) rI (le_of_lt hrI_lt_rJ)
  omega

def recordDiff (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) - f (recordTime f hunbounded i)

lemma recordDiff_eq_f_sub (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i : ℕ) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) = recordDiff f hunbounded i := by
  have h := recordTime_shift_eq f hunbounded hadd hf0 i 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
  simp only [add_zero, hf0] at h
  exact h

lemma recordDiff_pos (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) :
    0 < recordDiff f hunbounded i := by
  unfold recordDiff
  have h := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
  omega

lemma recordDiff_antitone (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i : ℕ) :
    recordDiff f hunbounded (i + 1) ≤ recordDiff f hunbounded i := by
  have hmono := recordTime_diff_nonincreasing f hunbounded hadd hf0 i
  rw [recordDiff_eq_f_sub f hunbounded hadd hf0 (i + 1),
      recordDiff_eq_f_sub f hunbounded hadd hf0 i] at hmono
  exact hmono

lemma exists_stable_recordDiff (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) :
    ∃ c J : ℕ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < J ∧ ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c := by
  have hantitone : ∀ i : ℕ, recordDiff f hunbounded (i + 1) ≤ recordDiff f hunbounded i :=
    recordDiff_antitone f hunbounded hadd hf0
  have hmono : Antitone (recordDiff f hunbounded) := antitone_nat_of_succ_le hantitone
  have hne : (Set.range (recordDiff f hunbounded)).Nonempty := ⟨recordDiff f hunbounded 0, ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨j0, hj0⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hne
  refine ⟨sInf (Set.range (recordDiff f hunbounded)), j0 + 1, ?_, Nat.succ_pos _, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hj0]; exact recordDiff_pos f hunbounded j0
  · intro j hj
    have hj0j : j0 ≤ j := by omega
    have hle1 : recordDiff f hunbounded j ≤ recordDiff f hunbounded j0 := hmono hj0j
    rw [hj0] at hle1
    have hle2 : sInf (Set.range (recordDiff f hunbounded)) ≤ recordDiff f hunbounded j :=
      Nat.sInf_le ⟨j, rfl⟩
    omega

lemma recordDiff_add_eq (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) = f (recordTime f hunbounded i) + recordDiff f hunbounded i := by
  unfold recordDiff
  have h := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
  omega

lemma recordTime_stable_sum (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (c J : ℕ) (hstable : ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : J ≤ j) (l : ℕ) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (j + l)) = f (recordTime f hunbounded j) + l * c := by
  induction l with
  | zero => simp
  | succ l ih =>
    have hjl : J ≤ j + l := by omega
    have hstep := hstable (j + l) hjl
    have hadd_eq := recordDiff_add_eq f hunbounded (j + l)
    rw [hstep] at hadd_eq
    have hshift : j + (l + 1) = (j + l) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hshift, hadd_eq, ih]
    ring

lemma record_diff_shift_stable_eq (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (c J : ℕ) (hstable : ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : J ≤ j) (l : ℕ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) - recordTime f hunbounded j + k) = l * c + f k := by
  have hij : j ≤ j + l := Nat.le_add_right j l
  have heq := recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 j (j + l) hij k hk
  have hsum := recordTime_stable_sum f hunbounded c J hstable j hj l
  omega

lemma record_diff_shift_stable_zero (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (c J : ℕ) (hstable : ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : J ≤ j) (l : ℕ) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) - recordTime f hunbounded j) = l * c := by
  have h := record_diff_shift_stable_eq f hunbounded hadd hf0 c J hstable j hj l 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
  simpa [hf0] using h

lemma recordTime_ge_index (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) :
    ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => exact Nat.zero_le _
  | succ n ih =>
    have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded n).1
    omega

lemma f_pos_on_pos (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 0 < f n := by
  have hs_ge : n ≤ recordTime f hunbounded n := recordTime_ge_index f hunbounded n
  have hs_pm : IsPrefixMaximum f (recordTime f hunbounded n) :=
    recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded n
  have hsplit : f n + f (recordTime f hunbounded n - n) = f (recordTime f hunbounded n) :=
    prefix_max_split f hadd hf0 (recordTime f hunbounded n) hs_pm n hs_ge
  have hlt : recordTime f hunbounded n - n < recordTime f hunbounded n := by omega
  have hstrict : f (recordTime f hunbounded n - n) < f (recordTime f hunbounded n) :=
    recordTime_strict f hunbounded n (recordTime f hunbounded n - n) hlt
  omega

lemma exists_min_a (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (c J : ℕ) (hstable_prop : ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c) :
    ∃ a : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ f a = c ∧ ∀ b : ℕ, 0 < b → f b = c → a ≤ b := by
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ f n = c := by
    refine ⟨recordTime f hunbounded (J + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded J, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded J).1
      omega
    · have heq := recordDiff_eq_f_sub f hunbounded hadd hf0 J
      rw [heq]
      exact hstable_prop J (le_refl J)
  classical
  refine ⟨Nat.find hex, (Nat.find_spec hex).1, (Nat.find_spec hex).2, ?_⟩
  intro b hb hfb
  exact Nat.find_min' hex ⟨hb, hfb⟩

lemma prefix_max_of_gap_eq (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (i t : ℕ) (ht_ge : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ t)
    (ht_lt : t < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1))
    (heq : f t = f (recordTime f hunbounded i)) :
    IsPrefixMaximum f t := by
  intro k hk
  by_cases hcase : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i
  · have hle := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i k hcase
    omega
  · have hcase' : recordTime f hunbounded i < k := Nat.not_le.mp hcase
    have hklt : k < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) := lt_of_le_of_lt hk ht_lt
    have hle := recordTime_min f hunbounded i k hklt hcase'
    omega

lemma record_gap_stabilizes (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (c J : ℕ) (_hc_pos : 0 < c) (_hJ_pos : 0 < J)
    (hstable_prop : ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c)
    (a : ℕ) (ha_pos : 0 < a) (ha_eq : f a = c)
    (ha_min : ∀ b : ℕ, 0 < b → f b = c → a ≤ b) :
    ∃ J1 : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, J1 ≤ i → recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i = a := by
  refine ⟨max J a, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have hiJ : J ≤ i := le_trans (le_max_left J a) hi
  have hrs : recordTime f hunbounded i < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) :=
    (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).1
  have hL_pos : 0 < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i := by omega
  have hL_eq : f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) = c := by
    have h := recordDiff_eq_f_sub f hunbounded hadd hf0 i
    rw [hstable_prop i hiJ] at h
    exact h
  have ha_le_L : a ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i :=
    ha_min _ hL_pos hL_eq
  have hrle : recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i ≤
      recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) := Nat.sub_le _ _
  have ha_le_s : a ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) := by omega
  have hsplit := prefix_max_split f hadd hf0 (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1))
    (recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded (i + 1)) a ha_le_s
  have hsum : f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) =
      f (recordTime f hunbounded i) + recordDiff f hunbounded i :=
    recordDiff_add_eq f hunbounded i
  rw [hstable_prop i hiJ] at hsum
  have hfsa : f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a) = f (recordTime f hunbounded i) := by
    rw [ha_eq] at hsplit
    omega
  have ht_eq : recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a =
      recordTime f hunbounded i +
        ((recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) - a) := by omega
  have ht_ge : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a := by omega
  have ht_lt : recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) := by omega
  have hpm_t : IsPrefixMaximum f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a) :=
    prefix_max_of_gap_eq f hunbounded i (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a) ht_ge ht_lt hfsa
  rw [ht_eq] at hpm_t
  have hadd_eq := hadd (recordTime f hunbounded i)
    ((recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) - a) hpm_t
  rw [← ht_eq] at hadd_eq
  rw [hfsa] at hadd_eq
  have hfzero : f ((recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) - a) = 0 := by
    omega
  by_contra hne
  have hLa_pos : 0 < (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) - a := by
    omega
  have hpos := f_pos_on_pos f hunbounded hadd hf0 _ hLa_pos
  omega

lemma recordTime_diff_stable_sum (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (a J1 : ℕ) (hJ1 : ∀ i : ℕ, J1 ≤ i → recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i = a)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : J1 ≤ j) :
    ∀ l : ℕ, recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) - recordTime f hunbounded j = l * a := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | zero => simp
  | succ l ih =>
    have hjl : J1 ≤ j + l := by omega
    have hgap := hJ1 (j + l) hjl
    have hmono1 : recordTime f hunbounded j ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) :=
      recordTime_mono f hunbounded j (j + l) (Nat.le_add_right j l)
    have hmono2 : recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (j + l + 1) :=
      le_of_lt (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded (j + l)).1
    have hstep1 : recordTime f hunbounded (j + l + 1) = recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) + a := by
      omega
    have hstep2 : recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) = recordTime f hunbounded j + l * a := by
      omega
    have hshift : j + (l + 1) = j + l + 1 := by ring
    rw [hshift, hstep1, hstep2]
    have hmul : (l + 1) * a = l * a + a := by ring
    omega

lemma f_period_additive (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (c J : ℕ) (hstable_prop : ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c)
    (a J1 : ℕ) (hJ1 : ∀ i : ℕ, J1 ≤ i → recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i = a) :
    ∀ k l : ℕ, f (k + l * a) = f k + l * c := by
  intro k l
  set j := max (max J1 J) k with hj_def
  have hjJ1 : J1 ≤ j := le_trans (le_max_left J1 J) (le_max_left (max J1 J) k)
  have hjJ : J ≤ j := le_trans (le_max_right J1 J) (le_max_left (max J1 J) k)
  have hjk : k ≤ j := le_max_right (max J1 J) k
  have hrj_ge_j : j ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j := recordTime_ge_index f hunbounded j
  have hrj_ge_k : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j := le_trans hjk hrj_ge_j
  have hgapsum : recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) - recordTime f hunbounded j = l * a :=
    recordTime_diff_stable_sum f hunbounded a J1 hJ1 j hjJ1 l
  have hshift := record_diff_shift_stable_eq f hunbounded hadd hf0 c J hstable_prop j hjJ l k hrj_ge_k
  rw [hgapsum] at hshift
  have goal_eq : k + l * a = l * a + k := by ring
  rw [goal_eq, hshift]
  ring

theorem main
    (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd :
      ∀ m n : ℕ,
        IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) →
        f (m + n) = f m + f n) :
    ∃ A B C D : ℕ,
      0 < A ∧
      0 < B ∧
      0 < C ∧
      0 < D ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, f (A * n + B) = C * n + D := by
  have hf0 := f_zero_eq_zero f hadd
  have hf1 := f_one_pos f hunbounded hadd hf0
  have hrecord_pm := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded
  have hrecord_spec := recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded
  have hrecord_strict := recordTime_strict f hunbounded
  have hrecord_shift := recordTime_shift_eq f hunbounded hadd hf0
  have hrecord_shift_lt := recordTime_shift_lt f hunbounded hadd hf0
  have hrecord_mono := recordTime_mono f hunbounded
  have hrecord_diff_add := recordTime_diff_add f hunbounded hadd hf0

import Mathlib

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

/--
`IsPrefixMaximum f r` means that `f r` is at least every value
`f k` with `k ≤ r`.
-/
def IsPrefixMaximum (f : ℕ → ℕ) (r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ r → f k ≤ f r

/--
A function from the nonnegative integers to themselves is unbounded when it
attains values at least as large as every prescribed natural number.
-/
def IsUnboundedNatFunction (f : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ n : ℕ, N ≤ f n

lemma f_zero_eq_zero (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n) :
    f 0 = 0 := by
  have hpm : IsPrefixMaximum f (0 + 0) := by
    intro k hk
    have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp (by simpa using hk)
    subst hk0
    simp
  have h := hadd 0 0 hpm
  simp at h
  omega

lemma exists_argmax_le (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ r : ℕ, r ≤ n ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ n → f k ≤ f r := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨0, le_refl 0, ?_⟩
    intro k hk
    have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hk
    subst hk0
    exact le_refl _
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨r, hr_le, hr_max⟩ := ih
    by_cases h : f (n + 1) ≤ f r
    · refine ⟨r, hr_le.trans (Nat.le_succ n), ?_⟩
      intro k hk
      rcases hk.eq_or_lt with hk' | hk'
      · subst hk'
        exact h
      · exact hr_max k (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hk')
    · push_neg at h
      refine ⟨n + 1, le_refl _, ?_⟩
      intro k hk
      rcases hk.eq_or_lt with hk' | hk'
      · subst hk'
        exact le_refl _
      · exact le_trans (hr_max k (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hk')) (le_of_lt h)

lemma exists_prefix_max_ge (f : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, r ≤ n ∧ IsPrefixMaximum f r ∧ f n ≤ f r := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr_le, hr_max⟩ := exists_argmax_le f n
  refine ⟨r, hr_le, ?_, hr_max n (le_refl n)⟩
  intro k hk
  exact hr_max k (hk.trans hr_le)

lemma prefix_max_eq_f_zero_of_f_one_eq_zero (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (h1 : f 1 = 0) :
    ∀ r : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f r → f r = f 0 := by
  have key : ∀ r : ℕ, ∀ r' : ℕ, r' ≤ r → IsPrefixMaximum f r' → f r' = f 0 := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero =>
      intro r' hr' _
      have hz : r' = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hr'
      subst hz
      rfl
    | succ r ih =>
      intro r' hr' hpm
      rcases hr'.eq_or_lt with heq | hlt
      · subst heq
        have heq2 : f (r + 1) = f r + f 1 := hadd r 1 hpm
        rw [h1, add_zero] at heq2
        have hpm_r : IsPrefixMaximum f r := by
          intro k hk
          have hk' : k ≤ r + 1 := hk.trans (Nat.le_succ r)
          have hle := hpm k hk'
          rw [heq2] at hle
          exact hle
        have hindr := ih r (le_refl r) hpm_r
        rw [heq2]
        exact hindr
      · have hle : r' ≤ r := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hlt
        exact ih r' hle hpm
  intro r hr
  exact key r r (le_refl r) hr

    (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) :
    0 < f 1 := by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have h1 : f 1 = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp h
  have hpm_eq := prefix_max_eq_f_zero_of_f_one_eq_zero f hadd h1
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hunbounded 1
  obtain ⟨r, hr_le, hr_max, hr_ge⟩ := exists_prefix_max_ge f n
  have hr0 : f r = f 0 := hpm_eq r hr_max
  rw [hr0, hf0] at hr_ge
  omega

lemma record_step (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : IsPrefixMaximum f s) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < s) :
    f k + f (s - k) = f (k + 1) + f (s - k - 1) := by
  have heq1 : k + (s - k) = s := by omega
  have heq2 : (k + 1) + (s - k - 1) = s := by omega
  have h1 := hadd k (s - k) (by rw [heq1]; exact hs)
  have h2 := hadd (k + 1) (s - k - 1) (by rw [heq2]; exact hs)
  rw [heq1] at h1
  rw [heq2] at h2
  exact h1.symm.trans h2

lemma prefix_max_split (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : IsPrefixMaximum f s) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ s → f k + f (s - k) = f s := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    simp [hf0]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hk
    have hk' : k ≤ s := by omega
    have hklt : k < s := by omega
    have step := record_step f hadd s hs k hklt
    have ihk := ih hk'
    have heq : s - (k + 1) = s - k - 1 := by omega
    rw [heq]
    omega

lemma shift_identity (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hs : IsPrefixMaximum f s) (ht : IsPrefixMaximum f t) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ s → f (t - s + k) + f s = f t + f k := by
  intro k hk
  have h1 : f k + f (s - k) = f s := prefix_max_split f hadd hf0 s hs k hk
  have hsk_le_s : s - k ≤ s := Nat.sub_le s k
  have hsk_le_t : s - k ≤ t := hsk_le_s.trans hst
  have h2 : f (s - k) + f (t - (s - k)) = f t :=
    prefix_max_split f hadd hf0 t ht (s - k) hsk_le_t
  have heq : t - (s - k) = t - s + k := by omega
  rw [heq] at h2
  omega

lemma exists_next_record (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (r : ℕ) :
    ∃ t : ℕ, r < t ∧ f r < f t := by
  obtain ⟨r0, hr0_le, hr0_max⟩ := exists_argmax_le f r
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hunbounded (f r0 + 1)
  have hn_gt : r < n := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hle := hr0_max n h
    omega
  refine ⟨n, hn_gt, ?_⟩
  have hfr_le : f r ≤ f r0 := hr0_max r (le_refl r)
  omega

def recordTime (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 0
  | (i + 1) => Nat.find (exists_next_record f hunbounded (recordTime f hunbounded i))

lemma recordTime_zero (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) :
    recordTime f hunbounded 0 = 0 := rfl

lemma recordTime_succ (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) :
    recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) =
      Nat.find (exists_next_record f hunbounded (recordTime f hunbounded i)) := rfl

lemma recordTime_succ_spec (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) :
    recordTime f hunbounded i < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) ∧
      f (recordTime f hunbounded i) < f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) := by
  rw [recordTime_succ]
  exact Nat.find_spec (exists_next_record f hunbounded (recordTime f hunbounded i))

lemma recordTime_min (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ)
    (hj_lt : j < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) (hj_gt : recordTime f hunbounded i < j) :
    f j ≤ f (recordTime f hunbounded i) := by
  rw [recordTime_succ] at hj_lt
  have hnotP := Nat.find_min (exists_next_record f hunbounded (recordTime f hunbounded i)) hj_lt
  push_neg at hnotP
  exact hnotP hj_gt

lemma recordTime_isPrefixMaximum (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) :
    ∀ i : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (recordTime f hunbounded i) := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
      rw [recordTime_zero]
      intro k hk
      have hk0 : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hk
      subst hk0
      exact le_refl _
  | succ i ih =>
      intro k hk
      rcases hk.eq_or_lt with hkeq | hklt
      · subst hkeq
        exact le_refl _
      · by_cases hkr : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i
        · have hfk := ih k hkr
          have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
          omega
        · push_neg at hkr
          have hle := recordTime_min f hunbounded i k hklt hkr
          have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
          omega

lemma recordTime_lt_of_lt (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : k < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) :
    f k < f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) := by
  by_cases hkr : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i
  · have hfk := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i k hkr
    have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
    omega
  · push_neg at hkr
    have hle := recordTime_min f hunbounded i k hk hkr
    have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
    omega

lemma recordTime_strict (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) :
    ∀ i k : ℕ, k < recordTime f hunbounded i → f k < f (recordTime f hunbounded i) := by
  intro i
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      intro k hk
      rw [recordTime_zero] at hk
      exact absurd hk (Nat.not_lt_zero k)
  | succ j =>
      intro k hk
      exact recordTime_lt_of_lt f hunbounded j k hk

lemma recordTime_shift_eq (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i + k) =
      f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) - f (recordTime f hunbounded i) + f k := by
  have hst : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) :=
    le_of_lt (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).1
  have hs := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i
  have ht := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded (i + 1)
  have heq := shift_identity f hadd hf0 (recordTime f hunbounded i)
    (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) hst hs ht k hk
  have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
  omega

lemma recordTime_shift_lt (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i k : ℕ) (hk : k < recordTime f hunbounded i) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i + k) <
      f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) := by
  have heq := recordTime_shift_eq f hunbounded hadd hf0 i k (le_of_lt hk)
  have hklt := recordTime_strict f hunbounded i k hk
  have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2
  omega

lemma recordTime_mono (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) :
    ∀ j : ℕ, i ≤ j → recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j := by
  intro j hij
  induction j, hij using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact le_refl _
  | succ n hn ih =>
    have hlt := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded n).1
    omega

lemma recordTime_diff_add (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (h i j : ℕ) (hhi : h ≤ i) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded h) =
      f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i) +
      f (recordTime f hunbounded i - recordTime f hunbounded h) := by
  set rh := recordTime f hunbounded h with hrh_def
  set ri := recordTime f hunbounded i with hri_def
  set rj := recordTime f hunbounded j with hrj_def
  have hri_rj : ri ≤ rj := recordTime_mono f hunbounded i j hij
  have hrh_ri : rh ≤ ri := recordTime_mono f hunbounded h i hhi
  have hs_i : IsPrefixMaximum f ri := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i
  have ht_j : IsPrefixMaximum f rj := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded j
  have hk_le : ri - rh ≤ ri := Nat.sub_le ri rh
  have heq1 := shift_identity f hadd hf0 ri rj hri_rj hs_i ht_j (ri - rh) hk_le
  have heq2 := shift_identity f hadd hf0 ri rj hri_rj hs_i ht_j 0 (Nat.zero_le ri)
  simp [hf0] at heq2
  have hsum : rj - ri + (ri - rh) = rj - rh := by omega
  rw [hsum] at heq1
  omega

lemma recordTime_shift_lt_general (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < recordTime f hunbounded i) :

  have hst : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j :=
    recordTime_mono f hunbounded i j hij
  have hs := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i
  have ht := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded j
  have hk_le : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i := le_of_lt hk
  have heq := shift_identity f hadd hf0 (recordTime f hunbounded i) (recordTime f hunbounded j)
    hst hs ht k hk_le
  have hfk_lt := recordTime_strict f hunbounded i k hk
  omega

lemma recordTime_shift_eq_general (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + k) =
      f (recordTime f hunbounded j) - f (recordTime f hunbounded i) + f k := by
  have hst : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j :=
    recordTime_mono f hunbounded i j hij
  have hs := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded i
  have ht := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded j
  have heq := shift_identity f hadd hf0 (recordTime f hunbounded i) (recordTime f hunbounded j)

    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < recordTime f hunbounded i) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + k + 1) -

      f (k + 1) - f k := by

  have hk0 : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded i := le_of_lt hk
  have heq1 := recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 i j hij k hk0
  have heq2 := recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 i j hij (k + 1) hk1
  have hshift : recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + (k + 1) =
      recordTime f hunbounded j - recordTime f hunbounded i + k + 1 := by omega
  rw [hshift] at heq2
  omega

    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)

    (p : ℕ) (hp_def : p = recordTime f hunbounded (j + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded j)

  have hri_rj : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j :=
    recordTime_mono f hunbounded i j hij
  have hrj_lt : recordTime f hunbounded j < recordTime f hunbounded (j + 1) :=
    (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded j).1

  have hk_lt : k < recordTime f hunbounded i := by omega
  have h1 := recordTime_diff_shift_step f hunbounded hadd hf0 i j hij (k + p) hkp_lt
  have h2 := recordTime_diff_shift_step f hunbounded hadd hf0 i (j + 1)

    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i : ℕ) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1 + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) ≤

  set rJ := recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) with hrJ_def
  set rK := recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1 + 1) with hrK_def

  have hij2 : i + 1 ≤ i + 1 + 1 := Nat.le_succ (i + 1)

  have hrJ_lt_rK : rJ < rK := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded (i + 1)).1

    recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 (i + 1) (i + 1 + 1) hij2 0 (Nat.zero_le rJ)

    recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 (i + 1) (i + 1 + 1) hij2 rI (le_of_lt hrI_lt_rJ)

    recordTime_shift_eq_general f hunbounded hadd hf0 i (i + 1) hij1 0 (Nat.zero_le rI)

  have hle : f (rK - rJ + rI) ≤ f rJ := by
    by_cases hcase : rK - rJ + rI ≤ rJ
    · exact recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded (i + 1) (rK - rJ + rI) hcase
    · push_neg at hcase
      exact recordTime_min f hunbounded (i + 1) (rK - rJ + rI) ht_lt_rK hcase
  have hfI_le_fJ : f rI ≤ f rJ := recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded (i + 1) rI (le_of_lt hrI_lt_rJ)
  omega

def recordDiff (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) - f (recordTime f hunbounded i)

lemma recordDiff_eq_f_sub (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (i : ℕ) :
    f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) = recordDiff f hunbounded i := by
  have h := recordTime_shift_eq f hunbounded hadd hf0 i 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
  simp only [add_zero, hf0] at h

lemma recordDiff_pos (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f) (i : ℕ) :

  unfold recordDiff
  have h := (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).2

lemma recordDiff_antitone (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)

lemma recordTime_stable_sum (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (c J : ℕ) (hstable : ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c)

  | succ n ih =>

lemma f_pos_on_pos (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)

    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (c J : ℕ) (_hc_pos : 0 < c) (_hJ_pos : 0 < J)
    (hstable_prop : ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c)
    (a : ℕ) (ha_pos : 0 < a) (ha_eq : f a = c)
    (ha_min : ∀ b : ℕ, 0 < b → f b = c → a ≤ b) :
    ∃ J1 : ℕ, ∀ i : ℕ, J1 ≤ i → recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i = a := by

  have hiJ : J ≤ i := le_trans (le_max_left J a) hi

    (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded i).1
  have hL_pos : 0 < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i := by omega
  have hL_eq : f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) = c := by
    have h := recordDiff_eq_f_sub f hunbounded hadd hf0 i
    rw [hstable_prop i hiJ] at h
    exact h
  have ha_le_L : a ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i :=
    ha_min _ hL_pos hL_eq
  have hrle : recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i ≤
      recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) := Nat.sub_le _ _
  have ha_le_s : a ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) := by omega
  have hsplit := prefix_max_split f hadd hf0 (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1))
    (recordTime_isPrefixMaximum f hunbounded (i + 1)) a ha_le_s
  have hsum : f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1)) =
      f (recordTime f hunbounded i) + recordDiff f hunbounded i :=
    recordDiff_add_eq f hunbounded i
  rw [hstable_prop i hiJ] at hsum
  have hfsa : f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a) = f (recordTime f hunbounded i) := by
    rw [ha_eq] at hsplit
    omega
  have ht_eq : recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a =
      recordTime f hunbounded i +
        ((recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) - a) := by omega
  have ht_ge : recordTime f hunbounded i ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a := by omega
  have ht_lt : recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a < recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) := by omega
  have hpm_t : IsPrefixMaximum f (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a) :=
    prefix_max_of_gap_eq f hunbounded i (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - a) ht_ge ht_lt hfsa
  rw [ht_eq] at hpm_t

    ((recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) - a) hpm_t
  rw [← ht_eq] at hadd_eq
  rw [hfsa] at hadd_eq
  have hfzero : f ((recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) - a) = 0 := by
    omega
  by_contra hne
  have hLa_pos : 0 < (recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i) - a := by
    omega
  have hpos := f_pos_on_pos f hunbounded hadd hf0 _ hLa_pos
  omega

lemma recordTime_diff_stable_sum (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (a J1 : ℕ) (hJ1 : ∀ i : ℕ, J1 ≤ i → recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i = a)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : J1 ≤ j) :
    ∀ l : ℕ, recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) - recordTime f hunbounded j = l * a := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | zero => simp
  | succ l ih =>
    have hjl : J1 ≤ j + l := by omega
    have hgap := hJ1 (j + l) hjl
    have hmono1 : recordTime f hunbounded j ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) :=
      recordTime_mono f hunbounded j (j + l) (Nat.le_add_right j l)
    have hmono2 : recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) ≤ recordTime f hunbounded (j + l + 1) :=
      le_of_lt (recordTime_succ_spec f hunbounded (j + l)).1
    have hstep1 : recordTime f hunbounded (j + l + 1) = recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) + a := by
      omega
    have hstep2 : recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) = recordTime f hunbounded j + l * a := by
      omega
    have hshift : j + (l + 1) = j + l + 1 := by ring
    rw [hshift, hstep1, hstep2]
    have hmul : (l + 1) * a = l * a + a := by ring
    omega

lemma f_period_additive (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hunbounded : IsUnboundedNatFunction f)
    (hadd : ∀ m n : ℕ, IsPrefixMaximum f (m + n) → f (m + n) = f m + f n)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (c J : ℕ) (hstable_prop : ∀ j : ℕ, J ≤ j → recordDiff f hunbounded j = c)
    (a J1 : ℕ) (hJ1 : ∀ i : ℕ, J1 ≤ i → recordTime f hunbounded (i + 1) - recordTime f hunbounded i = a) :
    ∀ k l : ℕ, f (k + l * a) = f k + l * c := by
  intro k l
  set j := max (max J1 J) k with hj_def
  have hjJ1 : J1 ≤ j := le_trans (le_max_left J1 J) (le_max_left (max J1 J) k)
  have hjJ : J ≤ j := le_trans (le_max_right J1 J) (le_max_left (max J1 J) k)
  have hjk : k ≤ j := le_max_right (max J1 J) k
  have hrj_ge_j : j ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j := recordTime_ge_index f hunbounded j
  have hrj_ge_k : k ≤ recordTime f hunbounded j := le_trans hjk hrj_ge_j
  have hgapsum : recordTime f hunbounded (j + l) - recordTime f hunbounded j = l * a :=
    recordTime_diff_stable_sum f hunbounded a J1 hJ1 j hjJ1 l
  have hshift := record_diff_shift_stable_eq f hunbounded hadd hf0 c J hstable_prop j hjJ l k hrj_ge_k
  rw [hgapsum] at hshift
  have goal_eq : k + l * a = l * a + k := by ring
  rw [goal_eq, hshift]
  ring
