      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 < b → f a = f b → a = b := by
  intro a b ha hb hfab
  have hffa := f_f_eq f hpos hineq a ha
  have hffb := f_f_eq f hpos hineq b hb
  rw [hfab] at hffa
  linarith

lemma seq_diff_eq (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    (∀ n, 0 < a n) ∧ ∀ n, a (n + 2) - a (n + 1) = a (n + 1) - a n := by
  have hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => rw [ha0]; exact hx
    | succ k ih => rw [haS k]; exact hpos (a k) ih
  refine ⟨hapos, ?_⟩
  intro n
  have h := f_f_eq f hpos hineq (a n) (hapos n)
  have e1 : a (n + 2) = f (f (a n)) := by
    rw [haS (n + 1), haS n]
  have e2 : a (n + 1) = f (a n) := haS n
  rw [e1, e2, h]
  ring

def funcIter (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => x
  | n + 1 => f (funcIter f x n)

lemma f_ge_id (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → f x ≥ x := by
  intro x hx
  have ha0 : funcIter f x 0 = x := by rfl
  have haS : ∀ n, funcIter f x (n + 1) = f (funcIter f x n) := fun n => by rfl
  obtain ⟨hapos, hdiff⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) ha0 haS
  set d : ℝ := funcIter f x 1 - funcIter f x 0 with hd_def
  have h1 : funcIter f x 1 = f x := by
    show funcIter f x (0 + 1) = f x
    rw [haS 0, ha0]
  have hd_eq : d = f x - x := by
    rw [hd_def, h1, ha0]
  have hconst : ∀ n, funcIter f x (n + 1) - funcIter f x n = d := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hd_def.symm
    | succ k ih =>
      have h := hdiff k
      rw [ih] at h
      exact h
  have hformula : ∀ n : ℕ, funcIter f x n = x + (n : ℝ) * d := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [ha0]
    | succ k ih =>
      have hk := hconst k
      have hstep : funcIter f x (k + 1) = funcIter f x k + d := by linarith
      rw [hstep, ih]
      push_cast
      ring
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hd_neg : d < 0 := by rw [hd_eq]; linarith
  have hnegd : 0 < -d := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (x / (-d))
  have hn' : x < (n : ℝ) * (-d) := (div_lt_iff₀ hnegd).mp hn
  rw [mul_neg] at hn'
  have hxn : x + (n : ℝ) * d < 0 := by linarith
  have hpos_n := hapos n
  rw [hformula n] at hpos_n
  linarith

lemma seq_diff_const (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n, a (n + 1) - a n = f x - x := by
  obtain ⟨hapos, hdiff⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  have hd0 : a 1 - a 0 = f x - x := by
    rw [haS 0, ha0]
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hd0
  | succ k ih =>
    have h := hdiff k
    rw [ih] at h
    linarith

lemma seq_formula (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, a n = x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
  have hdiff := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [ha0]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk := hdiff k
    have hstep : a (k + 1) = a k + (f x - x) := by linarith
    rw [hstep, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

lemma d_bounds (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) ∧
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≥ -2 * ((x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y)) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hineq x y hx hy
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith

lemma d_lipschitz (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ |x - f y| := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hfy := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have claimA : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2 ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ (f y) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hx.le hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hfy.le hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  have claimB : (x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : x ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (f y) ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma amqm_ge (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  linarith

lemma amgm_le (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : u * v ≤ ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  exact h2

lemma d_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hb := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have hxb : 0 < x + f y := by linarith
  have hs_ge : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amqm_ge x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hg_le : Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amgm_le x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hg_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs2 : (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2)) ^ 2 = (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hg2 : (Real.sqrt (x * f y)) ^ 2 = x * f y :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hkeyA : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) *
      (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) :=
    mul_nonneg hs_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hkeyB : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) * ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :=
    mul_nonneg hg_nonneg (by linarith)
  have claimA' : (2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y)) * (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hkeyA, hs2]
  have claimB' : ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) * (x + f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hkeyB, hg2]
  have claimA : 2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimA'
  have claimB : (x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimB'
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma seq_diff_lipschitz_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        |(x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))| := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hlip := d_lipschitz f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hlip
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hlip
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hlip
  push_cast at hlip
  simpa using hlip

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)
    (han : y < x + (n : ℝ) * dx) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      0 ≤ (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ∧
      (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) < dy ∧
      x + (n : ℝ) * dx ≤ y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy ∧
      2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ≤ (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) := by
  have hc : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y := by linarith
  set c : ℝ := (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y with hc_def
  have hk_pos : 0 < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (div_pos hc hdy)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hk_pos
  have hm' : ⌈c / dy⌉₊ = m + 1 := by omega
  have hm_lt : m < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := by omega
  have hub : (m : ℝ) < c / dy := Nat.lt_ceil.mp hm_lt
  have hlb : c / dy ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil (c / dy)
    rw [hm'] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  have h2 : c / dy * dy = c := div_mul_cancel₀ c hdy.ne'
  have hA : (m : ℝ) * dy < c := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hub hdy
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hB : c ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

lemma seq_diff_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hrb := d_refined_bound f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hrb
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hrb
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hrb
  push_cast at hrb
  simpa using hrb

lemma dy_bound_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdy : 0 < f y - y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by
  obtain ⟨m, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_m_bound (f x - x) (f y - y) x y hdy n hn
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hrb := seq_diff_refined_bound f hpos hineq x y hx hy n m
  have han_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hbm_pos : 0 < y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by linarith
  have hpos_an2 : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hpos_sum : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) := by linarith
  have hstep_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ((f y - y) - ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) *
          ((f y - y) + ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]
  have hstep1 :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :
      (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (sq_nonneg (f y - y))
  have hcross :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
    linarith
  have hfrac :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    (div_le_div_iff₀ hpos_sum hpos_an2).mpr hcross
  exact le_trans hrb hfrac

lemma d_zero_lt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → f x - x = 0 → 0 < f y - y → x < y := by
  intro x y hx hy hdx0 hdypos
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hxy : 0 ≤ x - y := by linarith

lemma d_bounds (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)

  intro x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hineq x y hx hy
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith

lemma d_lipschitz (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ |x - f y| := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hfy := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have claimA : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2 ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ (f y) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hx.le hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hfy.le hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  have claimB : (x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : x ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]

      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (f y) ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma amqm_ge (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  linarith

lemma amgm_le (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : u * v ≤ ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  exact h2

lemma d_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :

    amgm_le x (f y) hx.le hb.le

  have hg_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

    mul_nonneg hg_nonneg (by linarith)

      (x - f y) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hkeyA, hs2]
  have claimB' : ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) * (x + f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hkeyB, hg2]

    (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimB'
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        |(x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))| := by
  intro x y hx hy n m

  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)

  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hlip
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hlip
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hlip
  push_cast at hlip
  simpa using hlip

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)
    (han : y < x + (n : ℝ) * dx) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      0 ≤ (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ∧
      (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) < dy ∧
      x + (n : ℝ) * dx ≤ y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy ∧
      2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ≤ (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) := by
  have hc : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y := by linarith
  set c : ℝ := (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y with hc_def
  have hk_pos : 0 < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (div_pos hc hdy)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hk_pos

  have hm_lt : m < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := by omega
  have hub : (m : ℝ) < c / dy := Nat.lt_ceil.mp hm_lt
  have hlb : c / dy ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil (c / dy)
    rw [hm'] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  have h2 : c / dy * dy = c := div_mul_cancel₀ c hdy.ne'
  have hA : (m : ℝ) * dy < c := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hub hdy
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hB : c ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

    rw [h2] at h1

    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

lemma seq_diff_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)

      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧

  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)

  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)

  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)

  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hrb
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hrb
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hrb
  push_cast at hrb

lemma dy_bound_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)

    ∃ m : ℕ, |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by

          ((f y - y) + ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]
  have hstep1 :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *

        (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :
      (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *

      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *

    linarith

    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_lt hdypos
    rw [heq] at h

  rw [abs_of_pos hdypos] at hlip
  have hle0 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) - x ≤ 0 := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hle0] at hlip
  linarith

  have hn3 : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by

  have hxn_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have h2an_pos : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith

  rw [heq] at hC
  have hcompare : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) <

  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := dy_bound_exists f hpos hineq x y hx hy hdy n hn1
  linarith

    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1

    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

lemma dy_bound_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)

    ∃ m : ℕ, |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by

    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]

      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :
      (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *

lemma d_zero_lt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →

  push_neg at hcon
  have hxy : 0 ≤ x - y := by linarith
  have hN_le : (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (x - y) / (f y - y) :=

    rw [heq] at h

    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_lt hdypos
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith

  rw [hdx0] at hlip
  simp only [sub_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlip
  rw [abs_of_pos hdypos] at hlip
  have hle0 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) - x ≤ 0 := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hle0] at hlip
  linarith

  have hn3 : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by

  have hxn_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have h2an_pos : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith

  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hd_neg : d < 0 := by rw [hd_eq]; linarith
  have hnegd : 0 < -d := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (x / (-d))
  have hn' : x < (n : ℝ) * (-d) := (div_lt_iff₀ hnegd).mp hn
  rw [mul_neg] at hn'
  have hxn : x + (n : ℝ) * d < 0 := by linarith
  have hpos_n := hapos n
  rw [hformula n] at hpos_n
  linarith

lemma seq_diff_const (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n, a (n + 1) - a n = f x - x := by
  obtain ⟨hapos, hdiff⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  have hd0 : a 1 - a 0 = f x - x := by
    rw [haS 0, ha0]
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hd0
  | succ k ih =>
    have h := hdiff k
    rw [ih] at h
    linarith

lemma seq_formula (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, a n = x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
  have hdiff := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [ha0]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk := hdiff k
    have hstep : a (k + 1) = a k + (f x - x) := by linarith
    rw [hstep, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

lemma d_bounds (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) ∧
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≥ -2 * ((x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y)) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hineq x y hx hy
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith

lemma d_lipschitz (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ |x - f y| := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hfy := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have claimA : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2 ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ (f y) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hx.le hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hfy.le hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  have claimB : (x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : x ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (f y) ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma amqm_ge (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  linarith

lemma amgm_le (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : u * v ≤ ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  exact h2

lemma d_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hb := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have hxb : 0 < x + f y := by linarith
  have hs_ge : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amqm_ge x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hg_le : Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amgm_le x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hg_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs2 : (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2)) ^ 2 = (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hg2 : (Real.sqrt (x * f y)) ^ 2 = x * f y :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hkeyA : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) *
      (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) :=
    mul_nonneg hs_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hkeyB : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) * ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :=
    mul_nonneg hg_nonneg (by linarith)
  have claimA' : (2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y)) * (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hkeyA, hs2]
  have claimB' : ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) * (x + f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hkeyB, hg2]
  have claimA : 2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimA'
  have claimB : (x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimB'
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma seq_diff_lipschitz_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        |(x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))| := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hlip := d_lipschitz f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hlip
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hlip
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hlip
  push_cast at hlip
  simpa using hlip

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)
    (han : y < x + (n : ℝ) * dx) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      0 ≤ (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ∧
      (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) < dy ∧
      x + (n : ℝ) * dx ≤ y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy ∧
      2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ≤ (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) := by
  have hc : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y := by linarith
  set c : ℝ := (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y with hc_def
  have hk_pos : 0 < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (div_pos hc hdy)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hk_pos
  have hm' : ⌈c / dy⌉₊ = m + 1 := by omega
  have hm_lt : m < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := by omega
  have hub : (m : ℝ) < c / dy := Nat.lt_ceil.mp hm_lt
  have hlb : c / dy ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil (c / dy)
    rw [hm'] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  have h2 : c / dy * dy = c := div_mul_cancel₀ c hdy.ne'
  have hA : (m : ℝ) * dy < c := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hub hdy
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hB : c ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

lemma seq_diff_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hrb := d_refined_bound f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hrb
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hrb
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hrb
  push_cast at hrb
  simpa using hrb

lemma dy_bound_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdy : 0 < f y - y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by
  obtain ⟨m, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_m_bound (f x - x) (f y - y) x y hdy n hn
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hrb := seq_diff_refined_bound f hpos hineq x y hx hy n m
  have han_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hbm_pos : 0 < y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by linarith
  have hpos_an2 : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hpos_sum : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) := by linarith
  have hstep_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ((f y - y) - ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) *
          ((f y - y) + ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]
  have hstep1 :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :
      (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (sq_nonneg (f y - y))
  have hcross :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
    linarith
  have hfrac :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    (div_le_div_iff₀ hpos_sum hpos_an2).mpr hcross
  exact le_trans hrb hfrac

lemma d_zero_lt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → f x - x = 0 → 0 < f y - y → x < y := by
  intro x y hx hy hdx0 hdypos
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hxy : 0 ≤ x - y := by linarith
  have hN_le : (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (x - y) / (f y - y) :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hxy hdypos.le)
  have hN_lt : (x - y) / (f y - y) < (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  set N : ℕ := ⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ with hN_def
  have heq : (x - y) / (f y - y) * (f y - y) = x - y :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ (x - y) hdypos.ne'
  have hN1 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) ≤ x := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN_le hdypos.le
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hN2 : x < y + ((N : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_lt hdypos
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hlip := seq_diff_lipschitz_bound f hpos hineq y x hy hx N 0
  rw [hdx0] at hlip
  simp only [sub_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlip
  rw [abs_of_pos hdypos] at hlip
  have hle0 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) - x ≤ 0 := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hle0] at hlip
  linarith

lemma d_eq_of_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdx : 0 < f x - x) (hdy : 0 < f y - y) :
    f x - x = f y - y := by
  by_contra hne
  have habs_pos : 0 < |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  have habs2_pos : 0 < 2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max ((y - x) / (f x - x))
      (((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x)))
  have hnA : (y - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hn
  have hnB : ((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hn
  have hA := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnA
  have hB := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnB
  have hn1 : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hn3 : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
    linarith
  have hxn_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have h2an_pos : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hC := (div_lt_iff₀ habs2_pos).mp hn3

lemma seq_diff_lipschitz_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        |(x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))| := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hlip := d_lipschitz f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hlip
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hlip
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hlip
  push_cast at hlip
  simpa using hlip

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)
    (han : y < x + (n : ℝ) * dx) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      0 ≤ (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ∧
      (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) < dy ∧
      x + (n : ℝ) * dx ≤ y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy ∧
      2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ≤ (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) := by
  have hc : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y := by linarith
  set c : ℝ := (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y with hc_def
  have hk_pos : 0 < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (div_pos hc hdy)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hk_pos
  have hm' : ⌈c / dy⌉₊ = m + 1 := by omega
  have hm_lt : m < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := by omega
  have hub : (m : ℝ) < c / dy := Nat.lt_ceil.mp hm_lt
  have hlb : c / dy ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil (c / dy)
    rw [hm'] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  have h2 : c / dy * dy = c := div_mul_cancel₀ c hdy.ne'
  have hA : (m : ℝ) * dy < c := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hub hdy
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hB : c ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

lemma seq_diff_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)

  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl

lemma dy_bound_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdy : 0 < f y - y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by
  obtain ⟨m, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_m_bound (f x - x) (f y - y) x y hdy n hn
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hrb := seq_diff_refined_bound f hpos hineq x y hx hy n m
  have han_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hbm_pos : 0 < y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by linarith
  have hpos_an2 : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hpos_sum : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) := by linarith
  have hstep_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ((f y - y) - ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) *
          ((f y - y) + ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]
  have hstep1 :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :
      (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (sq_nonneg (f y - y))
  have hcross :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
    linarith
  have hfrac :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    (div_le_div_iff₀ hpos_sum hpos_an2).mpr hcross
  exact le_trans hrb hfrac

lemma d_zero_lt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → f x - x = 0 → 0 < f y - y → x < y := by
  intro x y hx hy hdx0 hdypos
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hxy : 0 ≤ x - y := by linarith
  have hN_le : (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (x - y) / (f y - y) :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hxy hdypos.le)
  have hN_lt : (x - y) / (f y - y) < (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  set N : ℕ := ⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ with hN_def
  have heq : (x - y) / (f y - y) * (f y - y) = x - y :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ (x - y) hdypos.ne'
  have hN1 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) ≤ x := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN_le hdypos.le
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hN2 : x < y + ((N : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_lt hdypos
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hlip := seq_diff_lipschitz_bound f hpos hineq y x hy hx N 0
  rw [hdx0] at hlip
  simp only [sub_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlip
  rw [abs_of_pos hdypos] at hlip
  have hle0 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) - x ≤ 0 := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hle0] at hlip
  linarith

lemma d_eq_of_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdx : 0 < f x - x) (hdy : 0 < f y - y) :

  have habs_pos : 0 < |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  have habs2_pos : 0 < 2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max ((y - x) / (f x - x))
      (((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x)))
  have hnA : (y - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hn
  have hnB : ((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hn
  have hA := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnA
  have hB := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnB
  have hn1 : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hn3 : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
    linarith
  have hxn_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have h2an_pos : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hC := (div_lt_iff₀ habs2_pos).mp hn3
  have heq : (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) * (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) =
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by ring
  rw [heq] at hC
  have hcompare : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) <
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := (div_lt_iff₀ h2an_pos).mpr hC
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := dy_bound_exists f hpos hineq x y hx hy hdy n hn1
  linarith

lemma d_pos_on_ge (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →

  have hlt := d_zero_lt f hpos hineq x y0 hx hy0 hzero hdy0

  have hxn : x + (n : ℝ) * d < 0 := by linarith
  have hpos_n := hapos n
  rw [hformula n] at hpos_n
  linarith

lemma seq_diff_const (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n, a (n + 1) - a n = f x - x := by
  obtain ⟨hapos, hdiff⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  have hd0 : a 1 - a 0 = f x - x := by
    rw [haS 0, ha0]
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hd0
  | succ k ih =>
    have h := hdiff k
    rw [ih] at h
    linarith

lemma seq_formula (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, a n = x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
  have hdiff := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [ha0]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk := hdiff k
    have hstep : a (k + 1) = a k + (f x - x) := by linarith
    rw [hstep, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

lemma d_bounds (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) ∧
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≥ -2 * ((x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y)) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hineq x y hx hy
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith

lemma d_lipschitz (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ |x - f y| := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hfy := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have claimA : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2 ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ (f y) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hx.le hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hfy.le hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  have claimB : (x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : x ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (f y) ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma amqm_ge (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  linarith

lemma amgm_le (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : u * v ≤ ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  exact h2

lemma d_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hb := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have hxb : 0 < x + f y := by linarith
  have hs_ge : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amqm_ge x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hg_le : Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amgm_le x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hg_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs2 : (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2)) ^ 2 = (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hg2 : (Real.sqrt (x * f y)) ^ 2 = x * f y :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hkeyA : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) *
      (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) :=
    mul_nonneg hs_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hkeyB : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) * ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :=
    mul_nonneg hg_nonneg (by linarith)
  have claimA' : (2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y)) * (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hkeyA, hs2]
  have claimB' : ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) * (x + f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hkeyB, hg2]
  have claimA : 2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimA'
  have claimB : (x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimB'
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma seq_diff_lipschitz_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        |(x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))| := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hlip := d_lipschitz f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hlip
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hlip
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hlip
  push_cast at hlip
  simpa using hlip

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)
    (han : y < x + (n : ℝ) * dx) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      0 ≤ (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ∧
      (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) < dy ∧
      x + (n : ℝ) * dx ≤ y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy ∧
      2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ≤ (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) := by
  have hc : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y := by linarith
  set c : ℝ := (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y with hc_def
  have hk_pos : 0 < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (div_pos hc hdy)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hk_pos
  have hm' : ⌈c / dy⌉₊ = m + 1 := by omega
  have hm_lt : m < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := by omega
  have hub : (m : ℝ) < c / dy := Nat.lt_ceil.mp hm_lt
  have hlb : c / dy ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil (c / dy)
    rw [hm'] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  have h2 : c / dy * dy = c := div_mul_cancel₀ c hdy.ne'
  have hA : (m : ℝ) * dy < c := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hub hdy
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hB : c ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

lemma seq_diff_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hrb := d_refined_bound f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hrb
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hrb
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hrb
  push_cast at hrb
  simpa using hrb

lemma dy_bound_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdy : 0 < f y - y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by
  obtain ⟨m, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_m_bound (f x - x) (f y - y) x y hdy n hn
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hrb := seq_diff_refined_bound f hpos hineq x y hx hy n m
  have han_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hbm_pos : 0 < y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by linarith
  have hpos_an2 : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hpos_sum : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) := by linarith
  have hstep_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ((f y - y) - ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) *
          ((f y - y) + ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]
  have hstep1 :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :
      (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (sq_nonneg (f y - y))
  have hcross :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
    linarith
  have hfrac :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    (div_le_div_iff₀ hpos_sum hpos_an2).mpr hcross
  exact le_trans hrb hfrac

lemma d_zero_lt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → f x - x = 0 → 0 < f y - y → x < y := by
  intro x y hx hy hdx0 hdypos
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hxy : 0 ≤ x - y := by linarith
  have hN_le : (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (x - y) / (f y - y) :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hxy hdypos.le)
  have hN_lt : (x - y) / (f y - y) < (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  set N : ℕ := ⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ with hN_def
  have heq : (x - y) / (f y - y) * (f y - y) = x - y :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ (x - y) hdypos.ne'
  have hN1 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) ≤ x := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN_le hdypos.le
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hN2 : x < y + ((N : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_lt hdypos
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hlip := seq_diff_lipschitz_bound f hpos hineq y x hy hx N 0
  rw [hdx0] at hlip
  simp only [sub_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlip
  rw [abs_of_pos hdypos] at hlip
  have hle0 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) - x ≤ 0 := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hle0] at hlip
  linarith

lemma d_eq_of_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdx : 0 < f x - x) (hdy : 0 < f y - y) :
    f x - x = f y - y := by
  by_contra hne
  have habs_pos : 0 < |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  have habs2_pos : 0 < 2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max ((y - x) / (f x - x))
      (((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x)))
  have hnA : (y - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hn
  have hnB : ((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hn
  have hA := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnA
  have hB := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnB
  have hn1 : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hn3 : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
    linarith
  have hxn_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have h2an_pos : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hC := (div_lt_iff₀ habs2_pos).mp hn3
  have heq : (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) * (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) =
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by ring
  rw [heq] at hC
  have hcompare : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) <

    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]
  have hstep1 :

    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :

lemma d_zero_lt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧

    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → f x - x = 0 → 0 < f y - y → x < y := by

  push_neg at hcon
  have hxy : 0 ≤ x - y := by linarith
  have hN_le : (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (x - y) / (f y - y) :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hxy hdypos.le)
  have hN_lt : (x - y) / (f y - y) < (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_floor_add_one _

  have heq : (x - y) / (f y - y) * (f y - y) = x - y :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ (x - y) hdypos.ne'
  have hN1 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) ≤ x := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN_le hdypos.le
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hN2 : x < y + ((N : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_lt hdypos
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hlip := seq_diff_lipschitz_bound f hpos hineq y x hy hx N 0
  rw [hdx0] at hlip
  simp only [sub_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlip
  rw [abs_of_pos hdypos] at hlip
  have hle0 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) - x ≤ 0 := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hle0] at hlip
  linarith

lemma d_eq_of_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →

  have habs_pos : 0 < |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  have habs2_pos : 0 < 2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max ((y - x) / (f x - x))
      (((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x)))
  have hnA : (y - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hn
  have hnB : ((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hn

  have hB := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnB

  have hn3 : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
    linarith
  have hxn_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have h2an_pos : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hC := (div_lt_iff₀ habs2_pos).mp hn3
  have heq : (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) * (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) =
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by ring
  rw [heq] at hC
  have hcompare : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) <

  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := dy_bound_exists f hpos hineq x y hx hy hdy n hn1
  linarith

lemma d_pos_on_ge (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)

      x + (n : ℝ) * dx ≤ y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy ∧

    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN_le hdypos.le

    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_lt hdypos
    rw [heq] at h
