  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [ha0]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk := hdiff k
    have hstep : a (k + 1) = a k + (f x - x) := by linarith
    rw [hstep, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

lemma d_bounds (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) ∧
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≥ -2 * ((x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y)) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hineq x y hx hy
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith

lemma d_lipschitz (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ |x - f y| := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hfy := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have claimA : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2 ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ (f y) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hx.le hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hfy.le hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  have claimB : (x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : x ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (f y) ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma amqm_ge (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  linarith

lemma amgm_le (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : u * v ≤ ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  exact h2

lemma d_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hb := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have hxb : 0 < x + f y := by linarith
  have hs_ge : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amqm_ge x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hg_le : Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amgm_le x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hg_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs2 : (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2)) ^ 2 = (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hg2 : (Real.sqrt (x * f y)) ^ 2 = x * f y :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hkeyA : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) *
      (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) :=
    mul_nonneg hs_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hkeyB : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) * ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :=
    mul_nonneg hg_nonneg (by linarith)
  have claimA' : (2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y)) * (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hkeyA, hs2]
  have claimB' : ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) * (x + f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hkeyB, hg2]
  have claimA : 2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimA'
  have claimB : (x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimB'
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma seq_diff_lipschitz_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        |(x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))| := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hlip := d_lipschitz f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hlip
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hlip
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hlip
  push_cast at hlip
  simpa using hlip

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)
    (han : y < x + (n : ℝ) * dx) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      0 ≤ (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ∧
      (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) < dy ∧
      x + (n : ℝ) * dx ≤ y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy ∧
      2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ≤ (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) := by
  have hc : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y := by linarith
  set c : ℝ := (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y with hc_def
  have hk_pos : 0 < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (div_pos hc hdy)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hk_pos
  have hm' : ⌈c / dy⌉₊ = m + 1 := by omega
  have hm_lt : m < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := by omega
  have hub : (m : ℝ) < c / dy := Nat.lt_ceil.mp hm_lt
  have hlb : c / dy ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil (c / dy)
    rw [hm'] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  have h2 : c / dy * dy = c := div_mul_cancel₀ c hdy.ne'
  have hA : (m : ℝ) * dy < c := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hub hdy
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hB : c ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

lemma seq_diff_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hrb := d_refined_bound f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hrb
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hrb
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hrb
  push_cast at hrb
  simpa using hrb

lemma dy_bound_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdy : 0 < f y - y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by
  obtain ⟨m, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_m_bound (f x - x) (f y - y) x y hdy n hn
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hrb := seq_diff_refined_bound f hpos hineq x y hx hy n m
  have han_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hbm_pos : 0 < y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by linarith
  have hpos_an2 : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hpos_sum : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) := by linarith
  have hstep_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ((f y - y) - ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) *
          ((f y - y) + ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]
  have hstep1 :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :
      (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (sq_nonneg (f y - y))
  have hcross :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
    linarith
  have hfrac :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    (div_le_div_iff₀ hpos_sum hpos_an2).mpr hcross
  exact le_trans hrb hfrac

lemma d_zero_lt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → f x - x = 0 → 0 < f y - y → x < y := by
  intro x y hx hy hdx0 hdypos
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hxy : 0 ≤ x - y := by linarith
  have hN_le : (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (x - y) / (f y - y) :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hxy hdypos.le)
  have hN_lt : (x - y) / (f y - y) < (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  set N : ℕ := ⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ with hN_def
  have heq : (x - y) / (f y - y) * (f y - y) = x - y :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ (x - y) hdypos.ne'
  have hN1 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) ≤ x := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN_le hdypos.le
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hN2 : x < y + ((N : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_lt hdypos
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hlip := seq_diff_lipschitz_bound f hpos hineq y x hy hx N 0
  rw [hdx0] at hlip
  simp only [sub_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlip
  rw [abs_of_pos hdypos] at hlip
  have hle0 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) - x ≤ 0 := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hle0] at hlip
  linarith

lemma d_eq_of_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdx : 0 < f x - x) (hdy : 0 < f y - y) :
    f x - x = f y - y := by
  by_contra hne
  have habs_pos : 0 < |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  have habs2_pos : 0 < 2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max ((y - x) / (f x - x))
      (((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x)))
  have hnA : (y - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hn
  have hnB : ((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hn
  have hA := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnA
  have hB := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnB
  have hn1 : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hn3 : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
    linarith
  have hxn_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have h2an_pos : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hC := (div_lt_iff₀ habs2_pos).mp hn3
  have heq : (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) * (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) =
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by ring
  rw [heq] at hC
  have hcompare : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) <
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := (div_lt_iff₀ h2an_pos).mpr hC
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := dy_bound_exists f hpos hineq x y hx hy hdy n hn1
  linarith

lemma d_pos_on_ge (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (y0 : ℝ) (hy0 : 0 < y0) (hdy0 : 0 < f y0 - y0) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, y0 ≤ x → 0 < f x - x := by
  intro x hxy0
  have hx : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hy0 hxy0
  have hge := f_ge_id f hpos hineq x hx
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ f x - x := by linarith
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hzero : f x - x = 0 := le_antisymm hcon hnonneg
  have hlt := d_zero_lt f hpos hineq x y0 hx hy0 hzero hdy0
  linarith

lemma linear_shift_satisfies (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < x + c) ∧
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (y + c) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ ((x + c) + y) / 2 ∧
      ((x + c) + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * (y + c)) := by
  refine ⟨fun x hx => by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro x y hx hy
  have hv : 0 ≤ y + c := by linarith
  have h1 := amqm_ge x (y + c) hx.le hv

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)

    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1

    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN_le hdypos.le
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith

    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_lt hdypos
    rw [heq] at h

  rw [abs_of_pos hdypos] at hlip
  have hle0 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) - x ≤ 0 := by linarith

lemma alpha_near_y_sq_lt (A y : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hy : 0 < y) :

  have hδ2 : δ ≤ A * y / (3 * A + y / 2) := min_le_right _ _
  have hpos3 : (0:ℝ) < 3 * A + y / 2 := by linarith

    apply lt_min

    have h : -(α - y) < δ := by linarith

    nlinarith [h2]

    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ1 hδpos.le]

  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ (A * y) hpos3.ne'] at hstep
  have hcombine : δ ^ 2 + 3 * A * δ ≤ A * y := by nlinarith [hδsq, hstep]
  have hfinal : (α - y) ^ 2 - 3 * A * (α - y) - 2 * A * y < 0 := by
    nlinarith [hsq, hlin, hcombine]

lemma f_f_eq (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → f (f y) = 2 * f y - y := by
  intro y hy
  have hfy : 0 < f y := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hineq (f y) y hfy hy
  have e1 : (f y ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 = (f y) ^ 2 := by ring
  have e2 : f y * f y = (f y) ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [e1, Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at h1
  rw [e2, Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at h2
  linarith

lemma f_inj_on_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 < b → f a = f b → a = b := by
  intro a b ha hb hfab
  have hffa := f_f_eq f hpos hineq a ha
  have hffb := f_f_eq f hpos hineq b hb
  rw [hfab] at hffa
  linarith

lemma seq_diff_eq (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    (∀ n, 0 < a n) ∧ ∀ n, a (n + 2) - a (n + 1) = a (n + 1) - a n := by
  have hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => rw [ha0]; exact hx
    | succ k ih => rw [haS k]; exact hpos (a k) ih
  refine ⟨hapos, ?_⟩
  intro n
  have h := f_f_eq f hpos hineq (a n) (hapos n)
  have e1 : a (n + 2) = f (f (a n)) := by
    rw [haS (n + 1), haS n]
  have e2 : a (n + 1) = f (a n) := haS n
  rw [e1, e2, h]
  ring

def funcIter (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => x
  | n + 1 => f (funcIter f x n)

lemma f_ge_id (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → f x ≥ x := by
  intro x hx
  have ha0 : funcIter f x 0 = x := by rfl
  have haS : ∀ n, funcIter f x (n + 1) = f (funcIter f x n) := fun n => by rfl
  obtain ⟨hapos, hdiff⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) ha0 haS
  set d : ℝ := funcIter f x 1 - funcIter f x 0 with hd_def
  have h1 : funcIter f x 1 = f x := by
    show funcIter f x (0 + 1) = f x
    rw [haS 0, ha0]
  have hd_eq : d = f x - x := by
    rw [hd_def, h1, ha0]
  have hconst : ∀ n, funcIter f x (n + 1) - funcIter f x n = d := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hd_def.symm
    | succ k ih =>
      have h := hdiff k
      rw [ih] at h
      exact h
  have hformula : ∀ n : ℕ, funcIter f x n = x + (n : ℝ) * d := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [ha0]
    | succ k ih =>
      have hk := hconst k
      have hstep : funcIter f x (k + 1) = funcIter f x k + d := by linarith
      rw [hstep, ih]
      push_cast
      ring
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hd_neg : d < 0 := by rw [hd_eq]; linarith
  have hnegd : 0 < -d := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (x / (-d))
  have hn' : x < (n : ℝ) * (-d) := (div_lt_iff₀ hnegd).mp hn
  rw [mul_neg] at hn'
  have hxn : x + (n : ℝ) * d < 0 := by linarith
  have hpos_n := hapos n
  rw [hformula n] at hpos_n
  linarith

lemma seq_diff_const (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n, a (n + 1) - a n = f x - x := by
  obtain ⟨hapos, hdiff⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  have hd0 : a 1 - a 0 = f x - x := by
    rw [haS 0, ha0]
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hd0
  | succ k ih =>
    have h := hdiff k
    rw [ih] at h
    linarith

lemma seq_formula (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, a n = x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
  have hdiff := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [ha0]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk := hdiff k
    have hstep : a (k + 1) = a k + (f x - x) := by linarith
    rw [hstep, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

lemma d_bounds (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) ∧
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≥ -2 * ((x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y)) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hineq x y hx hy
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith

lemma d_lipschitz (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ |x - f y| := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hfy := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have claimA : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2 ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ (f y) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hx.le hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hfy.le hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  have claimB : (x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : x ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (f y) ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma amqm_ge (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  linarith

lemma amgm_le (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : u * v ≤ ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  exact h2

lemma d_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hb := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have hxb : 0 < x + f y := by linarith
  have hs_ge : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amqm_ge x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hg_le : Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amgm_le x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hg_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs2 : (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2)) ^ 2 = (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hg2 : (Real.sqrt (x * f y)) ^ 2 = x * f y :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hkeyA : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) *
      (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) :=
    mul_nonneg hs_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hkeyB : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) * ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :=
    mul_nonneg hg_nonneg (by linarith)
  have claimA' : (2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y)) * (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hkeyA, hs2]
  have claimB' : ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) * (x + f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hkeyB, hg2]
  have claimA : 2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimA'
  have claimB : (x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimB'
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma seq_diff_lipschitz_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        |(x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))| := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hlip := d_lipschitz f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hlip
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hlip
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hlip
  push_cast at hlip
  simpa using hlip

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)
    (han : y < x + (n : ℝ) * dx) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      0 ≤ (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ∧
      (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) < dy ∧
      x + (n : ℝ) * dx ≤ y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy ∧
      2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ≤ (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) := by
  have hc : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y := by linarith
  set c : ℝ := (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y with hc_def
  have hk_pos : 0 < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (div_pos hc hdy)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hk_pos
  have hm' : ⌈c / dy⌉₊ = m + 1 := by omega
  have hm_lt : m < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := by omega
  have hub : (m : ℝ) < c / dy := Nat.lt_ceil.mp hm_lt
  have hlb : c / dy ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil (c / dy)
    rw [hm'] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  have h2 : c / dy * dy = c := div_mul_cancel₀ c hdy.ne'
  have hA : (m : ℝ) * dy < c := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hub hdy
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hB : c ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

lemma seq_diff_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hrb := d_refined_bound f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hrb
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hrb
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hrb
  push_cast at hrb
  simpa using hrb

lemma dy_bound_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdy : 0 < f y - y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by
  obtain ⟨m, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_m_bound (f x - x) (f y - y) x y hdy n hn
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hrb := seq_diff_refined_bound f hpos hineq x y hx hy n m
  have han_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hbm_pos : 0 < y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by linarith
  have hpos_an2 : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hpos_sum : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) := by linarith
  have hstep_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ((f y - y) - ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) *
          ((f y - y) + ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]
  have hstep1 :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :
      (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (sq_nonneg (f y - y))
  have hcross :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
    linarith
  have hfrac :

  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith

lemma d_lipschitz (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ |x - f y| := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hfy := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have claimA : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2 ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ (f y) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hx.le hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hfy.le hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  have claimB : (x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : x ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (f y) ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma amqm_ge (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  linarith

lemma amgm_le (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : u * v ≤ ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  exact h2

lemma d_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hb := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have hxb : 0 < x + f y := by linarith
  have hs_ge : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amqm_ge x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hg_le : Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amgm_le x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hg_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs2 : (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2)) ^ 2 = (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hg2 : (Real.sqrt (x * f y)) ^ 2 = x * f y :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hkeyA : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) *
      (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) :=
    mul_nonneg hs_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hkeyB : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) * ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :=
    mul_nonneg hg_nonneg (by linarith)
  have claimA' : (2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y)) * (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hkeyA, hs2]
  have claimB' : ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) * (x + f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hkeyB, hg2]
  have claimA : 2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimA'
  have claimB : (x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimB'
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma seq_diff_lipschitz_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        |(x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))| := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hlip := d_lipschitz f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hlip
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hlip
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hlip
  push_cast at hlip
  simpa using hlip

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)
    (han : y < x + (n : ℝ) * dx) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      0 ≤ (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ∧
      (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) < dy ∧
      x + (n : ℝ) * dx ≤ y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy ∧
      2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ≤ (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) := by
  have hc : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y := by linarith
  set c : ℝ := (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y with hc_def
  have hk_pos : 0 < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (div_pos hc hdy)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hk_pos
  have hm' : ⌈c / dy⌉₊ = m + 1 := by omega
  have hm_lt : m < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := by omega
  have hub : (m : ℝ) < c / dy := Nat.lt_ceil.mp hm_lt
  have hlb : c / dy ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil (c / dy)
    rw [hm'] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  have h2 : c / dy * dy = c := div_mul_cancel₀ c hdy.ne'
  have hA : (m : ℝ) * dy < c := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hub hdy
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hB : c ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

lemma seq_diff_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hrb := d_refined_bound f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hrb
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hrb
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hrb
  push_cast at hrb
  simpa using hrb

lemma dy_bound_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdy : 0 < f y - y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by
  obtain ⟨m, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_m_bound (f x - x) (f y - y) x y hdy n hn
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hrb := seq_diff_refined_bound f hpos hineq x y hx hy n m
  have han_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hbm_pos : 0 < y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by linarith
  have hpos_an2 : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hpos_sum : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) := by linarith
  have hstep_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ((f y - y) - ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) *
          ((f y - y) + ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]
  have hstep1 :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :
      (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (sq_nonneg (f y - y))
  have hcross :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
    linarith
  have hfrac :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    (div_le_div_iff₀ hpos_sum hpos_an2).mpr hcross
  exact le_trans hrb hfrac

lemma d_zero_lt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → f x - x = 0 → 0 < f y - y → x < y := by
  intro x y hx hy hdx0 hdypos
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hxy : 0 ≤ x - y := by linarith
  have hN_le : (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (x - y) / (f y - y) :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hxy hdypos.le)
  have hN_lt : (x - y) / (f y - y) < (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  set N : ℕ := ⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ with hN_def
  have heq : (x - y) / (f y - y) * (f y - y) = x - y :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ (x - y) hdypos.ne'
  have hN1 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) ≤ x := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN_le hdypos.le
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hN2 : x < y + ((N : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_lt hdypos
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hlip := seq_diff_lipschitz_bound f hpos hineq y x hy hx N 0
  rw [hdx0] at hlip
  simp only [sub_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlip
  rw [abs_of_pos hdypos] at hlip
  have hle0 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) - x ≤ 0 := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hle0] at hlip
  linarith

lemma d_eq_of_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdx : 0 < f x - x) (hdy : 0 < f y - y) :
    f x - x = f y - y := by
  by_contra hne
  have habs_pos : 0 < |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  have habs2_pos : 0 < 2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max ((y - x) / (f x - x))
      (((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x)))
  have hnA : (y - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hn
  have hnB : ((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hn
  have hA := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnA
  have hB := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnB
  have hn1 : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hn3 : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
    linarith
  have hxn_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have h2an_pos : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hC := (div_lt_iff₀ habs2_pos).mp hn3
  have heq : (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) * (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) =
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by ring
  rw [heq] at hC
  have hcompare : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) <
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := (div_lt_iff₀ h2an_pos).mpr hC
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := dy_bound_exists f hpos hineq x y hx hy hdy n hn1
  linarith

lemma d_pos_on_ge (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (y0 : ℝ) (hy0 : 0 < y0) (hdy0 : 0 < f y0 - y0) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, y0 ≤ x → 0 < f x - x := by
  intro x hxy0
  have hx : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hy0 hxy0
  have hge := f_ge_id f hpos hineq x hx
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ f x - x := by linarith
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hzero : f x - x = 0 := le_antisymm hcon hnonneg
  have hlt := d_zero_lt f hpos hineq x y0 hx hy0 hzero hdy0
  linarith

lemma linear_shift_satisfies (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < x + c) ∧
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (y + c) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ ((x + c) + y) / 2 ∧
      ((x + c) + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * (y + c)) := by
  refine ⟨fun x hx => by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro x y hx hy
  have hv : 0 ≤ y + c := by linarith
  have h1 := amqm_ge x (y + c) hx.le hv
  have h2 := amgm_le x (y + c) hx.le hv
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

lemma f_strict_mono_on_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x1 x2 : ℝ, 0 < x1 → 0 < x2 → x1 < x2 → f x1 < f x2 := by
  intro x1 x2 hx1 hx2 hlt
  have hge1 := f_ge_id f hpos hineq x1 hx1
  have hge2 := f_ge_id f hpos hineq x2 hx2
  rcases hge1.eq_or_lt with hd1 | hd1
  · rcases hge2.eq_or_lt with hd2 | hd2
    · linarith
    · linarith
  · rcases hge2.eq_or_lt with hd2 | hd2

    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        |(x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))| := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hlip := d_lipschitz f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hlip
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hlip
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hlip
  push_cast at hlip
  simpa using hlip

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)
    (han : y < x + (n : ℝ) * dx) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      0 ≤ (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ∧
      (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) < dy ∧
      x + (n : ℝ) * dx ≤ y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy ∧
      2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ≤ (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) := by
  have hc : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y := by linarith
  set c : ℝ := (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y with hc_def
  have hk_pos : 0 < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (div_pos hc hdy)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hk_pos
  have hm' : ⌈c / dy⌉₊ = m + 1 := by omega
  have hm_lt : m < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := by omega
  have hub : (m : ℝ) < c / dy := Nat.lt_ceil.mp hm_lt
  have hlb : c / dy ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil (c / dy)
    rw [hm'] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  have h2 : c / dy * dy = c := div_mul_cancel₀ c hdy.ne'
  have hA : (m : ℝ) * dy < c := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hub hdy
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hB : c ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

lemma seq_diff_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hrb := d_refined_bound f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hrb
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hrb
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hrb
  push_cast at hrb
  simpa using hrb

lemma dy_bound_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdy : 0 < f y - y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by
  obtain ⟨m, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_m_bound (f x - x) (f y - y) x y hdy n hn
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hrb := seq_diff_refined_bound f hpos hineq x y hx hy n m
  have han_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hbm_pos : 0 < y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by linarith
  have hpos_an2 : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hpos_sum : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) := by linarith
  have hstep_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ((f y - y) - ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) *
          ((f y - y) + ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]
  have hstep1 :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :
      (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (sq_nonneg (f y - y))
  have hcross :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
    linarith
  have hfrac :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    (div_le_div_iff₀ hpos_sum hpos_an2).mpr hcross
  exact le_trans hrb hfrac

lemma d_zero_lt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → f x - x = 0 → 0 < f y - y → x < y := by
  intro x y hx hy hdx0 hdypos
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hxy : 0 ≤ x - y := by linarith
  have hN_le : (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (x - y) / (f y - y) :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hxy hdypos.le)
  have hN_lt : (x - y) / (f y - y) < (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  set N : ℕ := ⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ with hN_def
  have heq : (x - y) / (f y - y) * (f y - y) = x - y :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ (x - y) hdypos.ne'
  have hN1 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) ≤ x := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN_le hdypos.le
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hN2 : x < y + ((N : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_lt hdypos
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hlip := seq_diff_lipschitz_bound f hpos hineq y x hy hx N 0
  rw [hdx0] at hlip
  simp only [sub_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlip
  rw [abs_of_pos hdypos] at hlip
  have hle0 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) - x ≤ 0 := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hle0] at hlip
  linarith

lemma d_eq_of_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdx : 0 < f x - x) (hdy : 0 < f y - y) :
    f x - x = f y - y := by
  by_contra hne
  have habs_pos : 0 < |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  have habs2_pos : 0 < 2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max ((y - x) / (f x - x))
      (((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x)))
  have hnA : (y - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hn
  have hnB : ((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hn
  have hA := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnA
  have hB := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnB
  have hn1 : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hn3 : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
    linarith
  have hxn_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have h2an_pos : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hC := (div_lt_iff₀ habs2_pos).mp hn3
  have heq : (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) * (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) =
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by ring
  rw [heq] at hC
  have hcompare : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) <
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := (div_lt_iff₀ h2an_pos).mpr hC
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := dy_bound_exists f hpos hineq x y hx hy hdy n hn1
  linarith

lemma d_pos_on_ge (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (y0 : ℝ) (hy0 : 0 < y0) (hdy0 : 0 < f y0 - y0) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, y0 ≤ x → 0 < f x - x := by
  intro x hxy0
  have hx : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hy0 hxy0
  have hge := f_ge_id f hpos hineq x hx
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ f x - x := by linarith
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hzero : f x - x = 0 := le_antisymm hcon hnonneg
  have hlt := d_zero_lt f hpos hineq x y0 hx hy0 hzero hdy0
  linarith

lemma linear_shift_satisfies (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < x + c) ∧
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (y + c) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ ((x + c) + y) / 2 ∧
      ((x + c) + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * (y + c)) := by
  refine ⟨fun x hx => by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro x y hx hy
  have hv : 0 ≤ y + c := by linarith
  have h1 := amqm_ge x (y + c) hx.le hv
  have h2 := amgm_le x (y + c) hx.le hv
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

lemma f_strict_mono_on_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x1 x2 : ℝ, 0 < x1 → 0 < x2 → x1 < x2 → f x1 < f x2 := by
  intro x1 x2 hx1 hx2 hlt
  have hge1 := f_ge_id f hpos hineq x1 hx1
  have hge2 := f_ge_id f hpos hineq x2 hx2
  rcases hge1.eq_or_lt with hd1 | hd1
  · rcases hge2.eq_or_lt with hd2 | hd2
    · linarith
    · linarith
  · rcases hge2.eq_or_lt with hd2 | hd2
    · have hzero : f x2 - x2 = 0 := by linarith
      have hdpos : 0 < f x1 - x1 := by linarith
      have hcontra := d_zero_lt f hpos hineq x2 x1 hx2 hx1 hzero hdpos
      linarith
    · have hdx1 : 0 < f x1 - x1 := by linarith
      have hdx2 : 0 < f x2 - x2 := by linarith
      have heq := d_eq_of_pos f hpos hineq x1 x2 hx1 hx2 hdx1 hdx2
      linarith

lemma d_ge_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ α y : ℝ, 0 < α → 0 < y → 0 < f y - y →
      f α - α ≥ (f y - y) - (α - y - (f y - y)) ^ 2 / (α + y + (f y - y)) := by
  intro α y hα hy hdy
  have hb := d_refined_bound f hpos hineq α y hα hy
  have heq1 : α - f y = α - y - (f y - y) := by ring
  have heq2 : α + f y = α + y + (f y - y) := by ring
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hb
  have hlow := (abs_le.mp hb).1
  linarith

lemma alpha_near_y_sq_lt (A y : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α →
      |α - y| < min (y / 2) (A * y / (3 * A + y / 2)) →
      (α - y - A) ^ 2 < A * (α + y + A) := by
  intro α hα hαy
  set δ := min (y / 2) (A * y / (3 * A + y / 2)) with hδ_def
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ y / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ2 : δ ≤ A * y / (3 * A + y / 2) := min_le_right _ _
  have hpos3 : (0:ℝ) < 3 * A + y / 2 := by linarith
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by
    apply lt_min
    · linarith
    · exact div_pos (mul_pos hA hy) hpos3
  have htlt : |α - y| < δ := hαy
  have ht' := abs_lt.mp htlt
  have t_lb : -δ < α - y := ht'.1
  have t_ub : α - y < δ := ht'.2
  have hp1 : 0 < δ - (α - y) := by linarith
  have hp2 : 0 < δ + (α - y) := by linarith
  have hsq : (α - y) ^ 2 < δ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [mul_pos hp1 hp2]
  have hlin : -3 * A * (α - y) < 3 * A * δ := by
    have h : -(α - y) < δ := by linarith
    have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h (show (0:ℝ) < 3 * A by linarith)
    nlinarith [h2]
  have hδsq : δ ^ 2 ≤ δ * (y / 2) := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ1 hδpos.le]
  have hstep : δ * (3 * A + y / 2) ≤ (A * y / (3 * A + y / 2)) * (3 * A + y / 2) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ2 hpos3.le
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ (A * y) hpos3.ne'] at hstep
  have hcombine : δ ^ 2 + 3 * A * δ ≤ A * y := by nlinarith [hδsq, hstep]
  have hfinal : (α - y) ^ 2 - 3 * A * (α - y) - 2 * A * y < 0 := by
    nlinarith [hsq, hlin, hcombine]
  nlinarith [hfinal]

lemma d_pos_open (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → 0 < f y - y →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → |α - y| < δ → 0 < f α - α := by
  intro y hy hdy
  set A := f y - y with hA_def
  set δ := min (y / 2) (A * y / (3 * A + y / 2)) with hδ_def
  have hpos3 : (0:ℝ) < 3 * A + y / 2 := by linarith
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by
    apply lt_min
    · linarith
    · exact div_pos (mul_pos hdy hy) hpos3
  refine ⟨δ, hδpos, ?_⟩
  intro α hα hαy
  have hlt := alpha_near_y_sq_lt A y hdy hy α hα hαy
  have hge := d_ge_bound f hpos hineq α y hα hy hdy
  have hApos : 0 < α + y + A := by linarith
  have hfrac_lt : (α - y - A) ^ 2 / (α + y + A) < A := (div_lt_iff₀ hApos).mpr hlt
  linarith [hge, hfrac_lt]

lemma d_le_sq_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → f x - x = 0 → 0 < f y - y →
      f y - y ≤ (y - x) ^ 2 / (y + x) := by
  intro x y hx hy hdx0 hdy
  have hrb := d_refined_bound f hpos hineq y x hy hx
  have hfx : f x = x := by linarith
  rw [hfx] at hrb
  simp only [sub_self] at hrb
  rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos hdy] at hrb
  exact hrb

lemma d_zero_below_sInf (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (hPne : {x : ℝ | 0 < x ∧ 0 < f x - x}.Nonempty) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < sInf {x : ℝ | 0 < x ∧ 0 < f x - x} → f x - x = 0 := by
  intro x hx hlt
  set P := {x : ℝ | 0 < x ∧ 0 < f x - x} with hP_def
  have hge := f_ge_id f hpos hineq x hx
  by_contra hne
  have hdpos : 0 < f x - x := lt_of_le_of_ne (by linarith) (Ne.symm hne)
  have hxP : x ∈ P := ⟨hx, hdpos⟩
  have hbdd : BddBelow P := ⟨0, fun y hy => hy.1.le⟩
  have hle : sInf P ≤ x := csInf_le hbdd hxP
  linarith

lemma d_pos_above_sInf (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧

lemma f_f_eq (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)

  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

    rw [heq] at h

  rw [abs_of_pos hdypos] at hlip
  have hle0 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) - x ≤ 0 := by linarith

lemma alpha_near_y_sq_lt (A y : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hy : 0 < y) :
    ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α →

  have hδ1 : δ ≤ y / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ2 : δ ≤ A * y / (3 * A + y / 2) := min_le_right _ _
  have hpos3 : (0:ℝ) < 3 * A + y / 2 := by linarith
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by
    apply lt_min
    · linarith
    · exact div_pos (mul_pos hA hy) hpos3
  have htlt : |α - y| < δ := hαy
  have ht' := abs_lt.mp htlt
  have t_lb : -δ < α - y := ht'.1
  have t_ub : α - y < δ := ht'.2
  have hp1 : 0 < δ - (α - y) := by linarith
  have hp2 : 0 < δ + (α - y) := by linarith
  have hsq : (α - y) ^ 2 < δ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [mul_pos hp1 hp2]
  have hlin : -3 * A * (α - y) < 3 * A * δ := by
    have h : -(α - y) < δ := by linarith
    have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h (show (0:ℝ) < 3 * A by linarith)
    nlinarith [h2]
  have hδsq : δ ^ 2 ≤ δ * (y / 2) := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ1 hδpos.le]
  have hstep : δ * (3 * A + y / 2) ≤ (A * y / (3 * A + y / 2)) * (3 * A + y / 2) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ2 hpos3.le
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ (A * y) hpos3.ne'] at hstep
  have hcombine : δ ^ 2 + 3 * A * δ ≤ A * y := by nlinarith [hδsq, hstep]
  have hfinal : (α - y) ^ 2 - 3 * A * (α - y) - 2 * A * y < 0 := by
    nlinarith [hsq, hlin, hcombine]
  nlinarith [hfinal]

lemma sInf_P_eq_zero (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)

  set A := f y0 - y0 with hA_def
  have hy0_pos : 0 < y0 := hy0P.1
  have hA_pos : 0 < A := hy0P.2

  have hm_pos : 0 < m := by
    rw [hm_def]

  have hε_pos : 0 < ε := by rw [hε_def]; linarith
  have hε_lt_m : ε < m := by rw [hε_def]; linarith
  have hε_lt_half : ε < s / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt_m (min_le_left _ _)
  have hε_lt_sqrt : ε < Real.sqrt (A * s / 2) := lt_of_lt_of_le hε_lt_m (min_le_right _ _)
  set x := s - ε with hx_def
  set y := s + ε with hy_def
  have hx_pos : 0 < x := by rw [hx_def]; linarith
  have hx_lt_s : x < s := by rw [hx_def]; linarith
  have hy_pos : 0 < y := by rw [hy_def]; linarith
  have hy_gt_s : s < y := by rw [hy_def]; linarith
  have hdx0 : f x - x = 0 :=
    d_zero_below_sInf f hpos hineq hPne x hx_pos hx_lt_s
  have hyP : y ∈ {x : ℝ | 0 < x ∧ 0 < f x - x} :=
    d_pos_above_sInf f hpos hineq hPne y hy_gt_s
  have hdy_pos : 0 < f y - y := hyP.2

    d_eq_of_pos f hpos hineq y y0 hy_pos hy0_pos hdy_pos hA_pos

    d_le_sq_bound f hpos hineq x y hx_pos hy_pos hdx0 hdy_pos
  have hyx : y - x = 2 * ε := by rw [hx_def, hy_def]; ring
  have hsum : y + x = 2 * s := by rw [hx_def, hy_def]; ring
  have hpos_sum : 0 < y + x := by rw [hsum]; linarith
  have hmul : (f y - y) * (y + x) ≤ (y - x) ^ 2 :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hpos_sum).mp hbound
  rw [hAeq, hyx, hsum] at hmul
  have h4 : (2 * ε) ^ 2 = 4 * ε ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [h4] at hmul
  have h6 : A * (2 * s) = 2 * (A * s) := by ring
  rw [h6] at hmul
  have hsq_lt : ε ^ 2 < A * s / 2 := by
    have hnn : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (A * s / 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

  have h5 : 4 * ε ^ 2 < 2 * (A * s) := by nlinarith [hsq_lt]
