  have hfy : 0 < f y := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hineq (f y) y hfy hy
  have e1 : (f y ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 = (f y) ^ 2 := by ring
  have e2 : f y * f y = (f y) ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [e1, Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at h1
  rw [e2, Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at h2
  linarith

lemma f_inj_on_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 < b → f a = f b → a = b := by
  intro a b ha hb hfab
  have hffa := f_f_eq f hpos hineq a ha
  have hffb := f_f_eq f hpos hineq b hb
  rw [hfab] at hffa
  linarith

lemma seq_diff_eq (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    (∀ n, 0 < a n) ∧ ∀ n, a (n + 2) - a (n + 1) = a (n + 1) - a n := by
  have hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => rw [ha0]; exact hx
    | succ k ih => rw [haS k]; exact hpos (a k) ih
  refine ⟨hapos, ?_⟩
  intro n
  have h := f_f_eq f hpos hineq (a n) (hapos n)
  have e1 : a (n + 2) = f (f (a n)) := by
    rw [haS (n + 1), haS n]
  have e2 : a (n + 1) = f (a n) := haS n
  rw [e1, e2, h]
  ring

def funcIter (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => x
  | n + 1 => f (funcIter f x n)

lemma f_ge_id (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → f x ≥ x := by
  intro x hx
  have ha0 : funcIter f x 0 = x := by rfl
  have haS : ∀ n, funcIter f x (n + 1) = f (funcIter f x n) := fun n => by rfl
  obtain ⟨hapos, hdiff⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) ha0 haS
  set d : ℝ := funcIter f x 1 - funcIter f x 0 with hd_def
  have h1 : funcIter f x 1 = f x := by
    show funcIter f x (0 + 1) = f x
    rw [haS 0, ha0]
  have hd_eq : d = f x - x := by
    rw [hd_def, h1, ha0]
  have hconst : ∀ n, funcIter f x (n + 1) - funcIter f x n = d := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hd_def.symm
    | succ k ih =>
      have h := hdiff k
      rw [ih] at h
      exact h
  have hformula : ∀ n : ℕ, funcIter f x n = x + (n : ℝ) * d := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [ha0]
    | succ k ih =>
      have hk := hconst k
      have hstep : funcIter f x (k + 1) = funcIter f x k + d := by linarith
      rw [hstep, ih]
      push_cast
      ring
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hd_neg : d < 0 := by rw [hd_eq]; linarith
  have hnegd : 0 < -d := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (x / (-d))
  have hn' : x < (n : ℝ) * (-d) := (div_lt_iff₀ hnegd).mp hn
  rw [mul_neg] at hn'
  have hxn : x + (n : ℝ) * d < 0 := by linarith
  have hpos_n := hapos n
  rw [hformula n] at hpos_n
  linarith

lemma seq_diff_const (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n, a (n + 1) - a n = f x - x := by
  obtain ⟨hapos, hdiff⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  have hd0 : a 1 - a 0 = f x - x := by
    rw [haS 0, ha0]
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hd0
  | succ k ih =>
    have h := hdiff k
    rw [ih] at h
    linarith

lemma seq_formula (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, a n = x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
  have hdiff := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [ha0]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk := hdiff k
    have hstep : a (k + 1) = a k + (f x - x) := by linarith
    rw [hstep, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

lemma d_bounds (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) ∧
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≥ -2 * ((x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y)) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hineq x y hx hy
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith

lemma d_lipschitz (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ |x - f y| := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hfy := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have claimA : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2 ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ (f y) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hx.le hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hfy.le hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  have claimB : (x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : x ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (f y) ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma amqm_ge (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  linarith

lemma amgm_le (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : u * v ≤ ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  exact h2

lemma d_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hb := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have hxb : 0 < x + f y := by linarith
  have hs_ge : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amqm_ge x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hg_le : Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amgm_le x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hg_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs2 : (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2)) ^ 2 = (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hg2 : (Real.sqrt (x * f y)) ^ 2 = x * f y :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hkeyA : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) *
      (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) :=
    mul_nonneg hs_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hkeyB : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) * ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :=
    mul_nonneg hg_nonneg (by linarith)
  have claimA' : (2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y)) * (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hkeyA, hs2]
  have claimB' : ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) * (x + f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hkeyB, hg2]
  have claimA : 2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimA'
  have claimB : (x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimB'
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma seq_diff_lipschitz_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        |(x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))| := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hlip := d_lipschitz f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hlip
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hlip
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hlip
  push_cast at hlip
  simpa using hlip

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)
    (han : y < x + (n : ℝ) * dx) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      0 ≤ (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ∧
      (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) < dy ∧
      x + (n : ℝ) * dx ≤ y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy ∧
      2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ≤ (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) := by
  have hc : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y := by linarith
  set c : ℝ := (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y with hc_def
  have hk_pos : 0 < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (div_pos hc hdy)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hk_pos
  have hm' : ⌈c / dy⌉₊ = m + 1 := by omega
  have hm_lt : m < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := by omega
  have hub : (m : ℝ) < c / dy := Nat.lt_ceil.mp hm_lt
  have hlb : c / dy ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil (c / dy)
    rw [hm'] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  have h2 : c / dy * dy = c := div_mul_cancel₀ c hdy.ne'
  have hA : (m : ℝ) * dy < c := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hub hdy
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hB : c ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

lemma seq_diff_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hrb := d_refined_bound f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hrb
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hrb
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hrb
  push_cast at hrb
  simpa using hrb

lemma dy_bound_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdy : 0 < f y - y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by
  obtain ⟨m, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_m_bound (f x - x) (f y - y) x y hdy n hn
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hrb := seq_diff_refined_bound f hpos hineq x y hx hy n m
  have han_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hbm_pos : 0 < y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by linarith
  have hpos_an2 : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hpos_sum : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) := by linarith
  have hstep_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ((f y - y) - ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) *
          ((f y - y) + ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]
  have hstep1 :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :
      (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (sq_nonneg (f y - y))
  have hcross :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
    linarith
  have hfrac :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    (div_le_div_iff₀ hpos_sum hpos_an2).mpr hcross
  exact le_trans hrb hfrac

      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → f x ≥ x := by
  intro x hx
  have ha0 : funcIter f x 0 = x := by rfl
  have haS : ∀ n, funcIter f x (n + 1) = f (funcIter f x n) := fun n => by rfl
  obtain ⟨hapos, hdiff⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) ha0 haS
  set d : ℝ := funcIter f x 1 - funcIter f x 0 with hd_def
  have h1 : funcIter f x 1 = f x := by
    show funcIter f x (0 + 1) = f x
    rw [haS 0, ha0]
  have hd_eq : d = f x - x := by
    rw [hd_def, h1, ha0]
  have hconst : ∀ n, funcIter f x (n + 1) - funcIter f x n = d := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hd_def.symm
    | succ k ih =>
      have h := hdiff k
      rw [ih] at h
      exact h
  have hformula : ∀ n : ℕ, funcIter f x n = x + (n : ℝ) * d := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [ha0]
    | succ k ih =>
      have hk := hconst k
      have hstep : funcIter f x (k + 1) = funcIter f x k + d := by linarith
      rw [hstep, ih]
      push_cast
      ring
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hd_neg : d < 0 := by rw [hd_eq]; linarith
  have hnegd : 0 < -d := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (x / (-d))
  have hn' : x < (n : ℝ) * (-d) := (div_lt_iff₀ hnegd).mp hn
  rw [mul_neg] at hn'
  have hxn : x + (n : ℝ) * d < 0 := by linarith
  have hpos_n := hapos n
  rw [hformula n] at hpos_n
  linarith

lemma seq_diff_const (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n, a (n + 1) - a n = f x - x := by
  obtain ⟨hapos, hdiff⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  have hd0 : a 1 - a 0 = f x - x := by
    rw [haS 0, ha0]
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hd0
  | succ k ih =>
    have h := hdiff k
    rw [ih] at h
    linarith

lemma seq_formula (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, a n = x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
  have hdiff := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [ha0]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk := hdiff k
    have hstep : a (k + 1) = a k + (f x - x) := by linarith
    rw [hstep, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

lemma d_bounds (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) ∧
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≥ -2 * ((x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y)) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hineq x y hx hy
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith

lemma d_lipschitz (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ |x - f y| := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hfy := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have claimA : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2 ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ (f y) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hx.le hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hfy.le hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  have claimB : (x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : x ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (f y) ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma amqm_ge (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  linarith

lemma amgm_le (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : u * v ≤ ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  exact h2

lemma d_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hb := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have hxb : 0 < x + f y := by linarith
  have hs_ge : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amqm_ge x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hg_le : Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amgm_le x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hg_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs2 : (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2)) ^ 2 = (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hg2 : (Real.sqrt (x * f y)) ^ 2 = x * f y :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hkeyA : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) *
      (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) :=
    mul_nonneg hs_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hkeyB : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) * ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :=
    mul_nonneg hg_nonneg (by linarith)
  have claimA' : (2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y)) * (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hkeyA, hs2]
  have claimB' : ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) * (x + f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hkeyB, hg2]
  have claimA : 2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimA'
  have claimB : (x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimB'
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma seq_diff_lipschitz_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        |(x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))| := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hlip := d_lipschitz f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hlip
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hlip
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hlip
  push_cast at hlip
  simpa using hlip

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)
    (han : y < x + (n : ℝ) * dx) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      0 ≤ (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ∧
      (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) < dy ∧
      x + (n : ℝ) * dx ≤ y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy ∧
      2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ≤ (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) := by
  have hc : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y := by linarith
  set c : ℝ := (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y with hc_def
  have hk_pos : 0 < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (div_pos hc hdy)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hk_pos
  have hm' : ⌈c / dy⌉₊ = m + 1 := by omega
  have hm_lt : m < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := by omega
  have hub : (m : ℝ) < c / dy := Nat.lt_ceil.mp hm_lt
  have hlb : c / dy ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil (c / dy)
    rw [hm'] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  have h2 : c / dy * dy = c := div_mul_cancel₀ c hdy.ne'
  have hA : (m : ℝ) * dy < c := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hub hdy
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hB : c ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

lemma seq_diff_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hrb := d_refined_bound f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hrb
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hrb
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hrb
  push_cast at hrb
  simpa using hrb

lemma dy_bound_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdy : 0 < f y - y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by
  obtain ⟨m, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_m_bound (f x - x) (f y - y) x y hdy n hn
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hrb := seq_diff_refined_bound f hpos hineq x y hx hy n m
  have han_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hbm_pos : 0 < y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by linarith
  have hpos_an2 : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hpos_sum : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) := by linarith
  have hstep_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ((f y - y) - ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) *
          ((f y - y) + ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]
  have hstep1 :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :
      (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (sq_nonneg (f y - y))
  have hcross :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
    linarith
  have hfrac :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    (div_le_div_iff₀ hpos_sum hpos_an2).mpr hcross
  exact le_trans hrb hfrac

lemma d_zero_lt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → f x - x = 0 → 0 < f y - y → x < y := by
  intro x y hx hy hdx0 hdypos
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hxy : 0 ≤ x - y := by linarith
  have hN_le : (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (x - y) / (f y - y) :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hxy hdypos.le)
  have hN_lt : (x - y) / (f y - y) < (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  set N : ℕ := ⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ with hN_def
  have heq : (x - y) / (f y - y) * (f y - y) = x - y :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ (x - y) hdypos.ne'
  have hN1 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) ≤ x := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN_le hdypos.le
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hN2 : x < y + ((N : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_lt hdypos
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hlip := seq_diff_lipschitz_bound f hpos hineq y x hy hx N 0
  rw [hdx0] at hlip
  simp only [sub_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlip
  rw [abs_of_pos hdypos] at hlip
  have hle0 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) - x ≤ 0 := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hle0] at hlip
  linarith

lemma d_eq_of_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdx : 0 < f x - x) (hdy : 0 < f y - y) :
    f x - x = f y - y := by
  by_contra hne

  have hx_lt_s : x < s := by rw [hx_def]; linarith
  have hy_pos : 0 < y := by rw [hy_def]; linarith

  have hpos_sum : 0 < y + x := by rw [hsum]; linarith
  have hmul : (f y - y) * (y + x) ≤ (y - x) ^ 2 :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hpos_sum).mp hbound
  rw [hAeq, hyx, hsum] at hmul
  have h4 : (2 * ε) ^ 2 = 4 * ε ^ 2 := by ring

  have h6 : A * (2 * s) = 2 * (A * s) := by ring

      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n, a (n + 1) - a n = f x - x := by
  obtain ⟨hapos, hdiff⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  have hd0 : a 1 - a 0 = f x - x := by
    rw [haS 0, ha0]
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hd0
  | succ k ih =>
    have h := hdiff k
    rw [ih] at h
    linarith

lemma seq_formula (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, a n = x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
  have hdiff := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [ha0]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk := hdiff k
    have hstep : a (k + 1) = a k + (f x - x) := by linarith
    rw [hstep, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

lemma d_bounds (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) ∧
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≥ -2 * ((x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y)) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hineq x y hx hy
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith

lemma d_lipschitz (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ |x - f y| := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hfy := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have claimA : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2 ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ (f y) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hx.le hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hfy.le hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  have claimB : (x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : x ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (f y) ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma amqm_ge (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  linarith

lemma amgm_le (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : u * v ≤ ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  exact h2

lemma d_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hb := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have hxb : 0 < x + f y := by linarith
  have hs_ge : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amqm_ge x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hg_le : Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amgm_le x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hg_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs2 : (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2)) ^ 2 = (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hg2 : (Real.sqrt (x * f y)) ^ 2 = x * f y :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hkeyA : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) *
      (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) :=
    mul_nonneg hs_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hkeyB : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) * ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :=
    mul_nonneg hg_nonneg (by linarith)
  have claimA' : (2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y)) * (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hkeyA, hs2]
  have claimB' : ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) * (x + f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hkeyB, hg2]
  have claimA : 2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimA'
  have claimB : (x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimB'
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma seq_diff_lipschitz_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        |(x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))| := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hlip := d_lipschitz f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hlip
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hlip
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hlip
  push_cast at hlip
  simpa using hlip

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)
    (han : y < x + (n : ℝ) * dx) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      0 ≤ (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ∧
      (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) < dy ∧
      x + (n : ℝ) * dx ≤ y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy ∧
      2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ≤ (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) := by
  have hc : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y := by linarith
  set c : ℝ := (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y with hc_def
  have hk_pos : 0 < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (div_pos hc hdy)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hk_pos
  have hm' : ⌈c / dy⌉₊ = m + 1 := by omega
  have hm_lt : m < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := by omega
  have hub : (m : ℝ) < c / dy := Nat.lt_ceil.mp hm_lt
  have hlb : c / dy ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil (c / dy)
    rw [hm'] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  have h2 : c / dy * dy = c := div_mul_cancel₀ c hdy.ne'
  have hA : (m : ℝ) * dy < c := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hub hdy
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hB : c ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

lemma seq_diff_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hrb := d_refined_bound f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hrb
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hrb
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hrb
  push_cast at hrb
  simpa using hrb

lemma dy_bound_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdy : 0 < f y - y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by
  obtain ⟨m, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_m_bound (f x - x) (f y - y) x y hdy n hn
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hrb := seq_diff_refined_bound f hpos hineq x y hx hy n m
  have han_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hbm_pos : 0 < y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by linarith
  have hpos_an2 : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hpos_sum : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) := by linarith
  have hstep_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ((f y - y) - ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) *
          ((f y - y) + ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]
  have hstep1 :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :
      (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (sq_nonneg (f y - y))
  have hcross :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
    linarith
  have hfrac :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    (div_le_div_iff₀ hpos_sum hpos_an2).mpr hcross
  exact le_trans hrb hfrac

lemma d_zero_lt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → f x - x = 0 → 0 < f y - y → x < y := by
  intro x y hx hy hdx0 hdypos
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hxy : 0 ≤ x - y := by linarith
  have hN_le : (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (x - y) / (f y - y) :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hxy hdypos.le)
  have hN_lt : (x - y) / (f y - y) < (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  set N : ℕ := ⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ with hN_def
  have heq : (x - y) / (f y - y) * (f y - y) = x - y :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ (x - y) hdypos.ne'
  have hN1 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) ≤ x := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN_le hdypos.le
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hN2 : x < y + ((N : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_lt hdypos
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hlip := seq_diff_lipschitz_bound f hpos hineq y x hy hx N 0
  rw [hdx0] at hlip
  simp only [sub_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlip
  rw [abs_of_pos hdypos] at hlip
  have hle0 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) - x ≤ 0 := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hle0] at hlip
  linarith

lemma d_eq_of_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdx : 0 < f x - x) (hdy : 0 < f y - y) :
    f x - x = f y - y := by
  by_contra hne
  have habs_pos : 0 < |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  have habs2_pos : 0 < 2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max ((y - x) / (f x - x))
      (((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x)))
  have hnA : (y - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hn
  have hnB : ((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hn
  have hA := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnA
  have hB := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnB
  have hn1 : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hn3 : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
    linarith
  have hxn_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have h2an_pos : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hC := (div_lt_iff₀ habs2_pos).mp hn3
  have heq : (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) * (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) =
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by ring
  rw [heq] at hC
  have hcompare : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) <
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := (div_lt_iff₀ h2an_pos).mpr hC
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := dy_bound_exists f hpos hineq x y hx hy hdy n hn1
  linarith

lemma d_pos_on_ge (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)

      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (ha0 : a 0 = x) (haS : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = f (a n)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, a n = x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
  have hdiff := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx a ha0 haS
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [ha0]
  | succ k ih =>
    have hk := hdiff k
    have hstep : a (k + 1) = a k + (f x - x) := by linarith
    rw [hstep, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

lemma d_bounds (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) ∧
      (f x - x) - (f y - y) ≥ -2 * ((x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y)) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hineq x y hx hy
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith

lemma d_lipschitz (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ |x - f y| := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hfy := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have claimA : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2 ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ (f y) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hx.le hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul h h hfy.le hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) :=
        Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  have claimB : (x + f y) / 2 - Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ |x - f y| / 2 := by
    rcases le_total x (f y) with h | h
    · have hxy : x - f y ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = -(x - f y) := abs_of_nonpos hxy
      have hle : x ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hx.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hx.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
    · have hxy : 0 ≤ x - f y := by linarith
      have habs : |x - f y| = x - f y := abs_of_nonneg hxy
      have hle : (f y) ^ 2 ≤ x * f y := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hfy.le]
      have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((f y) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hfy.le] at hsqrt
      linarith [hsqrt, habs]
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma amqm_ge (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  linarith

lemma amgm_le (u v : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ (u + v) / 2 := by
  have hle : u * v ≤ ((u + v) / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v)]
  have h2 : Real.sqrt (u * v) ≤ Real.sqrt (((u + v) / 2) ^ 2) :=
    Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hle
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
  exact h2

lemma d_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := by
  intro x y hx hy
  have hb := hpos y hy
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := d_bounds f hpos hineq x y hx hy
  have hxb : 0 < x + f y := by linarith
  have hs_ge : Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amqm_ge x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hg_le : Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x + f y) / 2 :=
    amgm_le x (f y) hx.le hb.le
  have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hg_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs2 : (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2)) ^ 2 = (x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hg2 : (Real.sqrt (x * f y)) ^ 2 = x * f y :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hkeyA : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) *
      (Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) / 2) :=
    mul_nonneg hs_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hkeyB : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x * f y) * ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :=
    mul_nonneg hg_nonneg (by linarith)
  have claimA' : (2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y)) * (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hkeyA, hs2]
  have claimB' : ((x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y)) * (x + f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hkeyB, hg2]
  have claimA : 2 * Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) - (x + f y) ≤
      (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) := (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimA'
  have claimB : (x + f y) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x * f y) ≤ (x - f y) ^ 2 / (x + f y) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hxb).mpr claimB'
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hb2, claimB]
  · linarith [hb1, claimA]

lemma seq_diff_lipschitz_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        |(x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))| := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hlip := d_lipschitz f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hlip
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hlip
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hlip
  push_cast at hlip
  simpa using hlip

lemma exists_m_bound (dx dy x y : ℝ) (hdy : 0 < dy) (n : ℕ)
    (han : y < x + (n : ℝ) * dx) :
    ∃ m : ℕ,
      0 ≤ (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ∧
      (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) - (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) < dy ∧
      x + (n : ℝ) * dx ≤ y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy ∧
      2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) ≤ (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy) := by
  have hc : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y := by linarith
  set c : ℝ := (x + (n : ℝ) * dx) - y with hc_def
  have hk_pos : 0 < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (div_pos hc hdy)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hk_pos
  have hm' : ⌈c / dy⌉₊ = m + 1 := by omega
  have hm_lt : m < ⌈c / dy⌉₊ := by omega
  have hub : (m : ℝ) < c / dy := Nat.lt_ceil.mp hm_lt
  have hlb : c / dy ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have h := Nat.le_ceil (c / dy)
    rw [hm'] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  have h2 : c / dy * dy = c := div_mul_cancel₀ c hdy.ne'
  have hA : (m : ℝ) * dy < c := by
    have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hub hdy
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hB : c ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 1) * dy := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlb hdy.le
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hA, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]
  · linarith [hB, hc_def]

lemma seq_diff_refined_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → ∀ n m : ℕ,
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤
        ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
  intro x y hx hy n m
  have hax := seq_formula f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hay := seq_formula f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcx := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hcy := seq_diff_const f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hapos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq x hx (funcIter f x) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  obtain ⟨hbpos, _⟩ := seq_diff_eq f hpos hineq y hy (funcIter f y) rfl (fun k => rfl)
  have hrb := d_refined_bound f hpos hineq (funcIter f x n) (funcIter f y m) (hapos n) (hbpos m)
  have heq1 : f (funcIter f x n) - funcIter f x n = f x - x := hcx n
  have heq2 : f (funcIter f y m) - funcIter f y m = f y - y := hcy m
  rw [heq1, heq2] at hrb
  have hfb : f (funcIter f y m) = funcIter f y (m + 1) := rfl
  rw [hfb] at hrb
  rw [hax n, hay (m + 1)] at hrb
  push_cast at hrb
  simpa using hrb

lemma dy_bound_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdy : 0 < f y - y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by
  obtain ⟨m, h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := exists_m_bound (f x - x) (f y - y) x y hdy n hn
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have hrb := seq_diff_refined_bound f hpos hineq x y hx hy n m
  have han_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hbm_pos : 0 < y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by linarith
  have hpos_an2 : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hpos_sum : 0 < (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) := by linarith
  have hstep_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ((f y - y) - ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) *
          ((f y - y) + ((y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y)) - (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)))) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hsq :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 ≤ (f y - y) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hstep_nonneg]
  have hstep1 :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (by linarith)
  have hstep2 :
      (f y - y) ^ 2 * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (sq_nonneg (f y - y))
  have hcross :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 *
          (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 *
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) := by
    linarith
  have hfrac :
      ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) - (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ^ 2 /
          ((x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) + (y + ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y))) ≤
        (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) :=
    (div_le_div_iff₀ hpos_sum hpos_an2).mpr hcross
  exact le_trans hrb hfrac

lemma d_zero_lt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y)) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y → f x - x = 0 → 0 < f y - y → x < y := by
  intro x y hx hy hdx0 hdypos
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hxy : 0 ≤ x - y := by linarith
  have hN_le : (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (x - y) / (f y - y) :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hxy hdypos.le)
  have hN_lt : (x - y) / (f y - y) < (⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 :=
    Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  set N : ℕ := ⌊(x - y) / (f y - y)⌋₊ with hN_def
  have heq : (x - y) / (f y - y) * (f y - y) = x - y :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ (x - y) hdypos.ne'
  have hN1 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) ≤ x := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN_le hdypos.le
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hN2 : x < y + ((N : ℝ) + 1) * (f y - y) := by
    have h := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hN_lt hdypos
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith
  have hlip := seq_diff_lipschitz_bound f hpos hineq y x hy hx N 0
  rw [hdx0] at hlip
  simp only [sub_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hlip
  rw [abs_of_pos hdypos] at hlip
  have hle0 : y + (N : ℝ) * (f y - y) - x ≤ 0 := by linarith
  rw [abs_of_nonpos hle0] at hlip
  linarith

lemma d_eq_of_pos (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) (hdx : 0 < f x - x) (hdy : 0 < f y - y) :
    f x - x = f y - y := by
  by_contra hne
  have habs_pos : 0 < |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
  have habs2_pos : 0 < 2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := by linarith
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max ((y - x) / (f x - x))
      (((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x)))
  have hnA : (y - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hn
  have hnB : ((f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) - x) / (f x - x) < (n : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hn
  have hA := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnA
  have hB := (div_lt_iff₀ hdx).mp hnB
  have hn1 : y < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have hn3 : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by
    linarith
  have hxn_pos : 0 < x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x) := by linarith
  have h2an_pos : 0 < 2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) := by linarith
  have hC := (div_lt_iff₀ habs2_pos).mp hn3
  have heq : (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x)) * (2 * |(f x - x) - (f y - y)|) =
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| * (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) := by ring
  rw [heq] at hC
  have hcompare : (f y - y) ^ 2 / (2 * (x + (n : ℝ) * (f x - x))) <
      |(f x - x) - (f y - y)| := (div_lt_iff₀ h2an_pos).mpr hC
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := dy_bound_exists f hpos hineq x y hx hy hdy n hn1
  linarith

lemma d_pos_on_ge (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < f x)
    (hineq : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < y →
      Real.sqrt ((x ^ 2 + (f y) ^ 2) / 2) ≥ (f x + y) / 2 ∧
      (f x + y) / 2 ≥ Real.sqrt (x * f y))
    (y0 : ℝ) (hy0 : 0 < y0) (hdy0 : 0 < f y0 - y0) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, y0 ≤ x → 0 < f x - x := by
  intro x hxy0
  have hx : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hy0 hxy0
  have hge := f_ge_id f hpos hineq x hx
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ f x - x := by linarith
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hzero : f x - x = 0 := le_antisymm hcon hnonneg
  have hlt := d_zero_lt f hpos hineq x y0 hx hy0 hzero hdy0

lemma linear_shift_satisfies (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :

      (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ
      rest

  Relation.ReflTransGen BlackboardMove s t

gcd(a, b) = gcd(min a b, max a b − min a b).

We argue by cases on whether a ≤ b or b ≤ a.

  gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a − b).

  The same divisibility argument as in Case 1 (with a and b swapped) shows gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a − b).

    rw [hu2, Multiset.cons_add]

lemma nat_dvd_sub {k m n : ℕ} (h1 : k ∣ m) (h2 : k ∣ n) : k ∣ m - n := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h2

    have hm : m = n + k * z := by
      rw [hx, hy, ← hz]
      ring
    omega
  · have hmn : m ≤ n := by
      rw [hx, hy]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hxy
    rw [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hmn]
    exact dvd_zero k

    Nat.gcd a b = Nat.gcd (min a b) (max a b - min a b) := by
  rcases le_total a b with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h, max_eq_right h]
    have d1 : Nat.gcd a b ∣ Nat.gcd a (b - a) := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd

    have d2 : Nat.gcd a (b - a) ∣ Nat.gcd a b := by

      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a (b - a)

    have d1 : Nat.gcd a b ∣ Nat.gcd b (a - b) := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
        exact nat_dvd_sub h1 h2

-- One legal blackboard move.
def BlackboardMove
    (s t : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ),
    1 < m ∧
    1 < n ∧
    s = m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest ∧
    t =
      Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ
      (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ
      rest

-- The board t can be obtained from s after zero or more moves.
def Reachable
    (s t : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen BlackboardMove s t

-- No further legal move can be made from s.
def Terminal
    (s : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ¬ ∃ t, BlackboardMove s t

-- There is no infinite sequence of legal moves starting from s.
def TerminatesFrom
    (s : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s

      _ = Nat.gcd m n * Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod := by ring

    (s t : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen BlackboardMove s t

-- No further legal move can be made from s.
def Terminal
    (s : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  ¬ ∃ t, BlackboardMove s t

-- There is no infinite sequence of legal moves starting from s.
def TerminatesFrom
    (s : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s

lemma prod_move (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) :
    ∃ m n : ℕ, 1 < m ∧ 1 < n ∧
      t.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod ∧
      t.prod ≤ s.prod ∧
      (0 < s.prod → (t.prod = s.prod ↔ Nat.gcd m n = 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  have hdvd : Nat.gcd m n ∣ Nat.lcm m n := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left m n)
  have hcalc : Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) = Nat.lcm m n :=
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
  have heq : t.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod := by
    subst hs
    subst ht
    simp only [Multiset.prod_cons]
    calc
      Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n * rest.prod) * Nat.gcd m n
          = Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by ring
      _ = Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by rw [hcalc]
      _ = Nat.gcd m n * Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod := by ring
      _ = m * n * rest.prod := by rw [Nat.gcd_mul_lcm]
      _ = m * (n * rest.prod) := by ring
  have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
    omega
  have hgcdpos : 0 < Nat.gcd m n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgcdne
  have hge1 : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd m n := hgcdpos
  refine ⟨m, n, hm, hn, heq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hle : t.prod * 1 ≤ t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := mul_le_mul_left' hge1 t.prod
    rw [mul_one] at hle
    calc t.prod ≤ t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := hle
      _ = s.prod := heq
  · intro hspos
    constructor
    · intro htst
      have h1 : s.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod := by
        have h0 := heq
        rw [htst] at h0
        exact h0
      have h2 : s.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod * 1 := by rw [mul_one]; exact h1
      exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hspos h2
    · intro hg
      rw [hg, mul_one] at heq
      exact heq

noncomputable def Cnt (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ := (s.filter (fun x => 1 < x)).card

lemma cnt_cons_pos {a : ℕ} (s : Multiset ℕ) (h : 1 < a) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) = 1 + Cnt s := by
  unfold Cnt
  rw [Multiset.filter_cons_of_pos (p := fun x => 1 < x) s h, Multiset.card_cons]
  omega

lemma cnt_cons_nonpos {a : ℕ} (s : Multiset ℕ) (h : ¬ 1 < a) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) = Cnt s := by
  unfold Cnt
  rw [Multiset.filter_cons_of_neg (p := fun x => 1 < x) s h]

lemma cnt_cons_le (a : ℕ) (s : Multiset ℕ) :
    Cnt (a ::ₘ s) ≤ 1 + Cnt s := by
  by_cases h : 1 < a
  · rw [cnt_cons_pos s h]
  · rw [cnt_cons_nonpos s h]
    omega

lemma count_move_le (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) :
    Cnt t ≤ Cnt s := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  subst hs
  subst ht
  have hs_eq : Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) = 2 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hm, cnt_cons_pos _ hn]
    omega
  have h1 := cnt_cons_le (Nat.gcd m n) (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ rest)
  have h2 := cnt_cons_le (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) rest
  have ht_le : Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) ≤ 1 + (1 + Cnt rest) := by
    omega
  omega

lemma count_move_eq_pred_of_coprime (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ)
    (hm : 1 < m) (hn : 1 < n) (hcop : Nat.gcd m n = 1) :
    Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) =
      Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) - 1 := by
  have hs_eq : Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) = 2 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hm, cnt_cons_pos _ hn]
    omega
  have hlcm : Nat.lcm m n = m * n := by
    have hh := Nat.gcd_mul_lcm m n
    rw [hcop, one_mul] at hh
    exact hh
  have hmn : 1 < m * n := by
    nlinarith
  have ht_eq : Cnt (Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest) = 1 + Cnt rest := by
    rw [hcop, hlcm]
    simp only [Nat.div_one]
    rw [cnt_cons_nonpos (a := 1) (m * n ::ₘ rest) (by decide), cnt_cons_pos rest hmn]
  omega

noncomputable def Mu (s : Multiset ℕ) : ℕ × ℕ := (s.prod, Cnt s)

def LtLex (p q : ℕ × ℕ) : Prop := p.1 < q.1 ∨ (p.1 = q.1 ∧ p.2 < q.2)

lemma move_decreases_measure (s t : Multiset ℕ) (h : BlackboardMove s t) (hpos : 0 < s.prod) :
    LtLex (Mu t) (Mu s) := by
  show t.prod < s.prod ∨ (t.prod = s.prod ∧ Cnt t < Cnt s)
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hs, ht⟩ := h
  have hdvd : Nat.gcd m n ∣ Nat.lcm m n := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n).trans (Nat.dvd_lcm_left m n)
  have hcalc : Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) = Nat.lcm m n :=
    Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
  have heq : t.prod * Nat.gcd m n = s.prod := by
    subst hs
    subst ht
    simp only [Multiset.prod_cons]
    calc
      Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n * rest.prod) * Nat.gcd m n
          = Nat.gcd m n * (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by ring
      _ = Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by rw [hcalc]
      _ = Nat.gcd m n * Nat.lcm m n * rest.prod := by ring
      _ = m * n * rest.prod := by rw [Nat.gcd_mul_lcm]
      _ = m * (n * rest.prod) := by ring
  by_cases hg : Nat.gcd m n = 1
  · right
    have hst : t.prod = s.prod := by
      rw [hg, mul_one] at heq
      exact heq
    refine ⟨hst, ?_⟩
    have hcnt := count_move_eq_pred_of_coprime rest m n hm hn hg
    rw [← ht] at hcnt
    have hCs : Cnt s = Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) := by rw [hs]
    have hpos2 : 0 < Cnt (m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest) := by
      rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hm]
      omega
    rw [hCs, hcnt]
    omega
  · left
    have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
      omega
    have hgcdpos : 0 < Nat.gcd m n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hgcdne
    have hgt1 : 1 < Nat.gcd m n := by omega
    have htpos : 0 < t.prod := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t.prod with h0 | h0
      · exfalso
        rw [h0, zero_mul] at heq
        omega
      · exact h0
    have hlt : t.prod < t.prod * Nat.gcd m n := by
      have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hgt1 htpos
      simpa using h2
    rw [heq] at hlt
    exact hlt

lemma lt_lex_wf : WellFounded LtLex := by
  have H : ∀ a : ℕ, ∀ b : ℕ, Acc LtLex (a, b) := by
    intro a
    have Ha : Acc ((· < ·) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) a := wellFounded_lt.apply a
    induction Ha with
    | intro a _ ih =>
      intro b
      have Hb : Acc ((· < ·) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) b := wellFounded_lt.apply b
      induction Hb with
      | intro b _ ihb =>
        apply Acc.intro
        intro q hq
        obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := q
        have hq' : c < a ∨ (c = a ∧ d < b) := hq
        rcases hq' with h1 | ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · exact ih c h1 d
        · rw [h1]
          exact ihb d h2
  exact ⟨fun p => H p.1 p.2⟩

lemma acc_pos_prod :
    ∀ s : Multiset ℕ, 0 < s.prod → Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s := by
  have key : ∀ p : ℕ × ℕ, ∀ s : Multiset ℕ, Mu s = p → 0 < s.prod →
      Acc (fun t s => BlackboardMove s t) s := by
    intro p
    have hacc : Acc LtLex p := lt_lex_wf.apply p
    induction hacc with
    | intro p _ ih =>
      intro s hMu hpos
      apply Acc.intro
      intro t ht
      have hlt : LtLex (Mu t) (Mu s) := move_decreases_measure s t ht hpos
      rw [hMu] at hlt
      have htpos : 0 < t.prod := by
        obtain ⟨m, n, hm, hn, heq, hle, hiff⟩ := prod_move s t ht
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t.prod with h0 | h0
        · exfalso
          rw [h0, zero_mul] at heq
          omega
        · exact h0
      exact ih (Mu t) hlt t rfl htpos
  intro s hpos
  exact key (Mu s) s rfl hpos

lemma exists_two_of_cnt_ge_two (t : Multiset ℕ) (h : 2 ≤ Cnt t) :
    ∃ (rest : Multiset ℕ) (m n : ℕ), 1 < m ∧ 1 < n ∧ t = m ::ₘ n ::ₘ rest := by
  unfold Cnt at h
  have hpos : 0 < (t.filter (fun x => 1 < x)).card := by omega
  have hne : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) ≠ 0 := Multiset.card_pos.mp hpos
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero hne
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem ha
  have hrcard : 1 ≤ r.card := by
    rw [hr, Multiset.card_cons] at h
    omega
  have hrne : r ≠ 0 := Multiset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero hrne
  obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem hb
  have ha1 : 1 < a := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp ha).2
  have hrle : r ≤ t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := by
    rw [hr]
    exact Multiset.le_cons_self r a
  have hb2 : b ∈ t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := Multiset.mem_of_le hrle hb
  have hb1 : 1 < b := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hb2).2
  have hab : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = a ::ₘ b ::ₘ r' := by rw [hr, hr']
  have hle2 : a ::ₘ b ::ₘ r' ≤ t := by
    rw [← hab]
    exact Multiset.filter_le _ t
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Multiset.le_iff_exists_add.mp hle2
  have hu2 : t = a ::ₘ (b ::ₘ r' + u) := by
    rw [hu, Multiset.cons_add]
  have hu3 : t = a ::ₘ b ::ₘ (r' + u) := by
    rw [hu2, Multiset.cons_add]
  exact ⟨r' + u, a, b, ha1, hb1, hu3⟩

lemma terminal_iff_cnt_le_one (t : Multiset ℕ) : Terminal t ↔ Cnt t ≤ 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro hterm
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, ht⟩ := exists_two_of_cnt_ge_two t (by omega)
    exact hterm ⟨Nat.gcd m n ::ₘ (Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n) ::ₘ rest, rest, m, n, hm, hn, ht, rfl⟩
  · intro hle
    rintro ⟨t', rest, m, n, hm, hn, ht, ht'eq⟩
    have hcnt : Cnt t = 1 + (1 + Cnt rest) := by
      rw [ht, cnt_cons_pos _ hm, cnt_cons_pos _ hn]
    omega

lemma cnt_ge_one_of_move {p q : Multiset ℕ} (h : BlackboardMove p q) : 1 ≤ Cnt q := by
  obtain ⟨rest, m, n, hm, hn, hp, hq⟩ := h
  subst hq
  by_cases hg : 1 < Nat.gcd m n
  · rw [cnt_cons_pos _ hg]
    omega
  · have hgcdne : Nat.gcd m n ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [Nat.gcd_eq_zero_iff] at h0
      omega
    have hg1 : Nat.gcd m n = 1 := by omega
    have hlcm : Nat.lcm m n = m * n := by
      have hh := Nat.gcd_mul_lcm m n
      rw [hg1, one_mul] at hh
      exact hh
    have hh1 : 1 < Nat.lcm m n / Nat.gcd m n := by
      rw [hg1, hlcm]
      simp only [Nat.div_one]
      nlinarith
    rw [cnt_cons_nonpos _ hg, cnt_cons_pos _ hh1]
    omega

lemma reachable_cnt_ge_one {s t : Multiset ℕ} (h : Reachable s t) (hs : 1 ≤ Cnt s) :
    1 ≤ Cnt t := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hs
  | tail _ hbc _ => exact cnt_ge_one_of_move hbc

lemma nat_dvd_sub {k m n : ℕ} (h1 : k ∣ m) (h2 : k ∣ n) : k ∣ m - n := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h2
  rcases le_total y x with hxy | hxy
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Nat.le.dest hxy  -- hz : y + z = x
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    have hm : m = n + k * z := by
      rw [hx, hy, ← hz]
      ring
    omega
  · have hmn : m ≤ n := by
      rw [hx, hy]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hxy
    rw [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le hmn]
    exact dvd_zero k

lemma gcd_min_max_sub (a b : ℕ) :
    Nat.gcd a b = Nat.gcd (min a b) (max a b - min a b) := by
  rcases le_total a b with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h, max_eq_right h]
    have d1 : Nat.gcd a b ∣ Nat.gcd a (b - a) := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
        exact nat_dvd_sub h2 h1
    have d2 : Nat.gcd a (b - a) ∣ Nat.gcd a b := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left a (b - a)
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a (b - a)
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a (b - a)
        have hb : Nat.gcd a (b - a) ∣ a + (b - a) := Nat.dvd_add h1 h2
        rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' h] at hb
    exact Nat.dvd_antisymm d1 d2
  · rw [min_eq_right h, max_eq_left h]
    have d1 : Nat.gcd a b ∣ Nat.gcd b (a - b) := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a b
        exact nat_dvd_sub h1 h2
    have d2 : Nat.gcd b (a - b) ∣ Nat.gcd a b := by
      apply Nat.dvd_gcd
      · have h1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left b (a - b)
        have h2 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right b (a - b)
        have ha : Nat.gcd b (a - b) ∣ b + (a - b) := Nat.dvd_add h1 h2
        rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel' h] at ha
      · exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left b (a - b)
    exact Nat.dvd_antisymm d1 d2

lemma factorization_gcd_eq_min (p m n : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (Nat.gcd m n).factorization p = min (m.factorization p) (n.factorization p) := by
  have hm' : m ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hn' : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  rw [Nat.factorization_gcd hm' hn']
  simp [Finsupp.inf_apply]

lemma pow_dvd_of_not_dvd_of_dvd_mul {p a b k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpa : ¬ p ∣ a) (hdvd : p ^ k ∣ a * b) : p ^ k ∣ b := by
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime p a := (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp).mpr hpa
  have hcop' : Nat.Coprime (p ^ k) a := hcop.pow_left k
  exact hcop'.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hdvd

    exact hlt

lemma lt_lex_wf : WellFounded LtLex := by
  have H : ∀ a : ℕ, ∀ b : ℕ, Acc LtLex (a, b) := by
    intro a
    have Ha : Acc ((· < ·) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) a := wellFounded_lt.apply a
    induction Ha with
    | intro a _ ih =>
      intro b
      have Hb : Acc ((· < ·) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) b := wellFounded_lt.apply b
      induction Hb with
      | intro b _ ihb =>

        intro q hq
        obtain ⟨c, d⟩ := q
        have hq' : c < a ∨ (c = a ∧ d < b) := hq
        rcases hq' with h1 | ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · exact ih c h1 d
        · rw [h1]

  exact ⟨fun p => H p.1 p.2⟩

  have hpos : 0 < (t.filter (fun x => 1 < x)).card := by omega
  have hne : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) ≠ 0 := Multiset.card_pos.mp hpos
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero hne
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem ha
  have hrcard : 1 ≤ r.card := by
    rw [hr, Multiset.card_cons] at h
    omega
  have hrne : r ≠ 0 := Multiset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero hrne
  obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem hb

    rw [hr]
    exact Multiset.le_cons_self r a
  have hb2 : b ∈ t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) := Multiset.mem_of_le hrle hb
  have hb1 : 1 < b := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hb2).2
  have hab : t.filter (fun x => 1 < x) = a ::ₘ b ::ₘ r' := by rw [hr, hr']
  have hle2 : a ::ₘ b ::ₘ r' ≤ t := by

    exact Multiset.filter_le _ t

  have hu2 : t = a ::ₘ (b ::ₘ r' + u) := by
    rw [hu, Multiset.cons_add]
  have hu3 : t = a ::ₘ b ::ₘ (r' + u) := by
    rw [hu2, Multiset.cons_add]
  exact ⟨r' + u, a, b, ha1, hb1, hu3⟩
